units.tr: Again, in counting we say un paio, due paia, a pair, two pairs; likewise un centinaio, due centinaia, a hundred, two hundred, or a hundredweight; un migliaio, due migliaia, a thousand, or a thousand-fold number, two thousands.

units.la: Item vna decina, due decine, Eine zehente, gezehnte Zahl, zwey gezehnte, zwey zehenten, vna duzina, due dozine, ein Dutzend, zwey dutzend vnd so fort. Item vna Ventina, due Ventine, vna Trentina, due Trentine. Eine gezwantzigste Zahl. Zwey gezwantzigste Zahlen. Ein gedreyssigftes Zahlwerck. Zwey gedreyssigste Werck,&c.
units.tr: Likewise una decina, due decine: a tenth, a number of tens, two tens or two tithes; una dozzina, due dozzine: a dozen, two dozen; and so on. Likewise una ventina, due ventine; una trentina, due trentine: one group of twenty, two groups of twenty; a thirtieth number, two thirtieth numbers, a thirty-fold number, two thirty-fold numbers, etc.

units.la: DE NOMINE RELATIVO.
units.tr: ON THE RELATIVE NOUN.

units.la: Der etwas widerholt, oder anzeigt.
units.tr: Which repeats or points back to something.

units.la: Lquale & laquale, est nomen, quod sæpissime in⁠greditur orationem; Il quale, welcher, Laquale, welche, &c. idem derselbe, dieselbe, ist ein Name, oder sind Namen, welche offtermaln in einer Red fürkommen. Ac semper refert aliquid, quod præcessit, vnd allezeit auff etwas, so vorher gangen, sich ziehet: quapropter à Grammaticis Relatiuum appellatur. Daher es von den SprachKünstlern Relatiuum genennet wird. Conjungitur semper cum Articulo. Es wird allezeit mit dem Articul angehengt, Nam quale, sine Articulo est potius qualitatis nomen, quam Relatiuum. Denn quale, ohn den Articul ist vil mehr ein Nomen, so eine beschaffenheit bedeutet, als ein Relatiuum.
units.tr: Il quale and la quale is a noun which very often enters a sentence: il quale, which; la quale, which (feminine), and so on. Idem, the same (masculine or feminine), are nouns which often occur in a sentence. And it always refers back to something that has gone before; for this reason it is called the Relative by the grammarians. It is always joined with the article, for quale without the article is rather a noun signifying quality than a relative.

units.la: Porro declinari potest modo, qui ex subjecto paradigmate conspicitur. Es kan aber also vnd der gestalt decliniret werden, wie auß hierbey gezeichnetem FürbildsExempel mit mehrerem zusehen.
units.tr: Moreover, it can be declined in the way shown by the model paradigm below. How it is declined can be seen more fully from the example given here.

units.la: Nominis Relatiui Declinatio.
units.tr: Declension of the Relative Noun.

units.la: Nom. sing. Ilquale, welcher, item auch welches, Lat. qui & Mulieb. gen. qua. welche, laquale. Item Genit. Del quale, welchen, cuius, & della quale, welcher Frawen, &c. Dativ.
units.tr: Nom. sing. Il quale, which (masculine), also which (neuter), Lat. qui; feminine la quale, which (feminine), qua. Also Gen. del quale, of which (masculine), cuius, and della quale, of which (feminine), etc. Dative:

units.la: Dativ. Alquale, welchem, tui a qui, & Alla-quale, welcher Frawen &c.
units.tr: Dat. al quale, to which (masculine), cui or qui; and alla quale, to which (feminine), etc.

units.la: Accuf. il quale, welcher, qui & quem, La quale, welche, quam &c.
units.tr: Acc. il quale, which (masculine), qui and quem; la quale, which (feminine), quam, etc.

units.la: Ablat. Dal quale, von welchem, de qui, quo, dalla quale, von welcher, qua &c.
units.tr: Abl. dal quale, from which (masculine), de qui, quo; dalla quale, from which (feminine), qua, etc.

units.la: Nom.plur. i quali, qui, welche, Le quali, qua, welche Frawen.
units.tr: Nom. plur. i quali, qui, which; le quali, quae, which (feminine).

units.la: Genit. dei quali, welcheren, quorum, delle quali, quarum, welcher Weiber.
units.tr: Genitive: of whom, of which (masculine), quorum, of whom (feminine), quarum, of which women.

units.la: Dativ. ai quali, welchen, oder denen, quibus, welchen Weibern, alle quali, quibus.
units.tr: Dative: to whom, to which, or to them, quibus, to which women, to whom, quibus.

units.la: Accuf. i quali, welche, quos, welche Weiber, Le quali, quas.
units.tr: Accusative: who, which, quos, which women, which, quas.

units.la: Ablat. Da i quali, von welchen, quibus dalle quali, von welchen Weibern, quibus.
units.tr: Abl. dai quali, from which, quibus; dalle quali, from which (feminine), quibus.

units.la: Verum in obliquis habet quoque, cui, quod ad utrumque genus & numerum pertinet, at infleEti hoc modo poteft.
units.tr: But in the oblique cases it also has cui, which applies to both gender and number; it is inflected in this way.

units.la: Aber in den Obliquis, hat es auch cui, welches generis communis und utriusque numeri ist, und kan folgender gestalt declinirt werden.
units.tr: In the oblique cases it also has cui, which is of common gender and of both numbers, and can be declined in the following manner.

units.la: Genitiv. De mi, cuius, mir, mich, pl. quorum, quarum, deren, welchern
units.tr: Gen. di cui, cuius, of whom or whose; plural quorum, quarum, of whom.

units.la: Dativ. A cui, cui, pl. quibus, welcher, deme, denen, oder welchen.
units.tr: Dat. a cui, cui, to whom; plural quibus, to whom.

units.la: Accuf. cui, deme, welchem, quem, quam, und plur. quos, quas, welchen, &c.
units.tr: Accusative: whom, to whom, which, quem, quam, and plural quos, quas, which, etc.

units.la: Ablat. da cui, von deme, von dere, quo, qua, pl. quibus, von welchen, und von denen.
units.tr: Abl. da cui, from whom, quo, qua; plural quibus, from whom.

units.la: Vfus autem huius Nominis, cui, eft huiufmodi, vt dicamus, per omnes Cafus obliquos, & Numeros,
units.tr: The usage of this word cui is such that we say it through all the oblique cases and numbers,

units.la: Als
units.tr: As follows:

units.la: Genitiv. Mi parlo tuo Padre, dein Vatter hat zu mir geredt, Locutus eft mihi Pater tuus.
units.tr: Gen. Di cui parlò tuo padre, of whom your father spoke; your father has spoken to me, Locutus est mihi Pater tuus.

units.la: Idem, di cui e il Canallo, dessen das Roß ist, cuius eft Equus.
units.tr: Likewise, di cui è il cavallo, whose the horse is, cuius est Equus.

units.la: Dativ. Io viddi il tuo fratello, a cui diedi il libro. Vidi fratrem tuum, cui librum dedi.
units.tr: Dative. I saw your brother, to whom I gave the book. I saw your brother, to whom I gave the book.

units.la: Ich hab deinen Bruder gefehen, dem ich das Buch gabe.
units.tr: I saw your brother, to whom I gave the book.

units.la: Accuf. Io haueua Familiarità col tuo amico, cui morde il cane arrabiato.
units.tr: Acc. Io avevo familiarità col tuo amico, cui morde il cane arrabbiato.

units.la: Vtebat familiariter amico tuo, quem canis rabidus mordit.
units.tr: He used to be on familiar terms with your friend, whom a mad dog bit.

units.la: Ich hatte gute Freundschafft mit deinem Freund, welchen ein wütiger Hund gebissen hat.
units.tr: I was on friendly terms with your friend, whom a mad dog has bitten.

units.la: Ablat. Andai a trouar Antonio, da cui riceuei le tue Lettere.
units.tr: Abl. Andai a trovar Antonio, da cui ricevei le tue lettere.

units.la: Conueni Antonium, a quo accepi tuas Literas.
units.tr: Convenì Antonium, a quo accepi tuas literas.

units.la: Ich habe dem Antonio zugesprochen, von welchem ich deine Schreiben empfangen hab.
units.tr: I went to see Antonio, from whom I received your letters.

units.la: Eodem prorsus modo deduci possunt exempla ex Numero multitudinis.
units.tr: The same examples can be drawn in exactly the same way from the plural number.

units.la: Also kan man auch mehr Exempel auß dem plurali Numero machen.
units.tr: So one can also make further examples from the plural number.

units.la: Et quanquam dixerimus hoc nomine carere recto, ac in obliquis tantum inflecti ex adjectione prapositionum, vt ostendimus.
units.tr: And although we have said that this word has no nominative, and is inflected only in the oblique cases with the addition of prepositions, as we have shown,

units.la: Vnd ob wir gleich gesagt, daß dises Wörtlein keinen Nominatiuum hab, vnd nur allein in den Obliquis, mit zusetzung der præpositičn abgeleitet werde, wie oben gewisen. Tamen passim reperiet apud probatos Authores, ipsos dicendi modos. So findet man doch hin vnd wider, bey bewehrten Bücherschreibern, dise Red arthen.
units.tr: And although we have said that this little word has no nominative and is inflected only in the oblique cases, with prepositions added, as shown above, nevertheless here and there in approved authors one finds these very turns of phrase.

units.la: Il cui valore, dessen oder welches Tapferkeit, La cui Bonta, welches Frömmigkeit, idem, i cui amori, dessen Lieben, idem, Le cui Ricchezze, welches Reichthümber, &c.
units.tr: Il cui valore, whose courage; la cui bontà, whose goodness; likewise i cui amori, whose loves; likewise le cui ricchezze, whose riches, etc.

units.la: Sed, ita eos refoluere necesse est, nempe, aber diese muß man also auffloßen, nemblich, Il valor di cui, cuius virtus, welches Tugend, dessen Tugend, La Bonta di cui, dessen Frömmigkeit, cuius Bonitas. Gli Amori di cui, cuius amores, Le Ricchezze di cui, cuius diuitiae, &c. Vnd könde man also per obliquum eben sowol sagen: del cui valore, pro del valor di cui, della cui Bonta, de i cui amori, delle cui ricchezze, pro della Bonta di cui, degli amori di cui, delle ricchezze di cui, cuius diuitiarum, &c.
units.tr: But these must be resolved in this way, namely, but these must be analysed thus, namely, the value of whom, whose virtue, which virtue, whose virtue, the goodness of whom, whose piety, whose goodness. The loves of whom, whose loves, the riches of whom, whose riches, etc. And one could in the same way say, per obliquum: of whose value, for of the value of whom, of whose goodness, of whose loves, of whose riches, for of the goodness of whom, of the loves of whom, of the riches of whom, whose riches, etc.

units.la: Nam per omnes alios casus modo confimili, quis percurrere posset. Dann es köndte einer gleicher gestalt, durch alle Casus lauffen, quod praetermitto breuitatis causa, welches ich kürtze wegen übergehe.
units.tr: For one could run through all the other cases in a similar manner, which I pass over for the sake of brevity.

units.la: Sed hinc facile perspicitur. Hierauß sihet man aber leichtlich, Articulos II, La, I, & Le, non proprie in illis dicendi modos pertinere ad nomen Cui. Daß die Articul Il, La, &c. in solchen Red arthen eygentlich nicht zum Wörtlein cui gehören, fed ad nomina, sondern zu den Namen, Valore, Tapfferkeit, Bonta, Gütigkeit, Frommigkeit, Amòri, die Lieben, & RiccheZZe, die Reichthumer.
units.tr: From this one can easily see that the articles il, la, i, and le do not properly belong, in such turns of phrase, to the word cui, but to the nouns: valore, courage; bontà, goodness or kindness; amori, the loves; and ricchezze, the riches.

units.la: Denique vfurpatur in Datiuo Cafu, fine prapofi- tione, hoc modo.
units.tr: Finally, it is used in the dative case without a preposition, in this way.

units.la: Letzlich braucht mans im Datiuo, ohne prapofition auff folgende weise, cui non bafta, pro a cui non bafta, deme nicht genug ist oder genüget, cui non sufficit.
units.tr: Finally it is used in the dative without a preposition, in the following manner: cui non basta, i.e. a cui non basta, to whom it is not enough, or who is not content, cui non sufficit.

units.la: Item cui diede il Re potestà, pro à cui diede &c. cui Rex poteftatem dedit, welchem oder deme der König den Gewalt gegeben.
units.tr: Likewise, cui diede il Re potestà, for à cui diede, etc. cui Rex potestatem dedit, to whom or to him the king has given power.

units.la: De vsu autem nominis, il quale, Vom nutz vnd gebrauch aber difes Wörtleins, il quale, non est, quod anxie conet, nonnulla afferre, Ist nicht noth, vil Wort davon zuverlieren.
units.tr: Concerning the use of the word il quale: it is not necessary to labour to bring forward many words about it (German: Ist nicht noth, vil Wort davon zuverlieren).

units.la: Quandoquidem cum Relatiuo latino eum habeat communem.
units.tr: Since it has this in common with the Latin relative.

units.la: Sintemahl es mit dem Lateinischen pronomine relatiuo eum, vberein kömbt.
units.tr: Since it agrees with the Latin relative pronoun eum.

units.la: Quodcirca illud nunc annotabo, Darumb will ich nur difes bemercken.
units.tr: Therefore I will note only this.

units.la: Particulam che, plerumque eius loco poni, Daß das Wörtlein che, gemeiniglich an seiner stell gebraucht werde. Idque tamen in Nominatiuo & Accusatiuo singul. & plur. nmeri, hoc modo.
units.tr: That the particle che is generally used in its place; and this indeed in the nominative and accusative, singular and plural, in this way.

units.la: Vnd solches zwar im Nominatiuo vnd Accusatiuo vtriusq; numeri, auff solche weise.
units.tr: And this indeed in the nominative and accusative of both numbers, in the following manner.

units.la: L'huomo, che penfa effer fauio, molte volte, è sciocco. Homo, qui prudens esse putat, est nonnunquam ineptus. Ein Mensch, der vermeint gescheid oder geschickt zuseyn, der ist offtermals ein Thor.
units.tr: L'uomo, che pensa esser savio, molte volte è sciocco. Homo, qui prudens esse putat, est nonnunquam ineptus. A man who thinks himself wise is often a fool.

units.la: Item L' huomo ch' io amo, e dotto, quem diligo hominem, est eruditus. Der Mann, welchen ich liebe, der ist gelehrt.
units.tr: The man whom I love is a learned man. The man whom I love, he is learned.

units.la: Eadem penitus exempla possunt ex multitudinis numero adduci. Dergleichen Exempel, können auch vom plurali num. gemacht oder beygebracht werden.
units.tr: The very same examples can be brought forward from the plural number.

units.la: Quando autem particula Che, mentionem fecimus, Weil aber das Stückwörtleins Che, ist gedacht worden.
units.tr: Since, however, we have mentioned the particle che,

units.la: Est de eaque sciendum, conjungi interdum cum praepositionibus, hoc modo. So ist von demselbigen zuwissen, daß es bißweilen mit denen praepositionibus gesetzt werde, auff solche weise.
units.tr: It is also to be known of this word that it is sometimes joined with prepositions, in this manner. So it should be known of that same word that it is sometimes used with prepositions, in the following way.

units.la: Di che, Dessen, A che, deme, oder welchem, Da che, von welchem, in che, in welchen, con che, mit welchem, per che, durch welchen, Item es wird mit den Articuln zusammen gefügt, als
units.tr: Di che, whose; A che, to whom, or to which; Da che, from which; in che, in which; con che, with which; per che, through which. Item, it is also joined together with the articles, as follows:

units.la: Il che, welches, dell che, dessen, Al che, deme, oder welchem, Nel che, in welchem, in was, &c.
units.tr: Il che, which; dell che, whose; Al che, to him, or to which; Nel che, in which, or in what, &c.

units.la: At non dicimus. Aber wir sagen nicht, col che, sicut neque, auch nicht, per il che, quod prius est in vsu, weil das erste im brauch ist, posterius vero ita vsurpatur, das letzer aber also gebraucht wird, nempe, nemblich, Il perche, atqui nemo, qui non omnino careat aurium judicio fatebitur esse rectius dictum, per il che;
units.tr: But we do not say col che, sicut neque, nor per il che, because quod prius est in vsu (the first is in use), posterius vero ita vsurpatur (but the latter is so used), nempe (namely) Il perche: for no one who lacks an ear for language entirely will admit that per il che is said more correctly.

units.la: Aber niemand, so mit den Ohren etwas vrtheilen kan, wird sagen, per ilche, sey besser, als il perche, vmb weß willen darumb denn.
units.tr: Yet no one who can judge anything by the ear will say that per il che is better than il perche, that is, "for which reason".

units.la: Et si hoc crebro vtatur, Boccacius, dicendi genere; illo vero nunquam; Obwol difes Boccatius sehr offt gebraucht, jenes aber niemals.
units.tr: Et si hoc crebro vtatur, Boccacius, dicendi genere; illo vero nunquam: although Boccaccio uses this form very often, he never uses that one.

units.la: Interdum hac particula geminatur, hoc modo. Bißweiln wird dieß Stückwörtlein che gedoppelt, anff dise weise, che che, & significat, vnd bedeut, qualunque cosa, vt che che sia, es sey was es sey, jedweders sey was es wolle, quicquid sit, Idem, che che habbia detto, es habs gesagt wer da woll, quicquid dixerit.
units.tr: Interdum hac particula geminatur, hoc modo. Sometimes this little particle che is doubled, in this way: che che, and it means qualunque cosa, vt che che sia, whatever it may be; quicquid sit. Idem, che che habbia detto, whatever he may have said; quicquid dixerit.

units.la: Rursus ex eadem, chiunque, hoc est, widerumb wird auß demselben chiunque, das ist, l. quicunque, ein jeder, ein jeglicher, & est trisyllabum, vnd hat drey Sylben. Sed inter chiunque, & qualunque, hoc interest.
units.tr: Again, from the same root comes chiunque, that is, l. quicunque, each one, every one; & est trisyllabum, and it has three syllables. Sed inter chiunque, & qualunque, hoc interest.

units.la: Aber difer Vnderscheid ist vnder Chiunque, vnd Qualunque.
units.tr: But there is this difference between Chiunque and Qualunque.

units.la: Quod alterum substantiuo non congungitur, alterum vero maxime,
units.tr: Because the one is not joined to a substantive, while the other especially is.

units.la: Daß das eine mit dem substantivo nicht gesetzt wird, das ander aber gar sehr.
units.tr: That the one is not joined with a substantive, while the other very often is.

units.la: Quamuis & ipsum aliquando separetur ab illo, Ob gleich bißweilen dasselbe nicht da stehet.
units.tr: Quamuis & ipsum aliquando separetur ab illo, although sometimes even that one is separated from its substantive.

units.la: Petrarcha enim ita loquitur, Dann Petrarcha redet also, Chiunque alberga, quicunque habitat, ein jeder herbriget oder wohnet.
units.tr: Petrarcha enim ita loquitur: for Petrarch speaks thus, Chiunque alberga, quicunque habitat: everyone lodges, or dwells.

units.la: Vbi chiunque est per se, sine abjestione alicuius nominis substantivi.
units.tr: Where chiunque stands by itself, without any substantive noun added.

units.la: Da stehet Chiunque allein, ohne zuthuung eines substantivi.
units.tr: Here Chiunque stands alone, without any substantive noun added to it.

units.la: Idem postea dicit, Eben diser saget hernach, Qualunque Animale, quodcunque animal, ein jedweders Thier.
units.tr: Idem postea dicit: the same author later says, Qualunque Animale, quodcunque animal: every animal.

units.la: Vbi animale substantivum nomen adjungitur nomini qualunque.
units.tr: Where an animate substantive noun is joined to any noun whatever.

units.la: Da animale das substantivum, zu dem Wort qualunque gesetzt wird.
units.tr: Here the substantive animale is placed with the word qualunque.

units.la: Dixi tamen aliquando, sed semel, Ich hab derhalben gesagt, bißweilen, vnd einmahl sage ich, Giotr di qualunque, quocunque latari, vber jedweders sich frewen.
units.tr: Dixi tamen aliquando, sed semel: I have therefore said it at times, but once only I say: Giotr di qualunque, quocunque latari, to rejoice over anyone's (good fortune).

units.la: Ex hac deinceps ablato E, & abscripto I, sit chi, wer.
units.tr: Ex hac deinceps ablato E, & abscripto I, sit chi: then from this, with the E removed and an I written in its place, comes chi, who.

units.la: Auß difem wird hernach Chi, wenn man das E, hinweg wirfft, vnd macht ein I.darfür hin.
units.tr: From this afterwards Chi is formed, when one drops the E and makes an I in its place.

units.la: Qua particula ponitur non raro pro Colui, quello, Colei, quella, Coloro, quelli & quelle.
units.tr: This particle is often used for colui, quello, colei, quella, coloro, quelli and quelle.

units.la: Welches Stuckwörtlein Chi, gar offt vnd vil gesetzt wird, für colui, der quello, derselbe, coloi, sie, quella, dieselbige, Coloro, quelli, sie dieselbigen Männer, & quelle, dieselben Weiber.
units.tr: This little word Chi is used very often and in many places for colui, he (the one who); quello, that one; coloi, she; quella, that woman; Coloro, quelli, those men; and quelle, those women.

units.la: Hoc modo, auff solche weise. Chi hä fmarrita la ftrada, tòrni in dietro, id eft pro colui vel quello, alfo nemblich, quello, il quale hà fmarrita, oder colui, il quale hà fmarrita, & c. qui deuiauit, redeat, wer deß weegs geirret hat, der kehr wider zuruck. Chi, pro inde nonnunquam fignificat, quis interrogandi vox, idque per omnes Casus.
units.tr: In this way: Chi hà smarrita la strada, tòrni in dietro, that is, pro colui vel quello, namely quello, il quale hà smarrita, or colui, il quale hà smarrita, etc., qui deuiauit, redeat: whoever has strayed from the way, let him turn back. Chi, accordingly, sometimes signifies quis, a word of interrogation, and this through all cases.

units.la: Darnach zuweilen bedeutet Chi, wie aller Hand fragen zugebrauchen, vnd dieß durch alle Casus, als nemblichen.
units.tr: Afterwards Chi sometimes has the sense of any kind of question word, and this through all the cases, namely:

units.la: Nom. Chi fu, quis fuit, wer ist da gewesen, Item, chi il fece, quis fecit, wer hat das gethan.
units.tr: Nominative: Chi fu, who was there; Item, chi il fece, who did it.

units.la: Genit. Di chi fei tu figliuolo, cuius es tu filius, Weß Sohn bist du.
units.tr: Genitive: Di chi fei tu figliuolo, whose son are you?

units.la: Dativ. a chi l hai dato: cui dedisti, wem haft du es geben.
units.tr: Dative: a chi l hai dato, to whom have you given it?

units.la: Accus. Chi battesti tu, quem verberasti, Wen haft du geschlagen, oder geschmiffen.
units.tr: Accusative: Chi battesti tu, whom did you strike, or throw down?

units.la: Ablat. Da chi l hai vdito, a quo audiuisti, Von wem haft du es gehört.
units.tr: Ablative: Da chi l hai vdito, from whom did you hear it?

units.la: Praterea dicimus, über daß sagen wir, Chi qua, e chi la, alius, alio, einer hin, der ander her, oder einer hie, der ander da, Chi spogliaua quefto, e chi quello, einer beraubte diesen, der ander jenen, alius hunc, alius illum spoliabat
units.tr: Furthermore we say Chi qua, e chi la, one here and another there; Chi spogliaua quefto, e chi quello, one robbed this man, and another that one.

units.la: Postremo dicimus, Endtlich sagt man auch, sbi chefia, quisquis sit, sey wer es wolle.
units.tr: Finally one also says sbi chefia, quisquis sit: whoever it may be.

units.la: De nominibus quæ Partitiua, Infinita, distributiua, & negantia appellantur.
units.tr: On the nouns called partitive, indefinite, distributive, and negative.

units.la: Von denen Namen, vvelche theilbare, vnendliche austheilige, vnd verneinliche genennet werden.
units.tr: Of the names called partitive, indefinite, distributive, and negative.

units.la: PRincipio nomen alteri, quod hanc tantum voce est contentum. Erstlich wird das Wort altri, so nur allein in difer endung gebräuchlich ist, atque ad omnem numerum & genus pertinet, vnd zu beyden Numeris, vnd Zahlen generibus oder Gefchlechten gehöret. Ita vsurpatur, wird also gebraucht, Ma quando altri volesse opporsi, l. sed si aliquis refragari vellet. Aber so sich jemand widersetzen wolte, Item, altri dice, es sprechen etliche, dicunt nonnulli, In obliquo autem habet altrui, quare dicimus: In denen obliquis hat es altrui, darumb saget man, Io porto la pena dell' altrui Colpa, Ich trag die Straffe, so ein anderer verschuldet, luo poenam alienæ culpæ.
units.tr: First, the word altri, which is used only in this one form, and pertains to every number and gender, belongs to both numbers and to both genders. So it is used: "Ma quando altri volesse opporsi," "but if someone should wish to object". Likewise, altri dice, some say, others say. In the oblique cases it has altrui, so we say: "Io porto la pena dell' altrui colpa," I bear the punishment which another's fault has incurred, I bear another's punishment for their fault.

units.la: Item all' altrui valore, vel al valore altrui, alienæ virtuti, anderer Tapfferkeit vnd Tugend, idem, dall' altrui forza, vel dalla forza altrui, alienavi, von anderer oder frembder Krafft vnd Stärcke. Nomen vero altro, habet in plurali altri. Aber das Wort altro, hat in plurali numero altri.
units.tr: Likewise, "all' altrui valore," or "al valore altrui," to another's worth, to another's courage and virtue; likewise, "dall' altrui forza," or "dalla forza altrui," from another's or a stranger's strength and might. But the word altro has altri in the plural.

units.la: Et est generis viril. sicut altra, quod est muliebris gen. habet in plurali numero altre. Vnd ist gener. masc. wie altra, so gener. fœmin. ist, vnd in plur. hat altre.
units.tr: It is of the masculine gender, like altra, which is of the feminine gender, and it has altre in the plural.

units.la: Quod nomen differt a nomine altri, de quo paulo superius egimus, in hoc. welches Wort von dem Wort altri, davon oben gedacht, in disem Stuck vnderschiden ist.
units.tr: This noun differs from the noun altri, of which we spoke a little above, in this: the word in question differs from the word altri, mentioned above, in the following respect.

units.la: Quod illud, nempe altri, nunquam substantivo adhæret, Daß altri niemals einem substantivo anhänget.
units.tr: That this word, namely altri, never attaches itself to a substantive, that altri never attaches itself to a substantivo.

units.la: Hoc vero, nempe altro, sape ac semper ad supra nominatas personas refertur. Dises aber nemblich altro, offters, vnd ziehet sich allezeit auff die Personen, so oben benannt worden.
units.tr: This word, however, namely altro, often and always refers to the persons named above. This one, namely altro, often and always refers to the persons named above.

units.la: Dicimus enim, wir sagen aber, L' altro tuo amico, gli altri tuoi amici, L' altra tua amica, L' altre tue amiche, Der ander dein Freund, die andern deine Freund, item die andere deine Freundin, die andern deine Freundinen.
units.tr: For we say, we say, L' altro tuo amico, gli altri tuoi amici, L' altra tua amica, L' altre tue amiche, the other (your) friend, the others (your) friends, likewise the other (your) female friend, the others (your) female friends.

units.la: Et modo confimili per omnes casus, Vocativo excepto, vnd also gleicher gestalt, durch alle casus, außgenommen den Vocatiuum.
units.tr: And in the same way through all the cases, except the vocative.

units.la: Idem vero utitur itidem in genere neutro, ac dicimus, Es wird auch in genere neutro gebraucht, vnd saget man, altro domando, aliud peto, ich begehr ein anders, item anzi altro, imo aliud, ja ein anders, ja vilmehr ein anders. Sed
units.tr: It is also used in the neuter gender, and we say, "altro domando," "aliud peto," I ask for something else; "anzi altro," "imo aliud," yes, something else, or rather something else. But

units.la: Sed tunc Articulum respuit, vt exemplis appa-ret, Aber da wirffts den Artickel hinwegk, wie auß den Exempeln erscheinet.
units.tr: But then it rejects the article, as appears from the examples.

units.la: Alcuno, aliquis, einer, einiger, idem jemands, habet in plur. alcuni, hat in dem plur. numero aliqui lat. alcuni Ital. einige, etliche, die einen, ficut alcuna, hoc est, aliqua, einige, eine Fraw, habet plur. alcune, hoc est, aliqua, einige, oder etliche Frawen, etliche sachen, &c. idque per omnes casus, ac sunt muliebris gen. vnd solches durch alle casus, vnd seynd Weiblichen Geschlechts.
units.tr: Alcuno, aliquis, someone, some one; likewise jemands, someone. It has alcuni in the plural, in the plural number the Latin aliqui and the Italian alcuni, meaning some, certain people, the ones; as alcuna, that is, aliqua, some, a woman; it has alcune in the plural, that is, aliquae, some or certain women, certain things, and so on. This holds through all the cases, and they are of the feminine gender.

units.la: Nomina vero Ognuno, Ciascuno, hoc est vnusquisque, omnis. Die Namen aber, jederman, jedweder, alles vnd jedes, idem ciascheduno, jedermänniglich. Item Niuno, Veruno, Nessuno, Nullo, hoc est nemo lat. Niemands, niemand, keiner, keines.
units.tr: But the nouns Ognuno and Ciascuno, that is, each one, everything; likewise ciascheduno, everybody. Likewise Niuno, Veruno, Nessuno, Nullo, that is, no one; nobody, none, no thing.

units.la: Carent numero multitudinis, die haben keinen numerum pluralem, qui pariter deest ijsdem, cum muliebris sunt generis, vt.
units.tr: They lack the plural number, which is likewise missing from them when they are of the feminine gender, as

units.la: Welches auch geschicht, wenn sie generis famin. seynd, als Ognuna, Ciascuna, Niuna, Veruna, Nessuna & Nulla.
units.tr: This also happens when they are of the feminine gender, as Ognuna, Ciascuna, Niuna, Veruna, Nessuna & Nulla.

units.la: Quanquam nomen nulla haud raro usurpatur, genere neutro & significat nihil. Wiewol der Namen nulla offt in genere neutro gebraucht wird, vnd heißt nichts.
units.tr: Although the noun nulla is often used in the neuter gender and means nothing.

units.la: Nulla posso leuar, inquit Poeta, nihil auferre queo. Ich kan nichts wegk nemmen, sagt der Poet.
units.tr: "Nulla posso levar," says the poet, "I can take nothing away."

units.la: Significat etiam nulla aliquid, Das nulla heißt auch etwas im Italienischen, als, Vuoi tu nulla, wil du etwas, vis ne aliquid.
units.tr: Nulla also means something in Italian, as, "Vuoi tu nulla," do you want something; do you want anything?

units.la: Postrema sciendum omnia haec nomina respuere articulum haud non dicimus.
units.tr: Lastly, it should be noted that all these nouns reject the article, as we say.

units.la: Endtlich ist zumerckẽ, daß alie dise Namen den Artickel nicht leiden können, dann man saget gar nicht, L' alcuno, L' ognuno, oder il Ciaschuno, il nessuno, sonder man sagt sie ohn den Articul, als alcuno, nessuno, ognuno, &c.
units.tr: Finally, it is to be noted that all these names cannot take the article, for one does not say at all L' alcuno, L' ognuno, or il Ciaschuno, il nessuno; rather one uses them without the article, as alcuno, nessuno, ognuno, etc.

units.la: DE PRONOMINE.
units.tr: ON THE PRONOUN.

units.la: Vom Pronomen oder Vornen Wort.
units.tr: Of the Pronoun, or Front Word.

units.la: PRonomen eam vocem appellamus, quae loco Nominis vsurpatur. Pronomen wird ein solches Wort genennt, daß an statt eines Nominis gebraucht wird. Cuiusmodi est quoque Pronomen apud Latinos, & Graecos. Gleich wie sich sonsten das Pronomen bey den Lateinern vnd Griechen verhelt.
units.tr: We call a pronoun that word which is used in place of a noun. A pronoun is a word that is used in place of a noun. This is also what the pronoun is among the Latins and the Greeks. Just as the pronoun behaves elsewhere among the Latins and Greeks.

units.la: Quare quaedam sunt, primitiua, quaedam derivatiua. Dahero seynd etliche Stamm Wörter, vnd etliche dauon herkommende oder hergeleitete Wörter, derivatiua.
units.tr: For this reason some pronouns are primitive, and some derivative. Hence there are some root words, and some words derived or drawn from them, derivative.

units.la: Habentque numeros, genera, & Personas, vt Latinorum, Graecorumq; Pronomina.
units.tr: And they have number, gender, and persons, as the pronouns of the Latins and Greeks do.

units.la: Vnd haben jhre Numeros Personen, vnd Geschlechte, gleich wie die Lateinischen vnd Griechischen Pronomina haben.
units.tr: And they have their numbers, persons and genders, just as the Latin and Greek pronouns have.

units.la: Sed quid habeant cum illis simile, quidve diuersum. Was aber sie mit denselben gleiches oder vngleiches haben, facile diligens Lector perspiciet, cum extractatione, qua de ijs jam instituitur, tum vero ex subiecto Typo.
units.tr: But what they have in common with those, or how they differ, the diligent reader will easily see, both from the discussion now being undertaken of them and especially from the attached Typus.

units.la: Kan der fleissige Leser, beydes auß disem, was jetzund von jhnen soll gehandelt werden; theils auß dem beygefügten Typo oder Täffelein, leichtlich ersehen.
units.tr: The diligent reader can easily see this both from what is now to be discussed about them and partly from the table or small chart attached.

units.la: Pronomina primitiua,
units.tr: Primitive Pronouns,

units.la: Ia, ego, ich, Tu, tu, se, sich, egli, er. Ei, e quello, colui, ille, is, er, der, derselbe. Ipse, ipfe, erselbest. Questo, costui, cotesto, cio, iste, istud, hic, hoc, dis, disser, solchs, solch. Noi, nos, wir. Voi, vos, jhr. Eglino, quelli, loro, coloro, illi, ij, sie, dieselben. Ipsi, ipsi, dieselben, selbsten. Questi, Costoro, disc, hi. Cotesti, isti, disc, solche.
units.tr: I, I, I; thou, thou; himself/herself, himself; he, he; that one, that man, that one, that, he, he, that, the same; himself, himself, himself; this, this man, that of yours, this, this, that, this, this, this, this, such, such; we, we, we; you, you, you (plural); they, those, they, those, they, they, they, the same; themselves, themselves, the same, themselves; these, these men, these, these; those of yours, those, these, such.

units.la: Pronomina primitiua Muliebria, wie folget, nemblich.
units.tr: Feminine primitive pronouns, as follows, namely.

units.la: Genus muliebre Num. sing. Ella, lei, quella, colei, Illa, ea, sie, diefelbige, Effa, ipsa, diefelb, felbefte, Questa, costei, hæc, die, dise Fraw, Cotesta, ista, solche, Num. plur. Mulieb. Elleno, elle, quelle, Illa, ea, sie, diefelben Frawen, Esse, ipsa, queste, coteste, ista, diese, dieselben Weiber,
units.tr: Feminine gender, singular: Ella, lei, quella, colei; she, her, that one, that woman; she, that, she, the same woman; herself, the very same; this, this woman, this one; the, this (fem.); this woman; Cotesta, that one, such (fem.). Plural, feminine: Elleno, elle, quelle; those, they, they, the same women; they themselves, these, those, those, these, the same women.

units.la: Pronomina Derivativa.
units.tr: Derivative pronouns.

units.la: Genus neutrum Num. singul. Mio, meus, mein, Tuo, tuus, dein, Suo, suus, sein, Nostro, noster, vnser, Vostro, vester, ewer, Num. plural. Miei, mei, meine, Tuoi, tui, deine, Suoi, sui, seine, Nostri, nostri, vnsere, Vostri, vestri, ewre,
units.tr: Masculine gender. Singular number: my (German mein), your (dein), his/her/its (sein), our (unser), your (ewer). Plural number: my (meine), your (deine), his/her/its (seine), our (unsere), your (ewre).

units.la: GeneMia, mea, meine, Tua, tua, deine, Sua, sua, seine, Noftra, noftra, vnfere, Voftra, veftra, ewere, Mie, mea, meine, Tue, tua, deine, Sue, sua, seine, Noftre, noftra, vnfere, Voftre, veftra, ewere.
units.tr: Feminine gender. Singular number: my (meine), your (deine), his/her/its (seine), our (unsere), your (ewere). Plural number: my (meine), your (deine), his/her/its (seine), our (unsere), your (ewere).

units.la: Prænomina ad utrumque genus pertinentia.
units.tr: Pronouns pertaining to both genders.

units.la: Io, ego, ich, Tu, tu, du, Coloro, illi, sie, dieselbe, Costoro, isti, sie, die, Loro, illi, sie, Se, sich.
units.tr: Io, ego, I; Tu, tu, thou (you); Coloro, illi, they (those); sie, dieselbe, Costoro, isti, they (these); sie, die, Loro, illi, they (them); Se, sich, himself/herself (oneself).

units.tr: Nominative singular Io, ego, I.

units.la: Genit, Di me, mei, meine. Dativ. A me, mihi, mir, Accuf. Me, me, mich. Abblat. Da me, a me, von mir, Nom. plur. Noi, nos, vns. Genitiv. di Noi, noftrum, vnser. Dativ. A noi, nobis, vns. Accufat. Noi, nos, vns. Ablativ. Da noi, a nobis, von vns.
units.tr: Genitive: Di me, mei, of me, mine. Dative. A me, mihi, to me. Accusative. Me, me, me. Ablative. Da me, a me, from me. Nominative plural Noi, nos, we. Genitive. di Noi, nostrum, of us, ours. Dative. A noi, nobis, to us. Accusative. Noi, nos, us. Ablative. Da noi, a nobis, from us.

units.la: Nom. sing. Tu, te, Du. Genit. Di te, tui, Dein. Dativ. A te, tibi, Dir. Accuf. Te, te, dich. Vocativ. Tu, tu, Du. Ablativ. Da Te, a te, Von dir. Nom. plur. Voi, vos, Ihr. Genit. Di voi, vestrum, Ewer. Dativ. A voi, vobis, Euch. Accuf. Voi, vos, Ihr. Vocat. Voi, vos, Ihr. Ablat. Da voi, vobis, Von euch.
units.tr: Nominative singular Tu, te, you. Genitive. Di te, tui, of you, yours. Dative. A te, tibi, to you. Accusative. Te, te, you. Vocative. Tu, tu, you. Ablative. Da Te, a te, from you. Nominative plural Voi, vos, you. Genitive. Di voi, vestrum, of you, yours. Dative. A voi, vobis, to you. Accusative. Voi, vos, you. Vocative. Voi, vos, you. Ablative. Da voi, vobis, from you.

units.la: Genit. Sing. & Plur. di se, sui, Seines. Dativ. A se, sibi, Ihme oder sich. Accuf. Se, se, Sich. Ablativ. Da se, a se, Von sich.
units.tr: Genitive, singular and plural, di se, sui, of himself, his own. Dative. A se, sibi, to him or to himself. Accusative. Se, se, himself. Ablative. Da se, a se, from himself.

units.tr: 4. Paradigm. The fourth table.

units.la: Nom. Sing. Egli, Ei, e, er, quello, colui, ių, ille, er oder derselbe.
units.tr: Nominative singular: he, he, he, that one, that man, that one, he or the same.

units.la: Genitiv. di lui, di colui, & di quello, eius, illius, deßselbigen, deßen.
units.tr: Genitive: of him, of that man, and of that one, of the same, whose.

units.la: Dativ. a lui, a colui, a quelo, ei, illi, jhme.
units.tr: Dative: a lui, a colui, a quelo, ei, illi, to him.

units.la: Accusativ. Lui, Colui, quello, eum, illum, denselben.
units.tr: Accusative: Lui, Colui, quello, eum, illum, the same.

units.la: Ablat. da lui, da colui, & a quello, ab eo, ab illo, von demselben.
units.tr: Ablative: from him, from that man, and from that one, from the same.

units.la: Nom. plur. Eglino, quelli, coloro, ij, illi, diesel ben.
units.tr: Nominative plural: Eglino, quelli, coloro, ij, illi, the same (plural).

units.la: Genitiv; di loro, di coloro, & di quelli, eorum, illorum, derselben oder derselbigen.
units.tr: Genitive: of them, of those, and of those ones, of the same (plural).

units.la: Dativ. a coloro, a loro, a quelli, eis, illis, denselben.
units.tr: Dative: to those, to them, and to those ones, to the same.

units.la: Accusativ. Loro, coloro, eos, illos, dieselben, dieselbigen.
units.tr: Accusative plural: Loro, coloro, eos, illos, the same (plural).

units.la: Ablativ. da loro, da coloro, da quelli, ab eis, illis, von denselbigen.
units.tr: Ablative: from them, from those, and from those ones, from the same.

units.la: 5. Paradig. Die fünffte Tafel.
units.tr: 5. Paradigm. The fifth table.

units.la: Nom. Sing. Ella, colei, quella, ea, illa, sie, dieselbe.
units.tr: Nom. sing.: she, that one, that one, she, that, she, the same.

units.la: Genitiv. di lei, di colei, di quella, eius, illius, derselbigen.
units.tr: Gen.: of her, of that one, of that one, of her, of that, of her, of the same.

units.la: Dativ. a lei, a Colei: a quella, ei, illi, jhr, jhro. Accus. Lei, Colei, quella, eam, illam, diefelbe. Ablat. da lei, da colei, da quella, ab ea, illa, von derselben.
units.tr: Dat.: to her, to that one, to that one, to her, to her, to her. Acc.: her, that one, that one, her, that, the same. Abl.: from her, from that one, from that one, from her, from that, from the same.

units.la: Nom. plur. Elleno, coloro, quelle, ea, illa, diefelben. Genit. di loro, di coloro, & di quelle, earum, illarum, deren felben, deren felbigen.
units.tr: Nom. pl.: they, those, those, they, those, the same. Gen.: of them, of those, and of those, of them, of those, of the same.

units.la: Dativ. a loro, a coloro, & a quelle, eis, illis, denenselben.
units.tr: Dat.: to them, to those, and to those, to them, to those, to the same.

units.la: Accus. loro, coloro, quelle, eas & illas, diefelbigen.
units.tr: Acc.: them, those, and those, them, those, the same.

units.la: Ablat. da loro, da coloro, da quelle donne, ab eis, illis Mulieb. von denen selben Weibern.
units.tr: Abl.: from them, from those, from those women, from them, from those, from the same women.

units.la: 6. Paradigma. Die sechste Vor- stell Taffel.
units.tr: 6. Paradigm. The sixth introductory table.

units.la: Nom. sing. Questo, Costui, hic, difer.
units.tr: Nominative singular: this (Italian questo, costui) [hic]; of this one, this one.

units.la: Dativ. a questo, a costui, huic, disem.
units.tr: Dative to questo, to costui, huic, disem.

units.la: Accus. questo, costui, hunc, difer.
units.tr: Accusative questo, costui, hunc, difer.

units.la: Ablat. da questo, da costui, ab hoc, von disem.
units.tr: Ablative: from this (da questo, da costui) [ab hoc]; from this one (von disem).

units.la: Nom. plural. Questi, Costoro, hi dise.
units.tr: Nominative plural: these (Questi, Costoro) [hi]; these people (dise).

units.la: Genit. di questi, di costoro, horum, difer.
units.tr: Genitive of questi, of costoro, horum, difer.

units.la: Dativ. a questi, a costoro, his, disen.
units.tr: Dative: to these (a questi, a costoro) [his]; to these people (disen).

units.la: Accus. questi, costoro, hos, dise.
units.tr: Accusative: these (questi, costoro) [hos]; these people (dise).

units.la: Ablat. da questi, da costoro, ab his, von disen.
units.tr: Ablative: from these (da questi, da costoro) [ab his]; from these people (von disen).
