units.tr: 7. Para-

units.la: Nom. sing. Questa, Costei, hæc, dise, dise, Fraw.
units.tr: Nominative singular: this (Italian Questa, Costei) [hæc]; this woman (dise, dise, Fraw).

units.la: Genit. di questa, di costei, huius, diser Frawen.
units.tr: Genitive: of this (f.), of this woman, huius, diser Frawen (of this woman).

units.la: Dativ. a questa, a costei, huic, diser.
units.tr: Dative to questa, to costei, huic, diser.

units.la: Accus. Questa, Costei, hanc, die, dise.
units.tr: Accusative: this (Questa, Costei) [hanc]; this woman (die, dise).

units.la: Ablat. da questa, da costei, ab hac, von diser.
units.tr: Ablative: from this (da questa, da costei) [ab hac]; from this woman (von diser).

units.la: Nom. plur. Queste, Costoro, hæ, dise Frawen.
units.tr: Nominative plural: these (Queste, Costoro) [hæ]; these women (dise Frawen).

units.la: Genit. di queste donne, o, di Costoro mogli, harum Mulier, diser Weiber.
units.tr: Genitive: of these (di queste donne, or, di costoro mogli) [harum]; of these women, of these wives (Mulier, diser Weiber).

units.la: Dativ. a queste, a costoro, his, disen.
units.tr: Dative: to these (a queste, a costoro) [his]; to these women (disen).

units.la: Accus. queste, costoro, has, dise.
units.tr: Accusative: these (queste, costoro) [has]; these women (dise).

units.la: Ablat. da queste, da costoro, ab his, von disen.
units.tr: Ablative: from these (da queste, da costoro) [ab his]; from these women (von disen).

units.la: Quod autem attinet ad catera pronomina, hoc est, derivativa. Was aber die andern pronomina angehet, das ist die derivatiua. Ea sequuntur prorsus declinationem eorum Nominum, quæ desinunt in O, si sunt generis viril, vel in A, si sunt generis Muliebr.
units.tr: As for the other pronouns, that is, the derivative ones: they follow exactly the declension of those nouns that end in O if they are of the masculine gender, or in A if they are of the feminine gender. (Was aber die andern pronomina angehet, das ist die derivatiua.)

units.la: So werden diefelbigen declinirt, wie die Wörter, so auff ein O. außgehen, vnd gen. Masc. seynd, oder auff ein A. vnd gen. fœm. seynd.
units.tr: They are declined in the same way as the words that end in an O and are masculine, or end in an A and are feminine.

units.la: Pronomen autem, cuiu, semper est sing. numeri & generis neutri.
units.tr: The pronoun cuiu, however, is always singular in number and neuter in gender.

units.la: Das Pronomen cuiu, aber ist allezeit sing. num. vnd generis neutri.
units.tr: The pronoun cuiu, however, is always singular in number and neuter in gender.

units.la: DE PRONOMINVM VSV.
units.tr: ON THE USE OF THE PRONOUNS.

units.la: Vom Gebrauch deren Vor-nenwörter.
units.tr: On the use of the pronouns.

units.la: Pronomine, Egli, ei, E' & Ella, semper recte dantur, ut, Die Pronomina, er, sie, werden allezeit zum Nominativo gesetzt, als, egli disse, is dixit, er hat gesagt, Ella volse, ea voluit, sie hat gewolt.
units.tr: The pronouns Egli, ei, E' and Ella are always correctly used: the pronouns "he" and "she" are always put in the nominative, as he said, she wished: he has said, she has wished.

units.la: Pronominum vero, Eglino & Elleno, quibus Oratores, vel qui soluta scribunt Oratione vtuntur. Desgleichen werden die Pronomina Eglino & Elleno, sie, dise, dieselben, so die Redner, oder die in einer freyen Redeschreiben gebrauchen. Idem penitus est vsus, ut recte dumtaxat seruiant, dicimus enim, Gleicher weise nur zu einem Nominativo gesetzt, dann wir sagen, Eglino differe, illi dixerunt, sie haben gesagt, Elleno volsera ille voluerunt, die haben gewolt.
units.tr: The pronouns Eglino and Elleno are used by orators, or by those who write in prose: likewise "they" and "these", "the same", are used by orators or by those who write in free prose. The usage is entirely the same, that they serve only as the nominative, for we say: likewise only as a nominative, for we say, they have said, they have said; they have wished, they have wished.

units.la: Rursus pronomina, Egli & e', quandoque sunt, explenda particulae.
units.tr: Again, the pronouns Egli and e' are sometimes mere filler words.

units.la: Hingegen widerumb seynd die pronomina Egli, vnd e bisweilen nur Füllwörtlein, Teutsch ac potius vsurpantur ornatus gratia, quam necessitatis, vnd werden mehr auß Zierde, als auß Nothwendigkeit gebraucht, als Egli non habuerit di sem.
units.tr: On the other hand, the pronouns Egli and e are sometimes only filler words in German, and are used for ornament rather than necessity, as he has not had.

units.la: di tempo, pro non hà guàri di tempo, non din est, Es ist nicht so gar lang, vor ist nicht lang. Item Eparra Menzogna, pro parra Menzogna, videbitur mendacium, es scheinet lügerlich, oder es bedunckt einen eine Lügen. Pronomina { Lui, Lei, Loro } dantur.
units.tr: it has not been long in time, instead of "he has not had long in time"; it is not long: it is not so very long; it is not long. Likewise "it seems a lie", instead of "it will seem a lie": it seems a lie, or it seems to someone a lie. The pronouns { Lui, Lei, Loro } are given.

units.la: Werden also gegeben.
units.tr: They are given as follows.

units.la: Genit. Ci siamo ricordati di Lui, Lei, Loro, Meminimus eius, eorum, earum, wir haben sich seiner, ihrer, erinnert.
units.tr: Genitive. We have remembered him, her, them: we have remembered him, her, them (of him, of her, of them).

units.la: Dativ. diffi a lui, lei, loro, dixi ei, eis. Ich hab jhme, jhr, jhnen, gesagt.
units.tr: Dative. I have said to him, to her, to them: I have said to him, to her, to them.

units.la: Accus. Vidi lui, lei, loro, vidi eum, eam, eos. Ich hab jhn, sie gesehen.
units.tr: Accusative. I have seen him, her, them: I have seen him, her.

units.la: Ablat. ho ricevuto cio da lui, lei, loro, accepi id ab eo, ea, is, ich hab dis von jhme, von jhr, von jhnen empfangen. Pronomina werden also gegeben, wie folgt. { Costui, Colui, Costei, Colei, Costoro, Coloro } dantur.
units.tr: Ablative. I have received this from him, from her, from them: I have received this from him, from her, from them. The pronouns are thus given, as follows: { Costui, Colui, Costei, Colei, Costoro, Coloro } are given.

units.la: Nom. Costui, Costei, Colui, Colei diffe, hic, hæc, ille, illa, dixit dieser, diese, derselbe, dieselbe, hat gesagt. Costoro, coloro differo, hi hæ, illi, illæ dixerunt, dieselben, sie, &c. haben gesagt.
units.tr: Nominative. This man, this woman, that man, that woman has said: this man, this woman, that man, that woman has said. These men, those men, they have said: these, they, etc. have said.

units.la: Genit. Mi ricordo di Coftui, di Coftei, di Colui, di Lei, di Costoro. Memini huius, illius, horum, harum, illorum, illarum. Ich erinnere mich deffen, oder difen, deffelben, jhrer, derfelben Männer vnd Weiber.
units.tr: Genitive. I remember this man, this woman, that man, her, these men. I remember this one, of that one, of these, of those, of them: I remember that of this man or woman, of that man or woman, of these men and women.

units.la: Dativ. Io diffi a coftui, a coftei, a colui, a colei, a coftoro, a coloro, dixi huic, illi, his, illis. Ich hab' gesagt zu jhm, zu jhr, zu demselben, zu derselben, zu jhnen.
units.tr: Dative. I have said to this man, this woman, that man, that woman, these men, those men: I have said to him, to her, to that man, to that woman, to them.

units.la: Accuf. Io amo coftui, coftei, colui, coftoro, coloro, Amo hunc, hanc, illum, illam, hos, has, illos, illas. Ich lieb jhn, sie, difen, dise, &c.
units.tr: Accusative. I love this man, this woman, that man, these men, those men: I love him, her, this one, that one, these, those.

units.la: Ablat. Io l' ho vdito da Coftui, da Coftei, da Colui, da Colei, da Costoro, da Coloro: Id audiui ab hoc, ab hac, ab illo, ab illa, ab his, ab illis. Ich habs gehört, von jhm, von jhr, von difem, von difer, von jhnen, von denselbigen, von derselben, &c.
units.tr: Ablative. I have heard it from this man, this woman, that man, that woman, these men, those men: I have heard it from him, from her, from this one, from that one, from them, etc.

units.la: Caterum Articuli Li, Gli, & Le, ponuntur non-nunquam pro pronominibus. Ferner werden die Articuli Li, Gli, vnd Le, bißweilen für Pronomina gesetzt, Lui & Lei idem, in Dativo tantum Casu, hoc modo.
units.tr: Further, the articles Li, Gli and Le are sometimes used in place of pronouns: Lui and Lei are the same, in the dative case only, in this way.

units.la: Lui vnd Lei, Er, sie, vnd zwar allein in dem Datiuo, folgender gestalt. Le di, vel dille, pro di a lei, dic ei, sage jhr, da gli, vel dalli, pro da a lui, da ei, gib jhme. Vbi aduertas animum articu-los gli Gli, & Le, qui multitud, numeri, sunt Nu-meri singularis.
units.tr: Lui and Lei, he, she, and indeed only in the dative, in the following form: Say to her, give to him. Here note that the articles Gli, Le, which are in the plural number, are here in the singular.

units.la: Wobey zumercken, daß die Artickel Gli, vnd Le, so sonst en plural. Num. seynd, allhier singularis werden.
units.tr: Here it should be noted that the articles Gli and Le, which are otherwise plural, here become singular.

units.la: Rursus articulo, Lo, la, le, gli, vsurpantur pro pronominibus, lui, lei, & loro.
units.tr: Again, the articles lo, la, le, gli are used in place of the pronouns lui, lei and loro.

units.la: Widerumb werden die Articul lo, la, gli, le, an statt der Fürnamen lui, lei, loro gebraucht: idque in Accusatiuo dumtaxat, sic; Aber dis allein im Accusatiuo, als lo batte, & batello, pro batte lui, batte quello, verberauit eum, hat jhne geschlagen, item la bacio, & baciolla, pro bacio lei, & bacio quella: Osculatus est illam, er hat sie geküßt oder geschmatzert, n. item gli percoffe, & percoffe gli, pro percoffe lora vel quelli, percuffit illos, er hat dieselben geschlagen, item le bacio & bascio-le, per bacio loro. Osculatus est illas, er hat dieselben geküßt, ein Bußmaul geben. L.
units.tr: Again, the articles lo, la, gli, le are used in place of the pronouns lui, lei, loro, and that only in the accusative, thus: But only in the accusative, as lo batte, & batello, for batte lui, batte quello, he has struck him; likewise la bacio, & baciolla, for bacio lei, & bacio quella: he has kissed her, he has kissed or smacked her; n. likewise gli percoffe, & percoffe gli, for percoffe loro or quelli: he has struck them, he has struck those men; likewise le bacio & bascio-le, for bacio loro: he has kissed them, he has kissed those women, given them a smacking kiss. L.

units.la: Pronomen se datur, wird also geben.
units.tr: The pronoun se is given thus.

units.la: Genit. Nefuno si dimentica di se. Nemo sui obliui-scitur, niemand vergiffet seiner.
units.tr: Genitive. Nobody forgets himself: nobody forgets himself (of himself).

units.la: Dativ. Catone diede a se la morte, Cato sibi mortem conscinit. Der Cato gibt jhme selbsten den Todt.
units.tr: Dative. Cato gave himself death: Cato gave himself death.

units.la: Accuf. Ciascuno ama più se, che, gli altri, quisque magis se, quam cateros amat. Ein jeder liebet sich, sehrer oder mehrer als andere.
units.tr: Accusative. Everyone loves himself more than others: everyone loves himself more, or more greatly, than others.

units.la: Ablat. Questo lodiffe da se, id ex se dixit. Dis sagte er von sich selbsten, vngezwungen.
units.tr: Ablative. He said this of himself: he said this of himself, unforced.

units.la: Sed hoc pronomen se,Das Pronomen se aber.
units.tr: But the pronoun se, however.

units.la: Conjungitur plerumque cum particulis ipse, sing. num. & gen. virilis, & ipsi, num. plur. ac generis eiusdem & ipsa, gen. mulieb. ac num. singul. & ipso, num. multitud. eiusdem generis.
units.tr: It is usually joined with the particles ipse (singular, genitive and masculine) and ipsi (plural, of the same gender), and ipsa (genitive, feminine, singular) and ipso (plural, of the same gender).

units.la: Wird gemeiniglich conjungirt, mit den particulis ipso, idque fit per omnes obliquos, excepto Vocativo, hoc modo, vnd geschicht solches durch alle obliquos casus, außgenommen den Vocativum, auff dise weise.
units.tr: It is usually combined with the particles ipso; this is done through all the oblique cases, except the vocative, in this way.

units.la: Di se ipso, sui ipsius, sein selbsten, di se ipsa, jhr selbsten, sua ipsius, di se ipsi, sui ipsorum, jhrer selbsten, di se ipsae, sui ipsarum, jhrer selbsten.
units.tr: Of himself, of himself; of herself; of themselves, of themselves; of themselves: of himself, of herself, of themselves.

units.la: Item a se ipso, sibi ipsi, sich selbsten, jhm selbsten, Rursus, se ipso, seipsum, sich selbst seipsae, se ipsi, sich selbsten, se ipsas & ipsos.
units.tr: Likewise from himself, to himself: to himself, to himself; again, himself; themselves, to themselves, themselves.

units.la: Demum, endtlich, da se ipso, a se ipso, von sich selbst, da se ipsa, a se ipsa, von jhr selbst, da se ipsi, a se ipsis, von jhnen selbsten.
units.tr: Finally, from himself, from himself: from himself; from herself; from themselves.

units.la: Idem penitus intelligatur de particulis, medesimo, medesima, medesimi, medesime, &c. Vnd dises ist gleicher gestalt von dem Stückwörtlein Medesimo zuverstehen.
units.tr: The same must be understood entirely of the particles medesimo, medesima, medesimi, medesime, etc. And this is to be understood in the same way of the little word Medesimo.

units.la: Conjungitur quoq; eadem particula cum omnibus aliis pronominibus, dicimus enim, Es wird auch eben dises Wörtlein mit allen andern fürnamen gesetzt, denn man saget, io ipso vel medesimo, ego ipse, ich selbsten, di me medesimo, me ipsius, mein selbsten.
units.tr: This same particle is also joined with all the other pronouns, for we say, The same little word is also placed with all the other pronouns, for one says: io ipso vel medesimo, ego ipse, I myself; di me medesimo, me ipsius, my own self.

units.la: Ac modo confimili, per omnes alios casus, Vocatiuo excepto, vnd so fort an, durch alle casus ohne den Vocativum.
units.tr: Ac modo confimili, per omnes alios casus, Vocatiuo excepto, and in the same manner through all the other cases, except the vocative.

units.la: In numero quidem plur. dicimus, In plurali fagt man zwar, noi fteffi, noi medefimi, nos ipfi, wir felbften, di noi fteffi vel medefimi, noftri ipforum, vnfer felbften, &c.
units.tr: In the plural we indeed say: we ourselves, we the same, ourselves: we ourselves; of ourselves, etc.

units.la: Idem tu fteffo, tu ipfe, du felbften, tu fteffa, tu ipfa, du Tochter felbften, idem io fteffa, ego ipfa, ich Fraw felbften, noi fteffe, nos ipfa, wir felbften, item di voi fteffe, vestri ipfarum, ewer felbften, egli fteffo, illo ipfe, er felbften, eben derfelbe, di lui fteffo, illius ipfius, eben deßfelbigen, Ella fteffa, illa ipfa, eben diefelbige, vnd felb felbfte, fie felbftea, di lei fteffa, der felb felbften, item jhr felbften, ( illius ipfius, ) eben deßfelben.
units.tr: Likewise you yourself, you yourself; you (daughter) yourself; likewise I (a woman) myself; we ourselves; likewise of you yourselves, of yourselves; he himself, very he himself; of him himself, of very him himself; she herself, very she herself; and of her herself, of herself; likewise of her herself, of very the same.

units.la: Eglino fteffi, illi ipfi, fie felbften, die felb felbften, di loro fteffi, der felb felbeften, item jhnen felbften, jhrer felbften, elleno fteffe, illa ipfa, fie felb felbften, eben diefelben.
units.tr: They themselves, the very same men; of themselves, of the very same men; to themselves, of themselves; they themselves, the very same women.

units.la: Sed quid tot exemplis moror, Aber was verweil ich mich mit fovil Exempeln.
units.tr: But why do I dwell on so many examples?

units.la: Cum harum particularum Societatem non folum omnia plane non recusent pronomina.
units.tr: Since not only do all pronouns refuse none of the company of these particles.

units.la: Da doch difer Wörter Gefellfchafft, nicht nur allein alle pronomina nicht verfchmähen.
units.tr: Since the company of these words does not reject all pronouns alone.

units.la: Verum etiam ne ipfa nomina, nam crebro ita loi quimur, Sondern auch die nomina felbften, denn man redet zum öfftern alfo.
units.tr: But also the nouns themselves, for people often speak in this way.

units.la: Il Re stesso, il Re medesimo, Rex ipse, der König selbsten, La Reina, stessa, vel medesima, die Köni- gin selbsten, idem i Cieli stessi vel medesimi, Cali ipsi, der Himmel selbsten, le stelle stesse, ouer me- desime, stella ipsa, die Sterne selbsten.
units.tr: The king himself, the same king, the king himself; the queen herself, or the same queen; the heavens themselves, or the same heavens; the stars themselves, or the same stars, the star itself, the stars themselves.

units.la: Neque illud censeo pratermittendum particu- lam. Difes acht ich mit stillschweigen auch nicht zuübergehen.
units.tr: I do not think this particle should be passed over in silence either.

units.la: Esso recipere in principio literam I. Daß das Wort esso oder Esso, von anfang ein I, zu sich neme, quando praceditur ab articulo, qui in voca- lem exit. Wenn ein Articul vorher gehet, so sich auffeinen Vocalen endet.
units.tr: That the word esso or Esso takes an I at the beginning: when it is preceded by an article that ends in a vowel.

units.la: Qui tamen articulus amittit suam vocalem, & Apostrophum suscipit. Welcher Articul jedoch seinen Vocalen verliert, vnd einen Apostro- phum zu sich nimmet. Prono- { Esso, Essa, } dantur. men. { Essi, Esse, }
units.tr: However, this article loses its vowel and takes an apostrophe. Pronouns are given: Esso, Essa, Essi, Esse.

units.la: Nomin. Esso vel Esso & Essa su, Essa disse, Esso, fece, Ipse vel ipsa fuit, dixit, fecit, derselbe oder dieselbe ist gewesen, hat gesagt, hat gemacht.
units.tr: Nominative. Esso vel Esso & Essa su, Essa disse, Esso, fece, Ipse vel ipsa fuit, dixit, fecit: the same man or the same woman has been, has said, has made.

units.la: Item Essi vel Esse furono, &c. ipsi vel ipsa fuerunt, &c. dieselbigen seynd gewesen.
units.tr: Likewise Essi or Esse furono, etc.; ipsi or ipsae fuerunt, etc. the same men have been.

units.la: Genitiv. Mi ricordero di esso vel d'essa, d'essi, d'esse, Meminero ipsius, ipsorum, ipsarum, Ich werde mich erinnern deßselbigen oder derofelbigen.
units.tr: Genitive. Mi ricordero di esso vel d'essa, d'essi, d'esse, I will remember of him or of her, of them (masc.), of them (fem.); I will remember of that same man or woman, of those same things.

units.la: Datv.
units.tr: Dative.

units.la: Dativ. Il diedi ad effo, dedi ipfi, Ich habs demfelben geben.
units.tr: Il diedi ad esso; dedi ipsi, I have given it to the same man.

units.la: Ablativ. L' ho vdito da effo, audiui ab ipfo, Ich habs von demfelben gehört.
units.tr: L'ho udito da esso; audivi ab ipso, I have heard it from the same man.

units.la: Quanquam haec omnia, excepto recto, melius per pronomina Lui, Lei, & loro explicarentur, wie- wol difealle, aufgenommen den rectum, oder Nominativum, besser durch die pronomina Lui, Lei vnd loro, aufgeredt würden.
units.tr: Although all of these, except the rectum, or nominative, would be better expressed through the pronouns Lui, Lei and loro.

units.la: Ita vt rectius ifto modo quis loqueretur, Also daß einer besser auff diese weise redete.
units.tr: So that one would speak more correctly in this manner.

units.la: Io mi ricordo di lui, & lei, e loro. Ich erinner mich deffelben, vnd derselben, vnd jhrer. Item L' ho dato a lui, a lei, a loro, Ich habs jhm geben, jhr geben, jhnen geben.
units.tr: Io mi ricordo di lui, e lei, e loro. I remember him, and her, and them. Item, l'ho dato a lui, a lei, a loro, I have given it to him, to her, to them.

units.la: Item ho veduto Lui e Lei, Ich hab jhn vnd sie gesehen.
units.tr: Item, ho veduto lui e lei, I have seen him and her.

units.la: Item L'ho riceuutto da lui, Ich habs von jhm empfangen.
units.tr: Item, l'ho ricevuto da lui, I have received it from him.

units.la: Conjunguntur praeterea eadem pronomina cum quibusdam nominibus per omnes casus, Vocatiuo excepto, quod ex subiecto Typo liquet.
units.tr: Moreover, these same pronouns are joined with certain nouns in all cases except the vocative, which is clear from the subject table.

units.la: Vber dis werden eben dise pronomina zu etlichen nominibus gesezt, durch alle casus, ausser dem Vocatiuo, wie auß nachfolgender Taffel zusehen.
units.tr: Moreover, these same pronouns are placed with certain nouns in all cases except the vocative, as can be seen from the following table.

units.la: Nom. Effo Rè dixit, ipse Rex dixit, der Königs selbst hats gesagt.
units.tr: Nom. Esso Re dixit; ipse Rex dixit, the king himself has said.

units.la: Genit. Vago di esse giouani, ipsarum puellarum cupidus, derselben jungen Mägdlein begierig.
units.tr: Genit. Vago di esse giovani; ipsarum puellarum cupidus, desirous of those very young girls.

units.la: Dativ. Diedi il libro ad essō Giudice, dedi librum ipsi Iudici, ich hab das Buch dem Richter selbsten geben.
units.tr: Dativ. Diedi il libro ad esso giudice; dedi librum ipsi iudici, I gave the book to the judge himself.

units.la: Accus. percosse essi nemici, ipsos hostes percussit, er hat die Feinde selbsten geschlagen.
units.tr: Accusative. Percosse essi nemici, he struck the enemies themselves; he has struck the enemies themselves.

units.la: Ablat. il riceuei da essi amici, von den Freunden selbsten hab ichs empfangen, ab ipsis amicis accepi.
units.tr: Ablat. Il ricevei da essi amici; ab ipsis amicis accepi, I received it from the friends themselves.

units.la: Postremo ita loquuntur Itali; Letstlichen reden die Italiäner also: con esso lui, con essa lei, con essi loro, pro con lui, con lei, con loro, cum illo, cum illa; cum illis, mit jhm, mit jhr, mit jhnen.
units.tr: Lastly, the Italians speak thus: con esso lui, con essa lei, con essi loro, for con lui, con lei, con loro, with him, with her, with them; cum illis; with him, with her, with them.

units.la: Dicunt etiam, sie sprechen auch, con esso le mani, manibus, mit den Händen, con esso vn colpo, vno ictu, in einem Streich. Sed huiusmodi, non paucis dicendi formulis Itali, ij praesertim, qui Hetruriam incolunt, delectantur. Aber dergleichen vnd nit wenig arthen zureden, gebrauchen die jenigen Italiäner zuförderst, welche in Toscania wohnen. Verum eas in vniuerfum vlurpari, nolim. Aber daß mans in gemein dahin brauchen solte, ist mein wille nicht.
units.tr: They also say con esso le mani (manibus), with the hands; con esso un colpo (vno ictu), in one stroke. But the Italians, especially those who live in Tuscany, delight in such and not a few other forms of speech. But I do not wish them to be used in general.

units.la: Pronomina autem, aber die pronomina, questi, quei, vel quegli, diese jene, oder die jenigen, olent plerumq; poni, locopronominum, werden gemeiniglich gesetzt an statt der pronominum, questo, quello, vel cofiui & colui, dißer, derselbig.
units.tr: But the pronouns questi, quei, or quegli, these, those, or those ones, are commonly used in place of the pronouns questo, quello, or colui and costui, this one, that one.

units.la: Idque in recto dumtaxat, ac per se quidem sine substantiui alicuius adjectione. Vnd dises einig vnd allein im Nominatiuo, auch für sich, ohne zusetzung einiges substantiui. Sed tamen referuntur semper ad virum aliquem. Doch aber ziehen sie sich allezeit auff ein Mannsbild, cuius mentio paulo superius facta fit, dessen meldung kurtz vorher geschehen. Quod exemplis aliquot liquido apperebit, welches auß etlichen Exempeln klärlich erscheinen wird. Dicimus enim, man sagt aber, Cicerone fu non solo Oratore Summo, ma anchora ottimo Cittadino, questi gioua molto alla sua Patria, Cicero fuit non solum Orator summus, sed etiam Ciuis optimus, hic valde sua profuit Patria. Cicero ist nit allein ein vornemer Redner, sondern anch ein fürtrefflicher Burger gewest, diser hat seinem Vatterlande sehr genützt. Item, quegli parlo, is est locutus, diser hat geredt. Et huiusmodi pene innumera apud Hetruscos Scriptores ptores reperies, vnd dergleichen vnzeliche mehr, findeft du bey den Tofcanifchen Scribenten.
units.tr: And this only in the nominative, and by itself, without any noun added. Yet they always refer back to some man whose mention was made shortly before, as will clearly appear from a few examples. For we say: Cicerone fu non solo oratore sommo, ma anche ottimo cittadino; questi giovò molto alla sua patria; Cicero fuit non solum orator summus, sed etiam civis optimus; hic valde suae profuit patriae, Cicero was not only a great orator but also an excellent citizen; this man greatly benefited his fatherland. Likewise quegli parlò, is est locutus, he has spoken. You will find countless similar examples among the Tuscan writers.

units.la: Verùm, (ut libere dicam quod sentio,) vix adducipossum, ut id probem.
units.tr: But, to speak freely what I think, I can hardly bring myself to approve it.

units.la: Aber daß ich nur kein Blat vor das Maul nemme, oder herauß sage, wir mirs vmbs Hertz ist, kan ich mich nicht bereden lassen, solches vnd dergleichen zubillichen.
units.tr: But, not to mince words or conceal what I really feel, I cannot persuade myself to approve such things and the like.

units.la: Videtur enim mihi esse genus dicendi nimis affectatum. Dann es bedünckt mich, als wäre eine solche arth zureden, von gar zu grosser, vnd vngebührlicher Begierd, oder Ehrsichtigkeit.
units.tr: For it seems to me that this manner of speaking is far too affected, the product of excessive and unseemly ambition.

units.la: Proinde questo & quello, cum generis sunt Viril, substantiuum Nomen requirunt.
units.tr: Therefore questo and quello, when they are masculine, require a substantive noun.

units.la: Derhalben questo vnd quello, wann sie generis Mascul. seynd, nemmen sie einen Substantiuum zu sich, als questo Rè, hic Rex, difer König, quello Principe, ille Princeps, derselbige Fürst. Cum vero usurpantur genere neutro, respuunt substantiuum Nomen, quare dicimus. Wann sie aber in genere neutro gebraucht werden, verwerffen sie das substantiuum, dann man sagt, questo che io dico è Cosi, hoc quod dico ita est. Diß, was ich sage, verhelt sich also. Item quello non è Cosi, illud non est ita. Difem ist nit also, oder dasselbig istnit also.
units.tr: Thus, when questo and quello are of the masculine gender, they take a substantive noun with them, as questo Re, hic Rex, this king; quello Principe, ille Princeps, that prince. But when they are used in the neuter gender, they reject the substantive noun, so we say: questo che io dico è così, hoc quod dico ita est, what I say is so. Likewise quello non è così, illud non est ita, that is not so.

units.la: De quibus pronominibus illud minime est ignorandum. Von welchen pronominibus dises nicht zuuergessen. Quod cum per Genitiv. plur. effe-runtur, primari solent à meris, (ut ita loquar,) Hetruscis praepositione DI, hoc modo. Daß wenn sie im Genitivo plurali werden außgesprochen, werden sie von den Tofcanern der praepositione DI, beraubet, der gestalt, A Casa di questi vsarai, zu dem Haufe discr Wucherer.
units.tr: Of these pronouns this must by no means be overlooked. Of these pronouns, this is not to be forgotten. When they are pronounced in the genitive plural, they are usually stripped, as it were, of the preposition DI by the Tuscans, in this way. That when they are pronounced in the genitive plural, the Tuscans strip them of the preposition DI, as in A Casa di questi vsarai, "to the house of these usurers."

units.la: De pronomine autem, cio, quod diximus supra, esse semper generis neutri.
units.tr: But concerning the pronoun cio, which we mentioned above, it is always of the neuter gender.

units.la: Aber von dem pronomine, cio, welches, wie oben gemelt, allzeit generis neutri ist. isti dicendi modi sumuntur, ut dicamus, cioè, id est, sopra cio, super hoc. Werden diese Arthen zureden genommen, daß wir sagen, cioè, das ist, sopra cio, super hoc, über dieß, oltre cio, prater hoc, cioche, quicquid, alles daß, dieß daß, Accioche, perciocche, auff daß, darumb daß, propterea quod, per cio propterea, derhalben, &c.
units.tr: But concerning the pronoun cio, which, as noted above, is always of the neuter gender: these modes of speaking are used, so that we say cioè, that is, sopra cio, super hoc, upon this; oltre cio, prater hoc, besides this; cioche, quicquid, everything that, this that; Accioche, perciocche, in order that, because; propterea quod, per cio propterea, for this reason, therefore; and so on.

units.la: Quantum vero spectat ad pronomen Cotesto, dieser, solcher, datur rebus & personis, quae extra pronunciata sunt, Wird solches von denen sachen vnd Personen gesagt, so außerhalb außgesprochen werden, quam ob rem dicimus ei, quo cum loquimur. Darumb sagen wir zu disem, mit deme wir reden: Cotesto libro, il quale tu hai nelle mani, e bello, iste liber quem habes in manibus, est pulcher. Dises Buch, so du in der Hand haft, ist schön. Vtimur hoc pronomine quoque in neutro genere, hoc modo.
units.tr: As far as the pronoun Cotesto is concerned, this, such, it is applied to things and persons which are spoken of outside the immediate company, that is, to things and persons that are not present with us. For which reason we say to the one with whom we are speaking: Cotesto libro, il quale tu hai nelle mani, e bello, iste liber quem habes in manibus, est pulcher. "This book, which you have in your hand, is beautiful."

units.la: Wir gebrauchen difes pronomen auch, in neutro genere, also, Cotesto che tu dici, è vero, iflud quod
units.tr: We also use this pronoun in the neuter gender, thus: Cotesto che tu dici, è vero, iflud quod

units.la: quod dicis, verum est, dises so du sagest, ist war. Videretur tandem non nihil dici opportere de particulis ci & ne.
units.tr: What you say is true, this that you say is true. It seems that something should at last be said about the particles ci and ne.

units.la: Auch scheinet notwendig, daß man etwas sagen solte, von den Stückwörtern ci & ne, quae pro noi, mi, quae pro me, vi, quae pro voi, & ti, quae pro te vsurpantur.
units.tr: It also seems necessary to say something about the particles ci and ne, which are used for noi, mi (for me), vi (for voi), and ti (for te).

units.la: Welche für Noi, mi, welches für me, vi, welches für voi, vnd ti, so für T., gebraucht werden.
units.tr: These stand for noi, mi (for me), vi (for voi), and ti (for te).

units.la: Sed quoniam verbis sunt plerumque affixa. Aber weil sie gemeinglich den verbis angehefft seynd.
units.tr: But since they are for the most part attached to verbs. But since they are for the most part attached to verbs,

units.la: Vt in Lingua Hebraeorum, saepe contingit, ideo in eum locum reijcientur, wie in der Hebraischen Sprache offt geschicht, als soll es an denselbigen Orth verschoben werden.
units.tr: As often happens in the Hebrew language, they will therefore be deferred to that place. as often happens in Hebrew, they will be put off to that place.

units.la: Vbi de ipsis verbis tractauerimus, da man von verbis handlet.
units.tr: When we treat of the verbs themselves. When we treat of the verbs themselves.

units.la: Conjugationes verborum sunt quatuor, & cognoscuntur praecipuè ex modis infinitivis.
units.tr: There are four conjugations of verbs, and they are recognised chiefly from the infinitive mood.

units.la: Die Conjugationes oder Zeitwandlungswörter, seynd vier. vnnd werden vornemlich auß dem Infinitiuo erkennet.
units.tr: The conjugations, or the inflection-patterns of verbs, are four. They are recognised chiefly from the Infinitive mood.

units.la: Nam prima conjugatio est eorum verborum, quae in penultima syllaba praesentis temporis infinitiui modi, modi, habent A longum, vt Amare, Cantare, man-giare. Dann die erste conjugatio ist in denen Wörtern, welche in der letzten Sylben ohne eine, im præsenti infinitivi modi, ein langes A, haben, als Amare, Cantare, Mangiare, lieben, singen, essen.
units.tr: For the first conjugation is of those verbs which, in the penultimate syllable of the present tense of the infinitive mood, have a long A, as Amare, Cantare, Mangiare. For the first conjugation is that of the words which, in the penultimate syllable of the present infinitive, have a long A, as Amare, Cantare, Mangiare: to love, to sing, to eat.

units.la: Secunda est eorum, qua habent E, longum. Die andere deren ist die, so ein langE, haben, als Valere, Havere, Tenere, gelten, wolstehen, haben, halten.
units.tr: The second is of those which have a long E. The second is that of those which have a long E, as Valere, Havere, Tenere: to be worth, to be well, to have, to hold.

units.la: Tertia eorum, qua habent E, breve, vt. Die dritte derselben ist, welche ein kurtz E, haben, als Leggere, Scribere, Vivere, Ridere, &c. Lesen, schreiben, leben, lachen.
units.tr: The third of those which have a short E, as. The third is that of those which have a short E, as Leggere, Scribere, Vivere, Ridere, &c.: to read, to write, to live, to laugh.

units.la: Quarta denique eorum est, qua habent I, longum. Endtlich die vierdte derer, so ein lang I, haben, als Morire, Finire, Vdire, Sterben, endigen, hören.
units.tr: Lastly, the fourth of those which have a long I. Lastly, the fourth, of those which have a long I, as Morire, Finire, Vdire: to die, to end, to hear.

units.la: Quod autem ad numeros, personas, tempora & modos attinet, nihil prorsus à Latinis discrepant.
units.tr: As for numbers, persons, tenses and moods, they differ in no way at all from the Latin.

units.la: Was aber die numeros, Personen, Zeit, und modos betrifft, so weichen sie gantz nichts vom dem Lateinischen ab.
units.tr: As for the numbers, persons, tense and moods, they do not differ in any way at all from the Latin.

units.la: DE VERBORVM DE-CLINATIONE.
units.tr: ON THE DECLENSION OF VERBS.

units.la: Von declinirung oder Abvvand-lung der Wörter. Declinatio verbi actiui, primæ Conjugationis, Modus indicativ.
units.tr: Of the declension or inflection of words. Declension of the active verb, first conjugation, indicative mood.

units.la: Tempus Præsens.
units.tr: Present tense.

units.la: Io amo, ich lieb, ego amo.Tu amas, tu amas, du liebest.Colui ama, ille amat, er liebet.Noi amiamo, nos amamus, wir lieben.Voi amate, vos amatis, jhr liebet.Coloro amano, illi amant, sie lieben.
units.tr: I love, I love, I love. You love, you love, thou lovest. He loves, he loves, he loves. We love, we love, we love. You love, you love, ye love. They love, they love, they love.

units.la: Præteritum imperfectum.
units.tr: Imperfect tense.

units.la: Io amana, ego amabam, ich liebete.Tu amaui, tu amabas, du liebetest.Colui amana, ille amabat, er liebete.Noi amauamo, nos amabamus, wir liebeten.Voi amauate, vos amabatis, jhr liebetet.Coloro amauano, illi amabant, sie liebeten.
units.tr: I was loving, I was loving, I loved. You loved, you were loving, thou lovedst. He was loving, he was loving, he loved. We were loving, we were loving, we loved. You were loving, you were loving, ye loved. They were loving, they were loving, they loved.

units.la: Præteritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect tense.

units.la: Io amai, ego amaui, ich hab geliebt.Tu amasti, tu amauisti, du hast geliebt.Colui amò, ille amauit, er hat geliebt.
units.tr: I have loved, I have loved, I have loved. Thou hast loved, thou hast loved, thou hast loved. He has loved, he has loved, he has loved.

units.la: Noi ammamo, nos amamus, wir haben geliebt.
units.tr: We have loved, we have loved, we have loved.

units.la: Voi amaste, vos amauistis, jhr habt geliebt.
units.tr: You have loved, you have loved, ye have loved.

units.la: Coloro amarono, & amaron, illi amauerunt, vel & auff gemeine weise. Io ho, tu hai, amato. Colui ha,
units.tr: They have loved, and they loved, they have loved, or and in the common manner. I have, thou hast, loved. He has,

units.la: Lat. idem amani, amauisti. Noi habbiamo, Voi hauete, amato. Coloro hanno,
units.tr: Lat. the same: loved, thou hast loved. We have, you have, loved. They have,

units.la: Præterito Plusquamperfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect tense.

units.la: Io haueua, tu haueui, colui haueua, amato, hatte geliebt.
units.tr: I had, thou hadst, he had, loved, had loved.

units.la: Noi haueuamo, voi haueuate, Coloro haueano, amato, wir hatten, jhr hattet, sie hatten geliebt.
units.tr: We had, you had, they had, loved, we had, ye had, they had loved.

units.la: Ego amaueram, tu amaueras, ille amauerat, er hatte geliebt.
units.tr: I had loved, thou hadst loved, he had loved, he had loved.

units.la: Nos amaueramus, vos amaueratis, illi amauerunt, sie hatten geliebt.
units.tr: We had loved, ye had loved, they had loved, they had loved.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future.

units.la: Io amerò, ego amabo, ich werde lieben.
units.tr: I shall love, I will love, I shall love.

units.la: Tu amerai, tu amabis, du wirst lieben.
units.tr: Thou wilt love, thou wilt love, thou wilt love.

units.la: Colui amerà, ille amabit, er wird lieben.
units.tr: He will love, he will love, he will love.

units.la: Noi ameremo, nos amabimus, wir werden lieben.
units.tr: We shall love, we shall love, we shall love.

units.la: Voi amarete, vos amabitis, jhr werdet lieben.
units.tr: Ye will love, you will love, ye will love.

units.la: Coloro ameranno & amarauno, sie werden lieben.
units.tr: They will love, and they will love, they will love.

units.la: Imperativus Tempus præsens.
units.tr: Imperative, present tense.

units.la: Ama tu, ama tu, liebe du. Ami colui, amet ille, liebe er. Amamo noi, amemus nos, lieben wir. Amate voi, amate vos, libet jhr. Amino Coloro, ament illi, lieben sie.
units.tr: Love thou, love thou, love thou. Let him love, let him love, let him love. Let us love, let us love, let us love. Love ye, love ye, love ye. Let them love, let them love, let them love.

units.la: Futurum Imperat.
units.tr: Future imperative.

units.la: Amera tu, amato tu, du solt lieben. Amerà colui, amato ille, er soll lieben. Ameremo noi, amemus nos, wir sollen lieben. Amarete voi, amatote vos, jhr sollet lieben. Ameranno coloro, amanto illi, sie sollen lieben.
units.tr: Thou shalt love, thou shalt love, thou shalt love. He shall love, he shall love, he shall love. We shall love, we shall love, we shall love. Ye shall love, ye shall love, ye shall love. They shall love, they shall love, they shall love.

units.la: Optatiuo modo temp.fut. & præsent.
units.tr: Optative mood, future and present tense.

units.la: subjunct. O Dio voglia, vel Dio voglia, vel O che, O Dio che, daß Gott wolt, O daß Gott wolt, O Gott daß, Io ami, ego amem, ich liebete. Tu ami, colui ami, tu ames, ille amet, daß du liebetest, daß er liebete. Noi amiamo, nos amemus, daß wir liebeten. Voi amiate, vos ametis, daß jhr liebetet. Coloro amino, illi ament, daß sie liebeten.
units.tr: Subjunctive: O God grant, or God grant, or O that, O God that, that God would, O that God would, O God that, I may love, that I might love, that I might love. You may love, he may love, that you might love, that he might love. We love, that we might love. You love, that you might love. They love, that they might love.

units.la: Præteritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect past tense.

units.la: O Dio volesse, O Dio che, O che, vtinam, io amassi, ego amarem, O wolte Gott daß ich solt lieben. O che tu amassi, vtinam tu amares, O daß du solt̄est lieben. Colui amasse, ille amaret, daß er solt lieben.
units.tr: O God would that, O God that, O that, vtinam, I loved, I might love, O that I should love. O that you loved, vtinam you might love, O that you should love. He loved, he might love, that he should love.

units.la: Noi amassimo, nos amaremus, daß wir solten lieben.
units.tr: We loved, we might love, that we should love.

units.la: Voi amaste, vos ameretis, daß jhr soltet lieben. coloro amassero, illi amarent, daß sie solten lieben.
units.tr: You loved, you might love, that you should love. They loved, they might love, that they should love.

units.la: Item Tempus aliter declinatum, auffein andere arth zu decliniren, da nemblich die obstehenden Aduerbia nicht darzu gebraucht werden, als nur
units.tr: Likewise the tense is declined otherwise, in another way of declining, where the adverbs mentioned above are not used, but only:

units.la: Oche io amarei, & ameria, cum ego amarem, daß ich liebete, ey daß ich liebete.
units.tr: Oh that I loved, and I would love, cum ego amarem, that I loved, oh that I loved.

units.la: Tu amaresti, tu amares, daß du liebetest.
units.tr: You loved, you might love, that you loved.

units.la: Colui amarebbe, & amaria, ille amaret, daß er liebete.
units.tr: He would love, and he would love, ille amaret, that he loved.

units.la: Noi amaremmo, nos amaremus, daß wir liebeten.
units.tr: We would love, nos amaremus, that we loved.

units.la: Voi amareste, vos amaretis, daß jhr liebetet.
units.tr: You would love, vos amaretis, that you loved.

units.la: Coloro amarebbono & amariano, illi amarent, daß sie liebeten.
units.tr: They would love and they would love, illi amarent, that they loved.

units.la: Prateritum Perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect past tense.

units.la: Auengache, O conciosia che, O che, Obwol ich, wiewol daß ich, du, er, wir, jhr, sie, hab, hast, hat, habet, haben geliebt. Io habbia, cum ego amauerim, Tu habbia, tu amaueris, Colui habbia, amato ille amauerit, Noi habbiamo, nos amauerimus, Voi habbiate, vos amaueritis, Coloro habbiano, illi amauerint.
units.tr: Although, since, or that, although I, you, he, we, you, they, have, hast, has, have loved. I may have, cum ego amauerim. You may have, tu amaueris. He may have, ille amauerit. We may have, nos amauerimus. You may have, vos amaueritis. They may have, illi amauerint.

units.la: O Dio volesse, O Dio che, O che, Vtinam, io hau uessi, tu hauessi, colui hauesse,
units.tr: O God would that, O God that, O that, Vtinam, I might have, you might have, he might have,

units.la: Noi hauessimo, Voi hauesse, Coloro hauessero, } amato.
units.tr: We might have, you might have, they might have, } loved.

units.la: O ego amauissem, daß ich solt haben geliebt. Tu amauisses, daß du solt est haben geliebt. Ille amauisset, er solt haben geliebt.
units.tr: O ego amauissem, that I should have loved. Tu amauisses, that you should have loved. Ille amauisset, he should have loved.

units.la: Nos amauissemus, daß wir solten haben geliebt. Vos amauissetis, daß jhr soltet haben geliebt. Illi amauissent, daß sie solten haben geliebt.
units.tr: Nos amauissemus, that we should have loved. Vos amauissetis, that you should have loved. Illi amauissent, that they should have loved.

units.la: Item dises Tempus auch also,
units.tr: Likewise, this tense also in this way:

units.la: Che io hauerei, Tu hauerest i, Colui hauerebbe, Noi haueremo, Voi hauereste, Coloro hauerebbono, das Lateinisch ist wie obstehet. amato.
units.tr: That I would have, you would have, he would have, we would have, you would have, they would have, as the Latin stands above. loved.

units.la: Daß ich hätte, du hättest, er hätte, wir hätten, jhr hättet, sie hätten geliebt.
units.tr: That I would have, you would have, he would have, we would have, you would have, they would have loved.

units.la: Quod autem ad modum subjunctiuum attinet, Was aber den subjunctivum anbelangt, a modo optandi nulla in re, praeter duas discrepat, ist derselbe vom Optatiuo mehr nicht, als in zweyen Stucken vnderschiden.
units.tr: As for the subjunctive mood, as for the subjunctive, it differs from the optative mood in no respect except two, it is the same as the optative, differing in two points only.

units.la: Quarum vna est, quod loco Adverbiorum, O Dio vogia, Q che, &c, habet adverbia, Conciosia, cosa che, che, auenga che, quando; & huiusmodi, Vnder welchen das erste ist, daß an statt der adverbio-rum, Dio voglia vnd O che, &c. dise adverbia vorgesetzt werden.
units.tr: The first of these is that, in place of the adverbs, O Dio voglia, O che, &c., it has the adverbs: since, although, that, when, and such like. The first is that in place of the adverbs, O God grant and O that, etc., these adverbs are set before it.

units.la: Conciosio, siacosa che, Auengache, vnd quando sintemahl daß ich, Obwol daß ich, item, wann ich werde haben geliebt, vnd auff weise vnd art, wie balden folgen wird.
units.tr: Since, although, although, and when, since I, although I, likewise, when I shall have loved, and in the manner and way that will follow shortly.

units.la: Altera est, quod explicare per se habet futurum quod ita inflectitur.
units.tr: The other is that it can by itself express the future tense, which is inflected thus.

units.la: Zum andern, daß er den futurum kan geben für sich, welches also gehet. [Io hauero, ] ꝛ Cum ego amauero, tu hauaraɩ, tu amaueris, colui hauerà, ille amauerit, Noi hauueremo, nos amauerimus, Voi hauerete, vos amaueritis, Coloro haueranno, illi amauerint.
units.tr: Second, that it can give the future tense by itself, which goes thus: [I shall have]. When I shall have loved, you will have, you will have loved, he will have, he will have loved, we shall have, we shall have loved, you shall have, you shall have loved, they will have, they will have loved.

units.la: Wenn ich werd, du wirst, er wird, wir werden, jhr werdet, sie werden haben geliebt.
units.tr: When I shall, you will, he will, we shall, you shall, they shall have loved.

units.la: Modus infinitivus temp. præs. Amare, lieben, das Præteritum, Hauere amato, geliebt haben lat. amauisse.
units.tr: The infinitive mood, present tense, Amare, to love; the perfect, Hauere amato, to have loved, Latin amauisse.

units.la: Futurum, douere amare, sollen lieben, esser per amare, amaturum esse, lat. geliebet seyn, hauere ad amare, zulieben haben.
units.tr: Future: to be to love, shall love; to be about to love, in Latin, to be loved; to have to love, to have to love.

units.la: Participium, Amante, amanti, lat. amans, amantes, Liebend, lieb habend, der vnd die liebenden.
units.tr: Participle, Amante, amanti, Latin amans, amantes, loving, having affection for, he who and they who love.

units.la: Gerundium, ist.
units.tr: Gerund, that is.

units.la: Præsens: Amando io, amando tu, amando colui, noi, voi, coloro, cum amem, cum ames, amet, amemus, ametis, ament, vel amarem, amares, amaret, amaremus, amaretis, amarent.
units.tr: Present: Amando io (loving I), amando tu (loving you), amando colui (loving he), noi (we), voi (you), coloro (they), when I may love, when you may love, when he may love, when we may love, when you may love, when they may love, or when I might love, you might love, he might love, we might love, you might love, they might love.

units.la: Dieweil ich lieb, du liebeft, dieweil er liebt, wir lieben, jhr liebetet, sie liebeten.
units.tr: Since I love, you love, since he loves, we love, you loved, they loved.

units.la: Præterit. Hauend'amato io, tu, colui, noi, voi & coloro, Nachdem ich, du, er, wir, jhr, sie haben geliebt, cum amauerim, ris, rit, rimus, ritis, erint, &c. vel amauissem, visses, visset, vissemus, vissetis, vissent.
units.tr: Past: Hauend'amato io (having loved I), tu (you), colui (he), noi (we), voi (you) & coloro (they), after I, you, he, we, you, they have loved, when I have loved, you have loved, he has loved, we have loved, you have loved, they have loved, etc., or when I had loved, you had loved, he had loved, we had loved, you had loved, they had loved.

units.la: Gerundij Futurum.
units.tr: Future of the Gerund.

units.la: Douendo amare, daß ich soll lieben, muß lieben, Effendo per amare, zulieben seyn, hauendo ad amare, io, tu, colui, noi, voi, coloro, weil sie zulieben haben, Lat. cum sim, sis, sit amaturus vel amatura, simus, sitis, sint amaturi vel amatura, weil sie oder nach dem sie zulieben seyn.
units.tr: Douendo amare (having to love), that I shall love or must love, Effendo per amare (being for loving), to be about to love, hauendo ad amare, io (I), tu (you), colui (he), noi (we), voi (you), coloro (they), since they have to love, Latin: cum sim, sis, sit amaturus vel amatura, simus, sitis, sint amaturi vel amatura, since they are about to love, or after they are about to love.

units.la: Declinatio verbi substantiui.
units.tr: Declension of the substantive verb.

units.la: Quoniam autem Lingua Italica verbo passiuo caret, Dieweil aber die Welsche Sprach keine verba passiua hat.
units.tr: Since, however, the Italian language has no passive verb.

units.la: Sed eius loco vsurpat verbum sum, es, est, cum participio passiuo, Sondern an derer statt, das Verbum sum, es, est, ich bin, du bist, er ist, mit dem participio passiuo gebraucht.
units.tr: But in its place it uses the verb sum, es, est, with the passive participle, but in its place the verb sum, es, est, I am, you are, he is, is used with the passive participle.

units.la: Ideo fubstantiui verbi declinationem hic ponere Operæpretium esse censeo, Als sihet mich vor gut vnd nutzlich an, hier zuweisen, wie solches Verbum conjugiret werde.
units.tr: I therefore think it useful and worthwhile to set out here how this substantive verb is conjugated.

units.la: Indicatiuo modo temp. praef.
units.tr: Indicative mood, present tense.

units.la: Io sono, ego sum, ich bin. Tu sei, tu es, du bist. Colui e, ille est, er ist. Noi siamo, nos sumus, wir seyn. Voi siete, sete, vos estis, jhr seydt. Coloro sono, illi sunt, sie seyn.
units.tr: I am, I am, I am. You are, you are, you are. He is, he is, he is. We are, we are, we are. You are, you are, you are, ye are. They are, they are, they are.

units.la: Prateritum imperfectum.
units.tr: Imperfect past.

units.la: Io era, ego eram, ich war. Tu eri, tu eras, du warest. Colui era, ille erat, er war. Noi eramo, nos eramus, wir waren. Voi eranate, vos eratis, jhr waret. Coloro erano, illi erant, sie waren.
units.tr: I was, I was, I was. You were, you were, thou wast. He was, he was, he was. We were, we were, we were. You were, you were, ye were. They were, they were, they were.

units.la: Prateritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect past.

units.la: Io fui, ego fui, ich bin gewesen. Tu fofti, tu fuisti, du bist gewesen. Colui fu, ille fuit, er ist gewesen. Noi fumo, nos fuimus, wir seynd gewesen. Voi fofte, vos fuistis, jhr seyd gewesen. Coloro furono, & furon, illi fuerunt, sie seynd gewesen.
units.tr: I have been, I have been, I have been. Thou hast been, thou hast been, thou hast been. He has been, he has been, he has been. We have been, we have been, we have been. Ye have been, ye have been, ye have been. They have been, they have been, they have been, they have been.

units.la: Idem hoc modo, das Lateinisch ist gleich.
units.tr: The same in this way, the Latin is the same.

units.la: Io fono, tu fei, colui e, noi siamo, voi siete, coloro fonostato, Ich bin, &c. sie seyn gewesen, &c. vide obstehend teutsch.
units.tr: I have been, you have been, he has been, we have been, you have been, they have been, I have been, etc.; they have been, etc. See the German above.

units.la: Praeterit. plusquamperfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect past.

units.la: Io era, ego fueram, ich war, stato, Tu eri, tu fueras, du warest, gewesen. Colui era, ille fuerat, er war, Noi eravamo, nos fueramus, wir waren gewesen,
units.tr: I had been, I had been, I had been; been, thou hadst been, thou hadst been, thou hadst been; been. He had been, he had been, he had been; we had been, we had been, we had been,

units.la: Voi eravate, coloro erano stato, jhr waret, sie waren gewesen. vos fueratis, illi fuerant.
units.tr: ye had been, they had been been, ye had been, they had been. Ye had been, they had been.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future.

units.la: Io sarò, ouer io sia, ego ero, ich werde seyn.
units.tr: I shall be, or I may be, I shall be, I shall be.

units.la: Tu sarai, tu eris, du wirst seyn.
units.tr: Thou shalt be, thou shalt be, thou shalt be.

units.la: Colui sarà, colui sia, & sie, idem ille erit, er wird seyn.
units.tr: He shall be, he may be, and he shall be, he will be, he shall be.

units.la: Noi saremo, nos erimus, wir werden seyn.
units.tr: We shall be, we shall be, we shall be.

units.la: Voi sarete, vos eritis, jhr werdet seyn.
units.tr: Ye shall be, ye shall be, ye shall be.

units.la: Coloro saranno, & siano, illi erunt, sie werden seyn.
units.tr: They shall be, and they may be, they shall be, they shall be.

units.la: Imperativo modo. temp. praes.
units.tr: Imperative mood, present tense.

units.la: Si i, sia, sie, tu, sis vel es tu, sey, oder sey du.
units.tr: Be, let me be, be thou, thou, be thou, or be thou, be, or be thou.

units.la: Sia vel sie, colui, sit ille, sey er.
units.tr: Let him be, he, let him be, let him be.

units.la: Siamo noi, simus nos, seyen wir.
units.tr: Let us be, let us be, let us be.

units.la: Siate voi, este vos, seyd jhr.
units.tr: Be ye, be ye, be ye.

units.la: Siano coloro, sint illi, seyen sie.
units.tr: Let them be, let them be, let them be.

units.la: Futurum Imperativ.
units.tr: Future imperative.

units.la: Sarai tu, esto tu, du folst seyn.
units.tr: Thou shalt be, be thou, thou shalt be.

units.la: Sara colui, esto ille, er soll seyn.
units.tr: He shall be, be he, he shall be.

units.la: Saremo noi, sumus nos, wir sollen seyn.
units.tr: We shall be, let us be, we shall be.

units.la: Sarete voi, estote vos, jhr sollet seyn.
units.tr: Ye shall be, be ye, ye shall be.

units.la: Saranno Coloro, sunto illi, sie sollen seyn.
units.tr: They shall be, let them be, they shall be.

units.la: Optatiuo modo, temp. futur. & praesent. subjunct.
units.tr: Optative mood, future and present subjunctive.

units.la: O Dio voglia, Dio voglia, O Dio che, O che, wolte Gott, O wolte Gott, O daß ich.
units.tr: O God wills, God wills, O God that, O that, would God, O would God, O that I.

units.la: Ch'io sia, che tu sij, che tu sia, & sie, daß du seyest, oder seyst. idem, daß ich sey.
units.tr: That I may be, that thou mayest be, that thou mayest be, and they may be, that thou mayest be, or art; likewise, that I may be.

units.la: Vtinam ego sim, tu sis.
units.tr: Would that I may be, that thou mayest be.

units.la: Che colui sia, ille sit, daß er sey.
units.tr: That he may be, that he may be.

units.la: Che noi siamo, nos simus, daß wir seyn, Voi siate, vos sitis, daß jhr seyd.
units.tr: That we may be, that we may be, that we may be; that you may be, that you may be, that ye may be.

units.la: Coloro siano, velsieno, illi sint, daß sie seyn, oder seyen.
units.tr: They may be, or they may be, that they may be, that they may be, or be.

units.la: Praeteritum imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past.

units.la: O Dio volesse, Dio volesse, O. Che io fossi & fussi, wolte Gott daß ich wär, vtinam ego essem, Che tu fossi & fussi, tu esses, du wärest.
units.tr: O God would, God would, O. That I might be or be, would to God I were, would that I might be, that thou mightest be, thou mightest be, thou wouldst be.

units.la: Che noi fossimo velfussimo, nos essemus, daß wir waren.
units.tr: That we might be or be, we might be, that we were.

units.la: Che voi foste, & fuste, vos essetis, daß jhr wäret.
units.tr: That ye might be, and ye might be, ye might be, that ye were.

units.la: Coloro fossero & fussero, illi essent, daß sie wären.
units.tr: They might be and they might be, they might be, that they were.

units.la: Idem Tempus aliter, auff andere weise, das Lateinisch ist einerley.
units.tr: The same tense differently, in another manner; the Latin is the same.

units.la: O che io farei & faria, O daß ich wäre, oder seyn wurde.
units.tr: O that I might be and I would be, O that I were, or would be.

units.la: Che tu faresti, colui farebbe & faria, daß du wärest oder seyn wurdest, daß er wäre, &c.
units.tr: That thou wouldst be and wouldst be, that he would be, and so on, that thou wouldst be, or wouldst be; that he were, etc.

units.la: Che noi faremmo, daß wir wären, oder seyn wurden.
units.tr: That we would be, that we were, or would be.

units.la: Che voi fareste, daß jhr wäret.
units.tr: That ye would be, that ye were.

units.la: Coloro farebbono & fariano, sie wären.
units.tr: They would be and would be, they were.

units.la: Præterit. Imperfectum.
units.tr: Preterite. Imperfect.

units.la: O Dio voglia, che io fia, tu sij, colui sia stato, wolte Gott daß ich, du, er, gewefen sey, vtinam cum ego fuerim, tu fueris, ille fuerit.
units.tr: Oh God grant that I might be, that you might be, that he might have been; would to God that I, you, he, had been; would that I might have been, you might have been, he might have been.

units.la: Che noi siamo, voi siate, coloro siano stati, daß wir, jhr, sie, gewefen seyn. Cum nos fuerimus, vos fueritis, illi fuerint.
units.tr: That we might be, you might be, they might have been; that we, you, they, had been. When we might have been, you might have been, they might have been.

units.la: Præteritum Plusquamperfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect.

units.la: O Dio volesse, che io fossi. tu fossi, colui fosse stato. Vtinam ego fuissem, tu fuisses, ille fuisset, Wolte Gott, daß ich, du, er wäre gewesen.
units.tr: Oh God would that I were, that you were, that he had been. Would that I had been, you had been, he had been; would to God that I, you, he, had been.

units.la: Che noi fossimo, voi foste, colore fossero stati, daß wir, jhr, sie wären gewesen. Nos fuissemus, vos fuissetis, illi fuissent.
units.tr: That we were, you were, they had been; that we, you, they, had been. We had been, you had been, they had been.

units.la: Idem dis auch auffolche weise, das Lateinische ist gleich.
units.tr: The same: the same way, in the same form; the Latin is the same.

units.la: O chio farei, tu faresti, colui farebbe stato, daß ich, du, er, gewefen seyn wurde. Noi faremmo, voi fareste, coloro farebbono & fariano stati, daß wir wurden seyn gewesen, daß jhr, daß sie wurden seyn gewesen.
units.tr: Oh that I would be, you would be, he would have been; that I, you, he, would have been. We would be, you would be, they would be and would have been; that we would have been, that you would have been, that they would have been.

units.la: Futurum subjunctiui.
units.tr: Future subjunctive.

units.la: Quando io saro, tu sarai, colui sarà stato. Wann ich, du, er wird gewesen seyn, cum ego fuero, tu fueris, ille fuerit.
units.tr: When I shall be, you shall be, he shall have been. When I, you, he, shall have been; when I shall have been, you shall have been, he shall have been.

units.la: Quando noi saremo, voi sarete, Coloro saranno stati, wann wir, jhr, sie werden gewesen seyn. Cum nos fuerimus, vos fueritis, illi fuerint.
units.tr: When we shall be, you shall be, they shall have been; when we, you, they, shall have been. When we shall have been, you shall have been, they shall have been.

units.la: Infinit. modus temp. præs.
units.tr: Infinitive mood, present tense.

units.la: Particip. stato, stata, gewesen, auch bißweilen suto, suta, qui & qua fuerunt.
units.tr: Participle: been, gewesen; sometimes also suto, suta, who and which have been.

units.la: Gerundium. præsens, Essendo ió. Essendo tu, colui, noi, voi, coloro, l. Cum sim, cum sis, cum sit, cum simus, cum sitis, cum sint, oder also, cum essem, cum esses, cum esset, semus, setis, sent, cum sent, &c. Dieweil ich bin, oder nach dem ich bin, du bist, weil er ist, Item, weil wir alle Sünder seyn.
units.tr: Gerundive, present: essendo, being (I). Essendo tu, colui, noi, voi, coloro, being you, he, we, you, they [essendo tu, colui, noi, voi, coloro]. Cum sim, cum sis, cum sit, cum simus, cum sitis, cum sint, or likewise cum essem, cum esses, cum esset, essemus, essetis, essent, cum essent, etc. [cum sim, cum sis, cum sit, cum simus, cum sitis, cum sint; cum essem, cum esses, cum esset, essemus, essetis, essent, cum essent, etc.]. Since I am, or after I am; you are; since he is; likewise, since we are all sinners.

units.la: Essende
units.tr: Being

units.la: Effendo noi tutti peccatori.
units.tr: Since we are all sinners.

units.tr: Cum simus peccatores omnes.

units.la: Gerund. praeteritum.
units.tr: Gerund, past.

units.la: Effendo stato, stata, stati, io fui, colui, noi, voi, coloro, cum fuerim, ris, rit, rimus, ritis, rint, vel, cum fuissem, fes, fet, femus, fetis, fent. Dieweil ich gewesen bin: Idem, effendo stato, colui, nach dem er gewesen ist. Dieweil wir, jhr, sie gewesen seyn.
units.tr: Having been, I was, he, we, you, they, when I have been, you have been, he has been, when we have been, you have been, they have been, or when I had been, you had been, he had been, we had been, you had been, they had been. Since I have been; likewise, having been, he, after he has been; since we, you, they, have been.

units.la: Gerundij futurum.
units.tr: Gerund, future.

units.la: Douendo essere io, tu, egli, noi, voi, eglino, weil ich seyn muß, oder seyn soll, du, er, wir, jhr, sie seyn müssen.
units.tr: Being about to be I, you, he, we, you, they; since I must be or shall be, you, he, we, you, they must be.

units.la: Cum sim, sis, sit, simus, sitis, sint, cum sint, &c.
units.tr: When I may be, you may be, he may be, we may be, you may be, they may be, when they may be, etc.

units.la: Hauendo ad essere, io, tu, colui, noi, voi, coloro.
units.tr: Having to be, I, you, he, we, you, they.

units.la: Dieweil ich zuseyn hab, du, er, wir, jhr, sie zuseyn haben.
units.tr: Since I have to be, you, he, we, you, they have to be.

units.la: Effendo per essere, io, tu, colui, noi, voi, colore. Nachdem ich seyn muß, du, er, wir, jhr, sie seyn müssen, als,
units.tr: Being to be, I, you, he, we, you, they. Since I must be, you, he, we, you, they must be, as

units.la: Effendo per esser io nella scuola, weil ich in der Schul seyn muß, cum sim in schola ego.
units.tr: Being to be in school, I, since I must be in school; when I must be in school.

units.la: Declinatio verbi passiui primae Conjugationis, Indicatiui modi, tempor. praes.
units.tr: Conjugation of the passive verb, first conjugation, indicative mood, present tense.

units.la: Io sono amato, ego amor, ich bin geliebt. Tu sei amato, tu amaris, du bist geliebt. Colui è amato, si amato, si ama, & amati, ille amatur, er ist geliebt.
units.tr: I am loved, I am loved. I am loved. You are loved, you are loved, you are loved. He is loved, he is loved, he is loved, and they are loved, he is loved.

units.la: Noi siamo, voi siete amati, wir sind, jhr seyd geliebt. Noi amamur, vos amamini.
units.tr: We are, you are loved, we are, you are loved. We are loved, you are loved.

units.la: Coloro sono amati, & si amano, vel amanssi & amansi, sie seyn geliebt, illi amantur.
units.tr: They are loved, and they are loved, or they are loved and they are loved, they are loved; they are loved.

units.la: Praeterit. Imperfectum.
units.tr: Preterite. Imperfect.

units.la: Io era amato, ego amabar, ich war geliebt. Tu eri amato, tu amabatis, du warest geliebt.
units.tr: I was loved, I was loved, I was loved. You were loved, you were loved, you were loved.

units.la: Colui era amato, & si amaua, amauasi, ille amabatur, er war geliebt. Noi eravamo, Voi eravate. } nos abamabur amati, vos amabamini.
units.tr: He was loved, and he was loved, he was loved, he was loved. We were, you were. We were loved, you were loved.

units.la: Wir, jhr, waren, waret geliebt.
units.tr: We, you, were loved.

units.la: Coloro erano, &c. item si amauano, item amauanosi & amamansi, sie waren geliebt, illi amabantur.
units.tr: They were, etc., likewise they were loved, likewise they were loved and they were loved, they were loved; they were loved.

units.la: Praeteritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect.

units.la: Io sono stato & fui amato, ego amatus sum vel fui, ich bin geliebt gewesen.
units.tr: I have been and was loved, I was loved, I have been loved.

units.la: Tu sei stato & fosti amato, tu amatus es vel fuisti, du bist geliebt gewesen.
units.tr: You have been and were loved, you were loved, you have been loved.

units.la: Colui è stato amato, & fu si amo, amoffi, ille amatus est vel fuit, er ist geliebt gewesen.
units.tr: He has been loved, and was loved, he was loved, he has been loved.

units.la: Noi siamo stati, & fummo amati, wir seyn geliebt gewesen, Nos amati sumus vel fuimus.
units.tr: We have been, and we were loved, we have been loved; we were loved.

units.la: Voi siete stati & fosti amati, vos amati estis & fuistis, Ihr seyt geliebt gewesen.
units.tr: You have been and were loved, you were loved, you have been loved.

units.la: Colore
units.tr: They

units.la: Coloro fono stati & furono amati, item coloro si amarone, & amaron, amaro, item amar, & amaronsi, amarossi, amarsi, lat. illi amati sunt, velfuerunt, sie seyn geliebt gewefen.
units.tr: They have been and were loved, likewise they were loved, and they were loved, they were loved, and they were loved, and they were loved; they have been loved.

units.la: Praterit. plusq. perfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect.

units.la: Io era, | stato | ego amatus eram. Tu eri, | amato. | tu amatus eras. Colui era, | | ille amatus erat. Noi eramo, | stati | nos amati eramus. Voi erauate, | amati. | vos amati eratis. Coloro erano, | | illi amati erant.
units.tr: I was, | been | I had been loved. Thou wert, | loved. | thou hadst been loved. He was, | | he had been loved. We were, | been | we had been loved. You were, | loved. | you had been loved. They were, | | they had been loved.

units.la: Ich, du, er, war, wurdest, ward geliebt.
units.tr: I, thou, he: was, wast, became loved.

units.la: Wir, jhr, sie, wurden, wurdet geliebt.
units.tr: We, you, they: were, you were, became loved.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future.

units.la: Io saro, tu sarai amato, ich werd, du wirst gelie-bet seyn, ego amabor, tu amaberis.
units.tr: I shall be, thou wilt be loved, I shall, thou wilt, be loved, I shall be loved, thou wilt be loved.

units.la: Colui sarà amato, item colui si amara over amera ssi, er wird geliebet seyn, ille amabitur.
units.tr: He will be loved; likewise he will be loved (amara, or amerassi), he will be loved, he will be loved.

units.la: Noi saremo, voi sarete amati, wir, jhr, werden, werdet geliebt seyn, nos amabimur, vos amabimini.
units.tr: We shall be, you will be loved, we shall, you will, be loved, we shall be loved, you will be loved.

units.la: Coloro saranno amati, & si ameranno, ameranossi, & ameransi, illi amabuntur, sie werden geliebt seyn.
units.tr: They will be loved, and they will love themselves, they will love themselves, and they will love themselves, they will be loved.

units.la: Imperatiuo modo temp. praef.
units.tr: Imperative mood, present tense

units.la: Sÿ amato tu, fey du geliebt, amare tu. Sia amato colui, & si ami, amisi, ametur ille, fey er geliebt.
units.tr: Be thou loved, be thou loved; be thou loved. Let him be loved, and let him love himself, let him be loved.

units.la: Siamo amati noi, feyn wir geliebt. Siate amati voi, feydt jhr geliebt. Siano amati coloro, vel si amino, aminosi & aminsi, lat. amentur illi, feyen sie geliebet.
units.tr: Let us be loved, let us be loved. Be ye loved, be ye loved. Let them be loved, or let them love themselves, let them be loved.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future

units.la: Sarai amato tu, amator tu, du sollest geliebet feyn. Sarà amato colui, & si amerà & amerasi, amator ille, er soll geliebet seyn. Saremo amati noi, wir sollen geliebt seyn, amemur nos. Sarete amati voi, jhr sollet geliebet seyn, amaminor vos. Saranno amati coloro, si ameranno & amerannosi, ameransi, sie sollen geliebet seyn, amantor illi.
units.tr: Thou shalt be loved, thou shalt be loved; thou shalt be loved. He shall be loved, and he shall love himself, he shall be loved. We shall be loved, we shall be loved; we shall be loved. You shall be loved, you shall be loved; you shall be loved. They shall be loved, and they shall love themselves, they shall be loved; they shall be loved.

units.la: Optat. modo temp. praf & futuri.
units.tr: Optative mood, present and future

units.la: O Dio voglia &c. chiofia amato, O wolte Gott, daß ich geliebet sey. Vtinam ego amet. Che tu sij amato, daß du geliebet seyest, tu ameris.
units.tr: O God grant that I may be loved, O would to God that I were loved. Would that I might love. That thou mayest be loved, that thou mayest be loved; that thou mayest be loved.

units.la: Che colui fia amato, & colui fi ami, colui amifi, daß er geliebet fey, ille ametur.
units.tr: That he may be loved, and that he may love himself, that he may be loved; that he may be loved.

units.la: Che noi fiamo amati, daß wir geliebt seyn, nos amemur.
units.tr: That we may be loved, that we may be loved; that we may be loved.

units.la: Che voi fiate amati, daß jhr geliebt seydt, vos amemini.
units.tr: That ye may be loved, that ye may be loved; that ye may be loved.

units.la: Che coloro siano amati, vel coloro fi amino, & aminosi, coloro aminsi, daß sie geliebet seyn, illi amentur.
units.tr: That they may be loved, or that they may love themselves, that they may be loved; that they may be loved.

units.la: Præteritum Imperfectum.
units.tr: Imperfect past

units.la: Dio volesse, che io fossi, & tu fossi amato, daß ich würde, du würdest geliebt, Vtinam ego amaret, tu amareris.
units.tr: O God, would that I were, and that thou wert loved, that I might be, that thou mightest be loved; would that I were loved, thou wert loved.

units.la: Che colui fosso amato, over che colui fi amasse, colui amassosi, daß er wurde geliebt, ille amaretur.
units.tr: That he were loved, or that he loved himself, that he might be loved; that he were loved.

units.la: Che noi fossimo amati, daß wir wurden geliebt, nos amaremur.
units.tr: That we were loved, that we might be loved; that we were loved.

units.la: Che voi foste amati, daß jhr wurdet geliebt, vos amaremini.
units.tr: That ye were loved, that ye might be loved; that ye were loved.

units.la: Coloro fossero amati, & si amassero, coloro amasseronsi, & amasserisi, daß sie werden geliebt, illi amarentur.
units.tr: They were loved, and they loved themselves, that they might be loved; they were loved.

units.la: Præteritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect past

units.la: O Dio voglia, ch'io sia stato amato, O wolte Gott, daß ich geliebet gewest sey, Vtinam ego amatus sim, vel fuerim.
units.tr: O God grant that I have been loved, O would to God that I had been loved; would that I might have been loved.

units.la: Che tu fij stato amato, daß du geliebet gewest seyst.
units.tr: That thou hast been loved, that thou hadst been loved.

units.la: Tu amatus fis, vel fueris.
units.tr: Thou hast been loved.

units.la: Che colui fij stato amato, daß er geliebet gewest sey. Ille amatus sit, vel fuerit. Noi siamo, Noi siate, Coloro siano, stati amati.
units.tr: That he has been loved, that he had been loved. He has been loved. We are, you are, they are, loved.

units.la: Daß wir, jhr, sie geliebt gewesen seyd, seyn: Nos amati simus, vel fuerimus. Vos amati sitis, vel fueritis. Illi amati sint, vel fuerint.
units.tr: That we, you, they, have been loved: We have been loved. You have been loved. They have been loved.

units.la: Praeterit. Plusq. perfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect past

units.la: O Dio volesse che io fossi, che tu fossi, che colui fosse stato amato. Daß ich, du, er wäre, wärest geliebt gewesen.
units.tr: O God would that I were, that thou wert, that he were, loved. That I, thou, he, would be, would have been loved.

units.la: Vtinam ego amatus essem, vel fuissem, tu amatus esses, ille amatus esset. Che noi fossimo, Che voi foste, Che coloro fossero. stati amati.
units.tr: Would that I had been loved, thou hadst been loved, he had been loved. That we were, that you were, that they were, been loved.

units.la: Daß wir, jhr, sie wåren, wåret geliebt gewefen.
units.tr: That we, you, they, would be, would have been loved.

units.la: Nos amati essemus, vel fuissemus.
units.tr: We had been loved.

units.la: Vos amati essetis, vel fuissetis.
units.tr: You had been loved.

units.la: Illi amati essent, vel fuissent.
units.tr: They had been loved.

units.la: Subjunctiuum jam diximus, similem esse Optat. Wir haben allbereit gesagt, der subjunctiuus sey dem Optatiuo gleich, exceptis duabus rebus, de quibus supra. Ausgenommen zweyerley Stuck, davon schon oben ist gedacht worden.
units.tr: We have already said that the subjunctive is similar to the optative, as already stated. (German: We have already said that the subjunctive is like the optative), except for two things, of which we have spoken above. Except for two points, already mentioned above.

units.la: Hic autem habet aliud discrimen, nempe. Hier aber hat es noch einen andern vnderscheid, nemblichen, quod eius praeteritum imperfectum, & praeteritum plusquam perfectum multipliciter inflecti possunt, hoc modo.
units.tr: Here, however, there is another difference, namely. Here, however, there is another difference, namely that the imperfect and pluperfect past can be inflected in many ways, in this manner.

units.la: Daß das praeteritum imperf. vnd plusq. perf. vilfeltiger weise könne verendert werden, der gestalt.
units.tr: That the imperfect and pluperfect past can be varied in many ways, in the following manner.

units.la: Praeteritum Imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past

units.la: Conciosia che io farei amato. Dieweiln daß ich würde geliebet seyn. Cum ego amarer.
units.tr: Since I would be loved. Since I would be loved. Since I were loved.

units.la: Tu farefti amato, du wurdest geliebet seyn, tu ameveris.
units.tr: Thou wouldst be loved, thou wouldst be loved; thou wouldst be loved.

units.la: Colui farebbe amato, vel colui fi amarebbe, & amarebbesi, weil er würde geliebet seyn. Cum ille amaretur.
units.tr: He would be loved, or he would love himself, since he would be loved. Since he were loved.

units.la: Noi faremmo amati, daß wir würden geliebet seyn. Nos amaremur.
units.tr: We would be loved, that we would be loved. We were loved.

units.la: Voi farefte amati, daß jhr würdet geliebet seyn. Vos amaremini.
units.tr: You would be loved, that you would be loved. You were loved.

units.la: Coloro farebbono amati, & fi amarebbero, amarebbonfi & amarebbenfi, daß sie würden geliebet seyn. Illi amarentur.
units.tr: They would be loved, and they would love themselves, they would love themselves, that they would be loved. They were loved.

units.la: Idem
units.tr: The same.

units.la: Io fària amato, Tu farefti, Ich, du wurde, würdest geliebet seyn. Ego amarer, tu amareris.
units.tr: I would be loved, thou wouldst, I, thou, would be, wouldst be loved. I were loved, thou wert loved.

units.la: Colui faria amato, velfi ameria, velcolui ameriafi, er wurde geliebet seyn. ille amaretur.
units.tr: He would be loved, or he would love himself, or he would love himself, he would be loved. He were loved.

units.la: Noi faremmo, voi farefte amati; Wir wurden, jhr wurdet geliebt seyn. Nos amaremur, Vos amaremini.
units.tr: We would be, you would be loved; we would be, you would be loved. We were loved, you were loved.

units.la: Coloro fariano amati, coloro fi amieran, & ameriano, & amerianfi, sie wurden geliebet seyn, Illi amarentur.
units.tr: They would be loved, they would love themselves, and they would love themselves, they would be loved. They were loved.

units.la: Prateritum Plusquamperfect.
units.tr: Preterite Pluperfect.

units.la: Concio fia cosa che, Avenga che io farei & faria flato amato. Sintemahln daß ich wurd geliebt gewesen seyn. Cum ego amatus essem, vel fuissem.
units.tr: Even though I would have been loved. Since I would have been loved. When I had been loved, or had been.

units.la: Tu farefti flato amato, du wurdest geliebt gewesen seyn. Tu amatus esses, vel fuisses.
units.tr: You would have been loved. You would have been loved. You had been loved, or had been.

units.la: Colui sarebbe & fariaflato amato, er wurde geliebet gewesen seyn. Ille amatus esset, velfuisset. Noi faremmo, Voi farefte, Coloro farebbono & fariano. flati amati.
units.tr: He would have been loved. He would have been loved. He had been loved, or had been. We would have been, you would have been, they would have been loved.

units.la: Wir, jhr, sie würden, würdet geliebt gewe- sen seyn. Nos amati essemus. Vos amati essetis. Illi amati essent, vel fuissent.
units.tr: We, you, they would have been loved. We had been loved. You had been loved. They had been loved, or had been.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future.

units.la: Quando { Io faro, Tu farai, Colui sarà } statò amato.
units.tr: When I shall have been loved, you will have been loved, he will have been loved.

units.la: Wann ich, du, er, wird, wirst geliebt ge- wesen seyn. Cum { Ego amatus ero, Tu amatus eris, Ille amatus erit. Quando { Noi saremo, Voi sarete, Coloro saranno } stati amati.
units.tr: When I, you, he shall have been loved. When I shall have been loved, you will have been, he will have been. When we shall have been, you will have been, they will have been loved.

units.la: Wann wir, jhr, sie, geliebet seyn werden. Cum { Nos amati erimus, Vos amati eritis, Illi amati erunt.
units.tr: When we, you, they shall be loved. When we shall be loved, you will be, they will be loved.
