units.tr: Infinitive mood, present tense.

units.la: Esse amato, amari, geliebt seyn.
units.tr: To be loved. To be loved.

units.la: Praeterit. Esse fuero stato amato, Esse fui amato geliebt gewesen seyn.
units.tr: Preterite: To have been loved, to have been loved. To have been loved.

units.la: Futur, Douere essere amato, geliebt seyn sollen oder müssen.
units.tr: Future: to be to be loved, to be to be loved, ought or must be loved.

units.la: Douerst amare ouero, douer amarst, l. amatum iri, sich lieben sollen.
units.tr: To be to love oneself, or to be to be loved, i.e. amatum iri, to be to love oneself, ought to love oneself.

units.la: Hauere ad essere amato, hauere ad amarst, hauerst amare, geliebt zuseyn haben, sich zulieben haben. Esser per amarst. } zulieben Esserst per amare, } seyn.
units.tr: To have to have been loved, to have to love oneself, to have to love oneself, to be to be loved, to be to love, to have to have been loved, to have to love oneself.

units.la: Amandum esse, vel fuisse.
units.tr: To be to be loved, or to have been to be loved.

units.la: Gerundia.
units.tr: Gerunds.

units.la: Præs. Essendo amato io, tu, colui. Nach dem ich geliebt bin, du geliebet bist, er geliebet ist. Cum amer, cum ameris, cum ametur.
units.tr: Present: Since I am loved, you are loved, he is loved. Since I am loved, since you are loved, since he is loved. When I am loved, when you are loved, when he is loved.

units.la: Et essendo amati noi, voi, coloro. Vnd weil wir, jhr, sie geliebet seyn, geliebet seyd. Cum amemur, cum amemini, cum amentur. Et amandosi, vnd weil man liebet. Cum ametur.
units.tr: And since we, you, they are loved. And since we, you, they are loved, are loved. When we are loved, when you are loved, when they are loved. And since one is loved. And since one loves. When one is loved.

units.la: Praterit. Essendosi stato amato, io, tu, colui. Nach dem ich, du, er, geliebet bin gewesen, geliebet worden bist, vnd ist, &c. Cum amatus sim, sis, sit, vel fuerim, fueris, fuerit, &c.
units.tr: Preterite: Since I, you, he have been loved. Since I, you, he have been loved, have become loved, and so on. When I have been loved, you have been, he has been, etc.

units.la: Et essendo stati amati noi, voi, coloro. Vnd weil wir geliebt gewesen seyn, jhr geliebt gewesen seyd, &c.
units.tr: And since we, you, they have been loved. And since we have been loved, you have been loved, and so on.

units.la: Cum amati simus, sitis, sint &c. vel fuerimus, fueritis, fuerint.
units.tr: When we have been loved, you have been, they have been, etc.

units.la: Et effendo si amato colui, vnd nach dem er geliebt gewesen, cum amatum fuerit ille.
units.tr: And since he has been loved. And since he has been loved. When he has been loved.

units.la: Futur. Gerundy. Effendo per esse amato io, tu, colui, weil ich zulieben bin, du zulieben bist, er zulieben ist.
units.tr: Future gerund: Since I am to be loved, you are to be loved, he is to be loved. Since I am to be loved, you are to be loved, he is to be loved.

units.tr: When I may be, you may be, he may be to be loved.

units.la: Et effendo per esse amati noi, voi, coloro, weil wir, jhr, sie zulieben seyn, &c.
units.tr: And since we are to be loved, you, they. And since we, you, they are to be loved.

units.la: Cum simus, sitis, sint amandi.
units.tr: When we may be, you may be, they may be to be loved.

units.la: Et effendo per amarsi, vel effendosi per amare, Vnd nach deme zulieben ist.
units.tr: And since it is to be loved. And since it is to be loved.

units.la: Cum amandum sit.
units.tr: When it is to be loved.

units.la: Douendo esser amato io, tu colui, nach dem zulieben seyn soll, ich du, er, &c.
units.tr: Being about to be loved: I, you, he. Being about to be loved, I, you, he, and so on.

units.la: Cum amandus sim, sis, sit.
units.tr: When I must be loved, you must, he must.

units.tr: Being about to be loved: we, you, they. Since we, you, they must be loved.

units.la: Cum simus, sitis, sint, amandi.
units.tr: When we must be loved, you must, they must.

units.tr: Being about to love, or being about to love oneself. Since it is to be loved, since it is to be loved.

units.la: Cum amandum sit.
units.tr: When it must be loved.

units.la: Hauendo ad essere amato, io, tu, colui, weil, vnd nach dem ich hab geliebt zuseyn, oder kurtz, weil ich zulieben bin, du zu lieben bist, &c. Cum sim, sis amandus, idem, & hauendo ad esser amati coloro, vnd nach dem sie zulieben seyn. Cum sint amandi. Et habendo ad amarsi ouer ad amare, weil man zulieben hat, oder weil zuliebẽ ist. Cum amandus sit.
units.tr: Having to be loved: I, you, he. Since, and after I have to have been loved, or briefly, since I am to be loved, you are to be loved, etc. When I must be loved, you must be loved, he must be loved. And having to be loved: they. And after they are to be loved. When they must be loved. And having to love oneself or having to love. Since one has to be loved, or since it is to be loved. When it must be loved.

units.la: Indicatiuo modo. Temp. præs.

units.tr: I hold, I hold, I hold. You hold, you hold, you hold. He holds, he holds, he holds. We hold, we hold, we hold. You hold, you hold, you hold. They hold, they hold, they hold.

units.la: Illud hic annotes Lector velim, me consulto in huius verbi declinatione præteriisse quasdam voces, quibus Poeta dumtaxat, vtuntur.
units.tr: Illud hic annotes, Lector, velim, me consulto in huius verbi declinatione praeteriisse quasdam voces, quibus Poeta duntaxat utuntur. I would have you note here, reader, that I deliberately passed over in this verb's conjugation certain forms that only poets use.

units.la: Dises lieber Leser, kanst du hier mercken, daß ich mit fleiß in dises verbi declinatione etliche Wörter hab übergangen, welche die Poeten allein gebrauchen.
units.tr: Dear reader, you may note here that I have deliberately passed over in this conjugation of the verb some words which only the poets use.

units.la: Vt ïtum, ibam, eo, ïni, gire, ire, & huiusmodi, Als dise, ich gieng, ich bin gangen, gehen, &c.
units.tr: Ut itum, ibam, eo, ini, gire, ire, & huiusmodi, such as these: I went, I was going, I go, go, gire, to go, and the like.

units.la: Est proinde notandum, omnia verba absoluta, (hoc est, quæ transitiua non sunt, quando actionem in aliquo tantum significant, non in aliquem,) in præteritis pro verbo io, cum participio passiuo præteriti temp, habere verbum.
units.tr: It is therefore to be noted that all verbs absolute (that is, those which are not transitive, when they signify an action only within the subject and not directed at another), in the preterites, take the verb sono with the past passive participle, for the verb ho.

units.la: Weiter ist zurnercken, daß alle verba absoluta, das ist die, oder welche nicht verwendliche Wörter seyn, vnd eine handlung in einem verbleibet, vnd nicht weiters in eine andere gehet, diefelben Wort sag ich, in den prateritis, für das verbum io, mit dem participio prat. temp. haben mussen das Wort, fono.
units.tr: Further, it is to be remarked that all verbs absolute, that is, those that are not transitive and whose action remains within the subject without passing on to another, I say, in the preterites must have the word sono in place of the verb ho, with the past participle.

units.la: Als, io fono andato, ich bin gegangen, vnd nit ho andato, ich hab gegangen.
units.tr: For example: io sono andato, I have gone (I am gone), and not ho andato, I have gone (I have gone).

units.la: Item io sono venuto, vnd nit, ho venuto, ich hab kommen. In Summa es muß das participium passiuum seyn, vnd in denen andern dergleichen allen also zuverfahren.
units.tr: Likewise io sono venuto, I have come, and not ho venuto, I have come. In short, it must be the passive participle, and in all other such cases proceed in the same way.

units.tr: Habendo a volere, io, tu, &c. Since I was willing, or had the will; habend'io volere, when I shall have wished.

units.la: Essendo per volere, io, colui, noi, voi, &c. weil ich, er, wir, im willens seyn, weil wir willens hatten, willens waren, cum nos voluerimus.
units.tr: Essendo per volere, io, colui, noi, voi, &c. since I, he, we, you, etc. were to be willing; since we were willing, had the will, were willing; when we shall have wished.

units.la: DECLINATIO VERBI FO, ET FACIO.
units.tr: THE DECLENSION OF THE VERB FO, AND FACIO.

units.la: Indicat. mod. temp. praes.
units.tr: Indicative mood, present tense.

units.la: Io faccio & fo, ego facio, Ich thue, thue, ich thu, idem, ich mach, mache.
units.tr: I do and I make (io faccio and fo; ego facio): I do, I do, I do, the same, I make, I make.

units.la: Tu fai, tu facis, du thuft, du machst, machest.
units.tr: You do, you make (tu fai; tu facis): you do, you make, you make.

units.la: Colui fa, ille facit, er thut, er macht.
units.tr: He does, he makes (colui fa; ille facit): he does, he makes.

units.la: Noi facciamo, nos facimus, wir thun oder machen,
units.tr: We do, we make (noi facciamo; nos facimus): we do or make.

units.la: Voi fate, vos facitis, jhr thut, jhr machet, macht.
units.tr: You do, you make (voi fate; vos facitis): you do, you make, make.

units.la: Coloro fanno, illi faciunt, sie thun, thuen, sie machen.
units.tr: They do, they make (coloro fanno; illi faciunt): they do, they do, they make.

units.la: Praeteritum Imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past tense.

units.la: Io faceua, ego faciebam, ich that, ich that, ich thät, ich machte.
units.tr: I did, I did, I did, I made (io faceua; ego faciebam): I did, I did, I was doing, I made.

units.la: Tu faceui, tu faciebas, du thatest, du thätest, du machtest.
units.tr: You did, you were doing, you made (tu faceui; tu faciebas): you did, you did, you made.

units.la: Colui faceua, ille faciebat, er thate, thate, er thäte, er machte, machete.
units.tr: He did, he did, he was doing, he made, he made (colui faceua; ille faciebat): he did, he did, he was doing, he made, he made.

units.la: Noi facenamo, nos faciebamus, wir thaten, thäten, theten, wir machten, macheten.
units.tr: We did, we were doing, we made, we made (noi facenamo; nos faciebamus): we did, we did, we did, we made, we made.

units.la: Voi faceuate, Vos faciebatis. jhr thatet, jhr thetet, jhr machtet, jhr machetet.
units.tr: You did, you did, you made, you made (voi faceuate; vos faciebatis): you did, you did, you made, you made.

units.la: Coloro faceuano, & faceano, illi faciebant, sie thaten, sie theten, sie machten, &c.
units.tr: They did, they did, they made, etc. (coloro faceuano, and faceano; illi faciebant): they did, they did, they made, etc.

units.la: Praeteritum perfectum, duplicatum.
units.tr: Perfect past tense, doubled form.

units.la: Io feci, & io ho fatto, ego feci. Ich hab gethan, ich hab gemacht.
units.tr: I did; I have done; I have made (io feci, and io ho fatto; ego feci): I have done, I have made.

units.la: Tu facesti, & hai fatto, tu fecisti, du haft gethan, du haft gemacht.
units.tr: You did, you have done, you have made (tu facesti, and hai fatto; tu fecisti): you have done, you have made.

units.la: Colui fece ouer, ha fatto, ille fecit, er hat gethan, hat gemacht.
units.tr: He did, he has done, he has made (colui fece or ha fatto; ille fecit): he has done, he has made.

units.la: Noi facemmo, ouer habbiam fatto, nos fecimus, Wir haben gethan, haben gemacht.
units.tr: We did, we have done (noi facemmo, or habbiam fatto; nos fecimus): we have done, we have made.

units.la: Voi faceste, o hauete fatto, Vos fecistis, jhr habt gethan, habet gemacht.
units.tr: You did, you have done (voi faceste, or hauete fatto; vos fecistis): you have done, you have made.

units.la: Coloro fecero, ouer hanno fatto, illi fecerunt, sie haben gethan, gemacht.
units.tr: They did, they have done (coloro fecero, or hanno fatto; illi fecerunt): they have done, they have made.

units.la: Praeterit. plusq. perfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect past tense.

units.la: Io haueua, fatto, Tu haueui, fatto, Colui haueua, fatto,
units.tr: I had, done; you had, done; he had, done.

units.la: Ego feceram, tu feceras, ille fecerat. Ich hatte, gethan, oder gemacht. Du hatteft, gethan, oder gemacht. Er hatte, gethan, oder gemacht.
units.tr: I had done or made; you had done or made; he had done or made.

units.la: Noi haueuamo, Voi haueuate, Coloro haueuano, fatto.
units.tr: We had, you had, they had, done.

units.la: M
units.tr: M

units.la: Nos feceramus, vos feceratis, illi fecerant, Wir hatten, jhr hattet, sie hatten gethan, gemacht.
units.tr: We had, you had, they had done or made.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future tense.

units.la: Io faro, tu farai, ego faciam, tu facies, ich werde du wirst thun, thun, machen, du wirst machen.
units.tr: I shall do, you will do, I shall make, you will make.

units.la: Colui farà, ille faciet, er wird thun, oder machen.
units.tr: He will do, he will make.

units.la: Noi faremo, nos faciemus, wir werden thun, machen.
units.tr: We shall do, we shall make.

units.la: Voi farete, Vos facietis, jhr werdet thun, werdet machen.
units.tr: You will do, you will make.

units.la: Coloro faranno, illi facient, sie werden thun, werden machen.
units.tr: They will do, they will make.

units.la: Imperat. mod. Temp. praes.
units.tr: Imperative mood, present tense.

units.la: Fà tu, fac tu, Thu du, mach du, oder mache du.
units.tr: Do you, make you, or make thou.

units.la: Faccia colui, faciat ille, thu er, mach er, mache er.
units.tr: Let him do, let him make, let him make.

units.la: Facciamo noi, faciamus nos, thun wir, machen wir.
units.tr: Let us do, let us make.

units.la: Fate voi, facite vos, thut jhr, macht jhr, oder machet jhr.
units.tr: Do you, make you, or make you.

units.la: Facciano coloro, faciant illi, thun sie, machen sie.
units.tr: Let them do, let them make.

units.la: Futurum Imperat.
units.tr: Future imperative.

units.la: Farai tu, facito tu, du solt thun, solt machen.
units.tr: You shall do, you shall make.

units.la: Farà colui, facito ille, er soll thun, soll machen.
units.tr: He shall do, he shall make.

units.la: Faremo noi, faciamus nos, wir sollen thun, wir sollen machen.
units.tr: We shall do, we shall make.

units.la: Farete Voi, facitote vos, jhr sollet thun, sollet machen.
units.tr: You shall do, you shall make.

units.la: Faranno coloro, faciunto illi, sie sollen thun, sollen machen.
units.tr: They shall do, they shall make.

units.la: Optat.
units.tr: Optative.

units.la: subjunctivus.
units.tr: Subjunctive.

units.la: O che io faccia, Vtinam ego faciam, O daß ich thue, daß ich mache.
units.tr: O that I may do, O that I may make.

units.la: Che tu faccia, tu facias, daß du thust, machest.
units.tr: That you may do, may make.

units.la: Colui faccia, ille faciat, daß er thu, daß er mach.
units.tr: That he may do, that he may make.

units.la: Che noi facciamo, nos faciamus, daß wir thun, daß wir machen.
units.tr: That we may do, that we may make.

units.la: Che Voi facciate, Vos faciatis, daß jhr thut, daß jhr macht.
units.tr: That you may do, that you may make.

units.la: Che coloro facciano, illi faciant, daß sie thun, daß sie machen.
units.tr: That they may do, that they may make.

units.la: Praeterit. Imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past subjunctive.

units.la: O che io facessi, Vtinam ego facerem, daß ich solte thun oder machen.
units.tr: O that I might do, that I should do or make.

units.la: Tu facessi, tu faceres, daß du soltest thun oder machen.
units.tr: That you might do, that you should do or make.

units.la: Colui facesse, ille faceret, daß er solt thun, oder machen.
units.tr: That he might do, that he should do or make.

units.la: Che noi facessimo, nos faceremus, daß wir solten thun oder machen.
units.tr: That we might do, that we should do or make.

units.la: Che Voi faceste, Vos faceretis, daß jhr solter thun, machen.
units.tr: That you might do, that you should do or make.

units.la: Coloro facessero, illi facerent, daß sie solten thun, solten machen.
units.tr: That they might do, that they should do or make.

units.la: Idem aliter, Lat. supra.
units.tr: The same in another form, see above.

units.la: O che io farei & faria, O daß ich thäte, machete.
units.tr: O that I would do, O that I would make.

units.la: Che tu faresti, daß du theteft, machetest.
units.tr: That you would do, that you would make.

units.la: Che colui farebbe & faria, daß er thete, machete.
units.tr: That he would do, that he would make.

units.la: Che noi faremmo, daß wir theten, macheten.
units.tr: That we would do, that we would make.

units.la: Che voi fareste, daß jhr thetet, daß jhr machtet vnd machetet.
units.tr: That you would do, that you would make, and make.

units.la: Coloro farebbono & fariano, daß sie theten, daß sie machten, vnd macheten.
units.tr: That they would do, that they would make, and make.

units.la: Praeteritum perfectum.
units.tr: Perfect tense.

units.la: O che io habbia, } tu habbia, } fatto. Colui habbia, }
units.tr: Oh that I may have, that you may have, done. That he may have, done.

units.la: Cum ego fecerim, tu feceris, ille fecerit.
units.tr: When I have done, you have done, he has done.

units.la: O daß ich hab, gethan, gemacht, daß du habst gethan, gemacht, daß er hab gethan, gemacht. Che noi habbiamo, } Che voi habbiate, } fatto. Coloro habbiano, }
units.tr: Oh that I have, done, made; that you have, done, made; that he have, done, made. That we have, that you (plural) have, that they have, done.

units.la: Cum nos fecerimus.
units.tr: When we have done.

units.la: Vos feceritis.
units.tr: When you have done.

units.la: Illi fecerint. Daß wir haben, } Daß jhr habet, } gethan, gemacht. Daß sie haben, }
units.tr: When they have done. That we have, that you have, done, made. That they have, done, made.

units.la: Praeteritum plusq. perfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect tense.

units.la: O Che io hauessi, } Tu hauessi, } fatto. Colui hauesse, }
units.tr: Oh that I had, that you had, that he had, done.

units.la: Vtinam ego fecissem, tu fecisses, ille fecisset. O daß ich solt, daß du solt est, daß er solte, Che noi hauessimo, Che voi hauesse, Che coloro hauessero, haben gethan, gemacht. fatto.
units.tr: Would that I had done, that you had done, that he had done. Oh that I should, that you should, that he should, that we had, that you had, that they had, have done, made. Done.

units.la: Nos fecissemus, Vos fecisset is, Illi fecissent. Daß wir solten, Daß ihr solte t, Daß sie solten. haben gethan, oder gemacht.
units.tr: Had we done, had you done, had they done. That we should, that you should, that they should, have done or made.

units.la: Idem aliter, Lat. supra.
units.tr: The same in another way, see above.

units.la: O che io hauerei & haueria : Tu haueresti ; Colui hauerebbe & haueria fatto.
units.tr: Oh that I would have, and would have done; you would have done; he would have done.

units.la: Daß ich, du, er, hätte, hättest gethan, gemacht. Che noi haueremmo, Che voi haueste, Coloro hauerebbono, & haueriano, fatto.
units.tr: That I, you, he, would have, would have done, made. That we would have, that you would have, that they would have, done.

units.la: Daß wir, ihr, sie, hätten, hättet gethan, oder gemacht.
units.tr: That we, you, they, would have, would have done or made.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future tense.

units.la: Io hauero, Tu hauerai, Colui haurà, fatto.
units.tr: I shall have, you will have, he will have, done.

units.la: Cum ego fecero, tu feceris, cum ille fecerit.
units.tr: When I shall have done, you will have done, when he will have done.

units.la: Wann ich, du, er, werd, wirst, wird haben gethan, oder gemacht. { Noi haueremo, / Voi hauerete, / Coloro haueranno, } fatta. Cum nos fecerimus. Cum vos feceritis. Cum illi fecerint. Wann wir werden, / Wann jhr werdet, / Wann sie werden. } haben gethan, oder gemacht.
units.tr: When I, you, he, shall, shalt, will have done or made. We shall have, you will have, they will have, done. When we shall, when you shall, when they shall have done or made.

units.la: Infinitiui modi, Temp. praef.
units.tr: Infinitive mood, present tense.

units.la: Fare, facere, thuen, thun machen.
units.tr: To do, to make, to do, to make.

units.la: Hauere fatta, gethan haben, gemacht haben.
units.tr: To have done, to have done, to have made.

units.la: fecisse. (esse.)
units.tr: To have done. (To be.)

units.la: Douer fare, thun oder machen sollen, facturum
units.tr: To be going to do, to be about to do or make, about to do.

units.la: Esser per fare, zuthun oder zumachen seyn.
units.tr: To be to be done, to be done or made.

units.la: Hauere a fare, zuthun oder zumachen haben.
units.tr: To have to do, to have to do or make.

units.la: Facente, facenti, faciens, facientes, der machend, der thuende, die machenden, die thuenden.
units.tr: Doing, the one doing, the doers, the ones doing, the one making, the one doing, the ones making, the ones doing.

units.la: Fatto, fatti, die That, oder das Gemächt, die Thaten, die Gemächten, oder die Gemächter, factus, facta.
units.tr: Done, done ones, the deed, or the thing made; the deeds, the things made, or the makers. Made, done.

units.la: Gerundy.
units.tr: Gerund.

units.la: Facendo, faciens, thuend, machend, machende.
units.tr: Doing, making, doing, making, one who makes.

units.la: Hauendo fatto io, nach dem ich gemacht hab, als ich gethan hab, cum ego fecerim.
units.tr: Having done, I, after I have made, as I have done. When I have done.

units.la: Douendo fare io, &c. nach dem ich oder er thun, oder machen solte. Ha
units.tr: Having to do, I, etc., after I or he ought to do or make.

units.la: Nach dem, vnd weil ich thun gehabt, oder als ich zumachen gehabt.
units.tr: After, and since I have had to do, or as I have had to make.

units.la: DECLINATIO VERBI VENIO, VENGO, VENIRE, kommen.
units.tr: CONJUGATION OF THE VERB VENIO, VENGO, VENIRE, to come

units.la: Indic. mod. temp. praes.
units.tr: Indicative mood, present tense

units.la: Io vengo, ego venio, ich komm. Tu vieni, tu venis, du kombst, oder du komst. Colui viene, ille venit, er kombt, er komet, komt. Noi veniamo, nos venimus, wir kommen. Noi venite, vos venitis, jhr kommet. Coloro vengono, illi veniunt, sie kommen.
units.tr: I come, I come, I come (I come). You come, you come, you come (you come, or you come). He comes, he comes, he comes (he comes, he comes, he comes). We come, we come, we come (we come). You come, you come (you come). They come, they come, they come (they come).

units.la: Praeterit. imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect tense

units.la: Io veniua, tu veniui, colui veniua. Ich kam, du kamest, er kame. Ego veniebam, tu veniebas, ille veniebat. Noi veniuamo, nos veniebamus. Wir kamen, voi veniuate, vos veniebatis, jhr kamet, coloro vemuano, illi veniebant, sie kamen.
units.tr: I was coming, you were coming, he was coming. I came, you camest, he came. We were coming, we were coming, you were coming, you were coming, they were coming, they were coming. We came, you came, you came, they came.

units.la: Praeteritum perfectum. duplici modo.
units.tr: Perfect tense, in two forms.

units.la: Io venni, io son venuto, ich bin kommen. Ego veni, tu venisti, tu venesti, tu sei venuto, du bist kommen. Colui venne, & e venuto, ille venit. Er ist kommen.
units.tr: I came, I have come, I am come. I came, you came, you came, you have come, you are come. He came, and has come, he came. He is come.

units.la: Noi venemmo, siamo venuti, nos venimus, Wir seynd, oder seynd kommen.
units.tr: We came, we have come, we came, we are, or have, come.

units.la: Voi veneste, voi siete & sete venuti, jhr seyd kommen.
units.tr: You came, you are and have come, you are come.

units.la: Coloro vennero, & sono venuti, illi venerunt, sie seyn kommen.
units.tr: They came, and have come, they came, they are come.

units.la: Præterit. Plusq. perfect.
units.tr: Pluperfect tense

units.la: Io era, tu eri, colui era venuto, ego veneram, tu veneras, ille venerat. Ich war, du warst, er war kommen.
units.tr: I was, you were, he had come. I had come, you had come, he had come. I was, you were, he was come.

units.la: Noi eravamo, Voi eravate, Coloro erano, Venuti.
units.tr: Noi eravamo, Voi eravate, Coloro erano, Venuti. We were, ye were, they were, come.

units.la: Nos veneramus, vos veneratis, illi venerant, Wir waren, jhr waret, sie waren kommen.
units.tr: Nos veneramus, vos veneratis, illi venerant, We were, ye were, they were come.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future

units.la: Io veniro & verrò, ego veniam, ich werd kommen.
units.tr: I will come and shall come, I shall come, I shall come.

units.la: Tu venirai, & verrai, tu venies, du wirst komen.
units.tr: Tu venirai, & verrai, tu venies, thou shalt come.

units.la: Colui venerà, & verrà, ille veniet, er wird kommen.
units.tr: He will come and will come, he will come, he will come.

units.la: Noi veniremo, & verremo, wir werden kommen, nos veniemus.
units.tr: We will come, and shall come, we shall come, we shall come.

units.la: Voi venirete, & verrete, jhr werdet kommen, vos venietis.
units.tr: You will come, and shall come, you shall come, you shall come.

units.la: Coloro veniranno, & verranno, sie werden kommen, illi venient.
units.tr: They will come, and will come, they will come, they shall come.

units.la: Imperatiuo modo temp. præs.
units.tr: Imperative mood, present tense

units.la: Vieni tu, Veni tu, komm du, komme du.Venga colui, Veniat ille, komm er, komme er.Veniamo noi, veniamus nos, kommen wir.Venite voi, kommet jhr, Venite vos.Vengano coloro, Veniant illi, kommen sie.
units.tr: Vieni tu, Veni tu, come thou, come thou. Venga colui, Veniat ille, let him come. Veniamo noi, veniamus nos, let us come. Venite voi, come ye, Venite vos. Vengano coloro, Veniant illi, let them come.

units.la: Futurum Imperat.
units.tr: Future imperative

units.la: Venerai & verrai tu, tu venies, du solst kommen.Venirà & verrà colui, Venito ille, er soll komen.Veniremo o, Verremo noi, Veniamus, wir sol-len kommen.Venirete & Verrete voi, Venitote, jhr sollet kommen.Veniranno & Verrano coloro, Veniunto, sie sol-len kommen.
units.tr: Venerai & verrai tu, tu venies, thou shalt come. Venirà & verrà colui, Venito ille, he shall come. Veniremo o, Verremo noi, Veniamus, we shall come. Venirete & Verrete voi, Venitote, ye shall come. Veniranno & Verrano coloro, Veniunto, they shall come.

units.la: Optat. modo fut. & præsent. subjunct.
units.tr: Optative mood, future and present subjunctive

units.la: O che io venga, tu venga, colui venga, O daß ich, du, er, komm, kommest.Vtinam ego veniam, tu venias, ille veniat.Che noi Veniamo, Voi veniate, coloro Vengano, Daß wir, jhr, sie, kommen, kommet.Nos veniamus, vos veniatis, illi veniant.
units.tr: O che io venga, tu venga, colui venga, O that I may come, that thou mayest come, that he may come. Vtinam ego veniam, tu venias, ille veniat. Che noi Veniamo, Voi veniate, coloro Vengano, that we may come, that ye may come, that they may come. Nos veniamus, vos veniatis, illi veniant.

units.la: Præterit. imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect tense

units.la: O che io Venissi, Vtinam ego venirem, Wol Gott, daß ich solt kommen.Tu Venissi, colui Venisse, tu venires, ille veniret, Daß du solt, daß er solt kommen.
units.tr: O che io Venissi, Vtinam ego venirem, Would God that I might come. Tu Venissi, colui Venisse, tu venires, ille veniret, that thou mightest come, that he might come.

units.la: Noi venissimo. Nos veniremus.
units.tr: Noi venissimo. Nos veniremus. That we might come.

units.la: Che voi veniste. Vos veniretis.
units.tr: Che voi veniste. Vos veniretis. That ye might come.

units.la: Coloro venissero. Illi venirent.
units.tr: Coloro venissero. Illi venirent. That they might come.

units.la: Daß wir solten kommen.
units.tr: That we should come.

units.la: Daß jhr soltet kommen.
units.tr: That ye should come.

units.la: Daß sie solten kommen.
units.tr: That they should come.

units.la: Idem aliter, Lat. vt supra.
units.tr: The same in another form, Latin as above.

units.la: O che io venirei & verrei.
units.tr: O che io venirei & verrei. O that I would come.

units.la: Che tu veniresti, & verresti.
units.tr: Che tu veniresti, & verresti. That thou wouldest come.

units.la: Colui venirebbe, verrebbe & verria. O daß ich, } keme. daß du, } kemetest, kemest. daß er, } keme.
units.tr: Colui venirebbe, verrebbe & verria. O that I, that thou, that he would come.

units.la: Noi veniremmo, & veremmo.
units.tr: Noi veniremmo, & veremmo. That we would come.

units.la: Voi venireste, & verreste.
units.tr: Voi venireste, & verreste. That ye would come.

units.la: Coloro venirebbono, verrebbono, & verriano.
units.tr: Coloro venirebbono, verrebbono, & verriano. That they would come.

units.la: Daß wir kemen.
units.tr: That we might come.

units.la: Daß jhr kemet.
units.tr: That ye might come.

units.la: Sie kemen.
units.tr: They might come.

units.la: Prateritum perfect. Optatiui modi
units.tr: Perfect tense of the optative mood

units.la: O che io sia, tu sij, sia, colui sia venuto. O daß ich sey, } kommen. daß du seyest, } daß er sey, }
units.tr: O che io sia, tu sij, sia, colui sia venuto. O that I may be come, that thou mayest be, that he may be come.

units.la: Cum ego veneram, tu veneris, ille venerit. Noi siamo, } venuti. Che voi siate, } Coloro siamo, }
units.tr: Cum ego veneram, tu veneris, ille venerit. Noi siamo, venuti. Che voi siate, venuti. Coloro siamo, venuti. That I may have come, thou mayest have come, he may have come. That we may be come, that ye may be come, that they may be come.

units.la: Daß wir seyen, } kommen.Daß jhr seyet, }Daß sie seyen, J
units.tr: That we may be, come. That ye may be, come. That they may be, come.

units.la: Nos venerimus, vos veneritis, illi venerint.
units.tr: Nos venerimus, vos veneritis, illi venerint.

units.la: O che io fossi, & sarei venuto. Vtinam ego fuissem, Daß ich wäre kommen.
units.tr: O che io fossi, & sarei venuto. Vtinam ego fuissem, O that I had been come. That I had come.

units.la: Che tu fossi & saresti venuto, Tu venisses, daß du wäreft kommen.

units.la: Che colui fosse & sarebbe venuto. Vtinam ille venisset, daß er wäre kommen.

units.la: Noi fossimo & saremo, } venuto.Voi foste & sareste, }Coloro fossero & sarebbero. J
units.tr: Noi fossimo & saremo, venuto. Voi foste & sareste, Coloro fossero & sarebbero. That we had been come, that ye had been come, that they had been come.

units.la: Nos venissemus, vos venissetis, illi venissent.
units.tr: Nos venissemus, vos venissetis, illi venissent.

units.la: Daß wir wären, daß wir wurden seyn, Daß jhr wäret, vnd seyn wurdet, Daß sie wären, vnd wurden seyn, } gekommen oder kommen. J
units.tr: That we had been, that we would have been come; that ye had been, and would have been come; that they had been, and would have been come; come or to come.

units.la: Io farò, } Cum ego venero. venuto. tu veneris. Tu sarai, Egli sarà, illi venerit.
units.tr: I shall have come; thou wilt have come; he will have come. When I have come; when thou hast come; when he has come.

units.la: Wann ich, du, er werd, wirst, wird kommen seyn. Noi saremo, } Cum nos venerimus. Voi sarete, venuti. Vos veneritis. Coloro saranno, Illi venerint. Wann wir, jhr, sie, werden, werdet komen seyn,
units.tr: When I, thou, he shall, wilt, will have come. We shall have come; you will have come; they will have come. When we, you, they shall, shall, will have come.

units.tr: Dovendo venire, io, tu, noi, voi, &c. Since we, you, I, thou are to come, or must come, &c.

units.la: Da tu, da tu, gib du. Dia colui, det ille, gebe er. Diamo noi, demus nos, geben wir. Date Voi, date Vos, gebet jhr. Diano coloro, dent illi, geben sie.

units.la: Darai tu, Dato tu, du solt geben. Dara colui, dato ille, er soll geben. Daremo noi, demus nos, wir sollen geben. Darete Voi, Datote Vos, jhr sollet geben. Daranno coloro, danto illi, sie solten geben.

units.la: Nos dedissemus, wir solten.Vos dedissetis, ihr soltet.Illi dedissent, sie solten haben gegeben.Vel sic. Oder also. O che io hauerei & haueria. } dato, Che tu haueresti, } Colui hauerebbe & haueria.
units.tr: We should have given, you should have given, they should have given. Or thus. Oh that I would have and would have; that thou wouldst have, he would have and would have given.

units.la: O daß ich, du, er, hätte, hättest gegeben.Che noi haueremmo,Che voi hauereste, } dato.Coloro hauerebbono, & haueriano, }Daß wir hätten, }Daß ihr hättet, } gegeben.Daß sie hätten, }
units.tr: Oh that I, thou, he might have, mightest have given. That we might have, that you might have, that they might have given.

units.la: Futurum.

units.tr: I shall have, you will have, he will have, we shall have, you will have, they will have: when I shall have given, you will have given, he will have given, we shall have given, you will have given, they will have given.

units.la: Wann ich werd, du wirst, er wird, wir werden, ihr werdet, sie werden haben gegeben.
units.tr: That I shall have given, you will have given, he will have given, we shall have given, you will have given, they will have given.
