units.la: DE PRÆTERITORVM FORMATIONE.
units.tr: ON THE FORMATION OF THE PRETERITES.

units.la: IN praeteritorum formandorum ratione, quod maius quidam in sit negotium, quam in caeterorum temporum.
units.tr: In the method of forming the preterites there is somewhat more difficulty than with the other tenses.

units.la: Weil in der arth vnd weise die praeterita zumachen, die sach etwas schwerer fållet, als bey denen andern temporibus.
units.tr: In the manner of forming the praeterita, the matter is somewhat harder than with the other tempora.

units.la: Idcirco de ea aliquid breuiter attingam. Als will ich dieselbe mit kurzem etwas berühren.
units.tr: Therefore I will touch on it briefly here.

units.la: Omnia itaque praeterita perfecta, indicatiui modi verborum, primæ Conjugationis, desinunt in Ai, vt
units.tr: Accordingly, all perfect preterites of the indicative mood of first-conjugation verbs end in Ai, as

units.la: Gehen derowegen alle perfecta, im indicatiuo modo, der ersten Conjugation, gehen auff Ai, auß, als, amäi, io amai, ich hab geliebt, ex verb. amo, vom lieben, Cantai, ich hab gesungen, ex verbo Canto, auß dem Wort, ich fing, idem, parlai, ich hab geredt, ex verbo parlo, ich red, idem mangiai, ex verbo mangio, ich esse, & pagai, ich hab bezahlt, auß dem Wort pago, pagare, ich zahl, zahlen, außzahlen.
units.tr: Accordingly, all perfects in the indicative mood of the first conjugation end in Ai, as amäi, io amai, I have loved, from the verb amo, to love; Cantai, I have sung, from the verb Canto, I sing; idem, parlai, I have spoken, from the verb parlo, I speak; idem mangiai, from the verb mangio, I eat; and pagai, I have paid, from the word pago, pagare, I pay, to pay, to pay out.

units.la: Excl. {Excipiuntur tamen quædam verba monosyllaba ita : in præsenti.
units.tr: Excl. {Some monosyllabic verbs are, however, excepted, as follows, in the present:

units.la: Doch werden etliche verba außgenommen, die in præsenti nur eine Sylben haben, als, sto, ich stehe, hat im præterito & steti, ich bin gestanden.
units.tr: Some verbs are excepted, however, which have only one syllable in the present, such as sto, I stand, which has steti in the preterite, I have stood.

units.la: Item Do, habet, dei & dedi, diedi, ich hab gegeben.
units.tr: Likewise do, has, dei & dedi, diedi, I have given.

units.la: Item fo, velfacio, habet io fei, feci, ich hab gethan, hab gemacht, &c.
units.tr: Likewise fo, vel facio, habet io fei, feci, I have done, I have made, etc.

units.la: Secunda autem Conjugationis omnia verba, quæ habent C. tantum propriam & peculiarem literam, mittunt præterita in cqui.
units.tr: Moreover, all verbs of the second conjugation which have C. as their own and peculiar letter only, form their preterites in cqui.

units.la: Die verba aber in der andern Conjugation, welche ein C. als ihren eigenen vnd abfonderlichen Buchstaben haben, machen ihre perfecta auff ein cqui. Als ex placcio, placqui, ich hab gefallen, in prima persona singulari, vnd in tertia persona, placque, er hat gefallen.
units.tr: The verbs of the second conjugation, however, which have a C. as their own and distinctive letter, form their perfects in cqui. Thus ex placcio, placqui, I have pleased, in the first person singular, and in the third person, placque, he has pleased.

units.la: Also auch auß taccio, tacqui, tacque, ich hab, er hat geschwigen, vnd auß giaccio, giacqui, giacque, ich bin gelegen, er ist gelegen.
units.tr: So also from taccio: tacqui, tacque, I have, he has, kept silent; and from giaccio: giacqui, giacque, I have lain, he has lain.

units.la: Quæ verba habent I. in præsenti, addunt in præterito, S. quomodo ex vaglio.
units.tr: Those verbs which have I. in the present add S. in the preterite, as from vaglio.

units.la: Die aber in præsenti ein I. haben, die thun im perfecto ein S. darzu, als auß vaglio, wird valsi, ich wanne das Korn, (vagliare, wannen.)
units.tr: Those which have an I. in the present add an S. in the perfect; thus from vaglio comes valsi, I winnow the corn (vagliare, to winnow).

units.la: N
units.tr: N

units.la: Item ex doglio, dolfi, ich bin fchmertzhafft, übel auff, voglio, hat, volfi, bey den Poeten, ich hab gewolt, aber in profa hat diß volli. Quan- quam libentius vel in ipsa soluta Oratione, priorem vocem ego vsurparem. Wiewol ich lieber, auch in einer vngebundnen Rede, das erste Wort gebrauchen wolt, vt minus, meo quidem judicio, affectatam, welches meinem Verstand nach, nit also rühmlichtig scheinet.
units.tr: Likewise from doglio, dolfi, I am in pain, I am unwell; voglio has volfi, I have wished, among the poets; but in prose it has volli. Although I would more willingly use the former word even in unbound prose, as, in my judgement, less affected, which, as far as my understanding goes, does not seem so praiseworthy.

units.la: Rursus quædam eandem propriam & peculiaʒ rem conduplicant literam. Hinwiderumb, machen vnd doppeln etliche verba jhren eignen Buchstaben, Als da ift, Caddi, ex cado, ich falle, welcher gleiches hat im perfecto, cadei & cadet-ri, ich bin gefallen, widerumb auß tango wird tetigi, ich hab gehalten, auß teno wird tetini, ich hab getruncken.
units.tr: Conversely, some verbs double their own peculiar letter. Conversely, some verbs double their own letter: thus Caddi, from cado, I fall, which has the same form in the perfect, cadei & cadetti, I have fallen. Again, from tango comes tetigi, I have touched; from teno comes tetini, I have held.

units.la: Veruntamen verbum SO. iedoch hat das verbum SO. Seppi, ich hab gewußt, Ho hat hebbi, ich hab gehabt, vnd Godo, hat godei, godetti, ich hab genossen. Posso hat im Perfecto potei, poterti, ich hab gekondt, vnd veggo, oder veggio, hat vidi, viddi, ich hab gesehen, also proveggo, providi, ich hab fürgesehen, vnd paio, hat parui & parpi, es hat bedeucht, oder bedüncket.
units.tr: Nevertheless the verb SO: the verb SO has Seppi, I have known; Ho has hebbi, I have had; and Godo has godei, godetti, I have enjoyed. Posso has potei, poterti in the perfect, I have been able; and veggo, or veggio, has vidi, viddi, I have seen; likewise proveggo, providi, I have foreseen; and paio has parui and parpi, it has seemed.

units.la: Caterum de preteritis tertia Conjugationis, ea erit Regula, Derogleichen ist von denen verbis der dritten Conjugation, dise Regul zumercken.
units.tr: Moreover, concerning the preterites of the third conjugation, this will be the rule. Likewise, concerning the verbs of the third conjugation, the following rule is to be noted.

units.la: Vt quorum participia praeteriti temporis Significationis, passiua in vto, terminantur, praeterita definant in ei, & inetti.
units.tr: Those whose passive participles of the past tense end in -uto have their preterites end in -ei and -etti.

units.la: Daß welcher participia passiua perfecti temporis, auff ein Vto außgehen, derselben perfecta sich auff ein ei, vnd etti enden.
units.tr: Those whose passive participles of the perfect tense end in -uto have their perfects end in -ei and -etti.

units.la: Quocirca verbum perdo, cum habeat in participio perduto, habet in praeterito, perdei & perdetti, Derowegen, weil das Verbum perdo, im participio perduto hat, so hat es im perfecto, perdei & perdetti, ich hab verlohren.
units.tr: Hence the verb perdo, since it has perduto in the participle, has perdei and perdetti in the preterite. Therefore, since the verb perdo has perduto in the participle, it has perdei and perdetti in the perfect, I have lost.

units.la: Compio habet in perfecti. compiuto, compietti, ic hab erfüllt, Riceuo, hat riceuuto, riceuei, & riceuetti, ich hab empfangen.
units.tr: Compio has compiuto, compietti in the perfect, I have completed; Riceuo has riceuuto, riceuei, and riceuetti, I have received.

units.la: Verbum autem concedo, habet conceduto, in profa & concessio, in versu, quo ad participium.
units.tr: The verb concedo, however, has conceduto in prose, and concessio in verse, as regards the participle.

units.la: Das Verbum concedo aber, hat conceduto, in der vngebundenen Red, vnd concessio in den Versen, derwegen hat es im perfecto im praeterito, hat es concedei, concedetti, & concessi, ich hab erlaubt, hab zugelassen. Ferner mordo, hat morduto, vel morso, gebissen, in participio, in praeterito hat es mordei, mordetti & morsi, ich hab gebissen.
units.tr: The verb concedo, however, has conceduto in unbound prose, and concessio in verse; therefore in the perfect, in the preterite, it has concedei, concedetti, and concessi, I have permitted, I have allowed. Further, mordo has morduto or morso, bitten, in the participle; in the preterite it has mordei, mordetti and morsi, I have bitten.

units.la: Sed conosco tametsi in participio habeat conosciutos, nihilominus in praeterito habet cognobi. Aber Conosco, ob gleich dasselbe im participio hat Conosciuto, hat es doch nichts destoweniger im perfecto connobi, ich hab erkandt, oder hab gekandt.
units.tr: But conosco, although in the participle it has conosciuto, nevertheless in the preterite it has connobi. But Conosco, although it has conosciuto in the participle, nonetheless has connobi in the perfect, I have known, or I have recognised.

units.la: Porro eiusdem Conjugationis verba, quando in participio habent duplex T. in praeterito habent item dem S. duplex.
units.tr: Further, verbs of the same conjugation which have a double T. in the participle likewise have a double S. in the preterite.

units.la: Ferner die Verba, in vorgemelter Conjugation, wenn sie in participio, ein zweyfaches T. haben, so haben sie im perfecto ebenmäßig ein doppelt S. als Leggo, ist Letto, und im prater. Lessi, ich hab gelesen, Exscriuo, ist scritto, in prater. scrissi, ich hab geschriben, ex eleggo kombt eletto, und im praeterit. elessi, ich hab erwöhlt.
units.tr: Further, verbs of the aforementioned conjugation which have a double T. in the participle likewise have a double S. in the perfect: thus Leggo makes letto, and in the preterite lessi, I have read; Exscriuo makes scritto, in the preterite scrissi, I have written; from eleggo comes eletto, and in the preterite elessi, I have chosen.

units.la: Excipitur stringo, quod habet quidem in participio stretto, sed in praeterito strinsi.
units.tr: Stringo is an exception, which indeed has stretto in the participle, but strinsi in the preterite.

units.la: Stringo wird ausgenommen, das hat zwar im participio stretto, aber im perfecto strinsi.
units.tr: Stringo is an exception: it has stretto in the participle, but strinsi in the perfect.

units.la: Quomodo etiam se habent eius composita, astringo, & constringo.
units.tr: So too its compounds, astringo and constringo, behave in the same way.

units.la: Vnd also gehen auch dessen Composita astringo, ich bind an, zieh an, und constringo, ich zieh zusammen.
units.tr: And so likewise its compounds astringo, I bind up, draw tight, and constringo, I draw together.

units.la: Quanquam id euenire arbitror, vel ex eo, quod in participio esset, dicendum, stringo. Wiewol ich meine, daß dises geschehe darumb, dieweil man im participio sagen soll, stringo.
units.tr: Although I think this happens because in the participle one must say stringo. Although I think this happens because in the participle one must say stringo.

units.la: Si quis rationem potius, quam vsum lingua spe-
units.tr: If anyone regards reason rather than the usage of the language

units.la: ctaret, Wenn einer mehr auff die Vrsach, als auff den gebrauch der Sprachen sehen wolte.
units.tr: (looks to it): if anyone wishes to look to the reason rather than the usage of the language.

units.la: Vel quod praeteritum latinum habet strinxi, unde deriuati videtur strinsi.
units.tr: Or because the Latin preterite has strinxi, from which strinsi seems to be derived.

units.la: Oder weil das Lateinische praeteritum hat strinxi, von welchem strinsi scheinet herkommen, ist
units.tr: Or because the Latin preterite has strinxi, from which strinsi seems to derive, is

units.la: alfo vom Lateinifchen ftrinxi, ftrinfi, ich hab hart zufamen gezogen, wie auch auß pinxi, pinfi, ich hab abgemahlet, ex cinxi, cinfi, ich hab gegurtet, ex finxi, finfi, ich hab ertticht, explanxi, planfi, ich hab gewont, vnd von extinxi, eftinfi, ich hab außgelöfcht.
units.tr: thus from the Latin strinxi, strinsi, I have drawn tight; likewise from pinxi, pinsi, I have painted; from cinxi, cinsi, I have girded; from finxi, finsi, I have feigned; explanxi, plansi, I have smoothed; and from extinxi, estinsi, I have extinguished.

units.la: Endtlich kombt vom Wort Ardo, arfi, vnd in participio arfi, ich hab gebrendt, ferner in praeterito. Rido hat rifo, & rifi, ich hab gelacht, Idem toglio hat tolto, tolfi, ich hab weg genommen, vnd muouo hat moffo, moffi, ich hab bewögt.
units.tr: Finally, from the word Ardo, arsi, and in the participle arso, I have burnt; further in the preterite. Rido has riso and risi, I have laughed; likewise toglio has tolto, tolsi, I have taken away; and muouo has mosso, mossi, I have moved.

units.la: Offendo hat offefo, offefi, & offefero, inpl. ich, fie, hab, haben beleidigt, Spargo, hat fparfo, fparfero, ich, fie, hab, haben außgeftreuet, außgegoffen.
units.tr: Offendo has offeso, offesi, and offesero, pl.: I, she, have, they have, offended; Spargo has sparso, sparsero: I, she, have, they have, scattered, poured out.

units.la: Widerumb metto hat meffo, mifi, mifero, &c. ich, fie, hab, haben hingelegt, hingeftellt, wie in gleichem pongo hat pofto, pofi, pofe, pofero, ich hab hingeftellt, er, fie, hat, haben hingefetzt.
units.tr: Again, metto has messo, misi, misero, etc.: I, she, have, they have, laid down, set out; in the same way pongo has posto, posi, pose, posero: I have set out, he, she, has, they have, set down.

units.la: Ferner nafco hat nato, nacqui, nacquero, ich, fie, bin, fie feyn geboren, gewachfen, nuoco, hat nociuto, nocqui, nocquero, ich, fie, hab, haben, gefchädigt, Sono, futo, fui, ich bin, bin gewefen.
units.tr: Further, nasco has nato, nacqui, nacquero: I, she, am, they are born, grown; nuoco has nociuto, nocqui, nocquero: I, she, have, they have harmed; sono, futo, fui: I am, I have been.

units.la: Rompo hat rotto, ruppi, ruppe, ruppero, ich, er, fie, hab, hat, haben zubrochen.
units.tr: Rompo has rotto, ruppi, ruppe, ruppero: I, he, she, have, has, they have broken to pieces.

units.la: Piouo, hat piouuto, & piouui, hat geregnet, Dinido, hat dinifo, dinifi, dinifero, ich, fie hab, haben zertheilt.
units.tr: Piouo has piouuto and piouui: it has rained. Dinido has dinifo, dinifi, dinifero: I, she have, they have divided.

units.la: Vccido, hat vccifo, & vccifi, vccife, vccifero, &c. ich hab, er hat, fie haben getödt. Spendo hat fpefo, & fpefi, ich hab aufgelegt, aufgezahlt.
units.tr: Vccido has vccifo, and vccifi, vccife, vccifero, etc.: I have, he has, they have killed. Spendo has spefo and spefi: I have laid out, I have paid out.

units.la: Postremo, verba quarta Conjugationis, habent praeterita definentia in I. simplex cum accentu, ut vdi, fenti, &c.
units.tr: Finally, the verbs of the fourth conjugation have their preterites ending in a simple I with the accent, such as vdi, fenti, etc.

units.la: Endtlich haben die verba in der vierdten Conjugation, ihre perfecta, die außgehn auff ein einfaches I. mit dem Accent, als vdi, fenti, haben pfunden, ich, er hab, hat gehört, effi vdi-rono, sie haben gehört, ex verbis oдa & fento, ich empfinde, atque nonnunquam ut in soluta Oratione, habent I. duplex, ut,
units.tr: Finally, the verbs in the fourth conjugation have their perfects, which end in a simple I with the accent, such as vdi and fenti: to have found, I, he has, has heard; essi vdi-rono, they have heard; from the verbs odo and sento, I perceive; atque nonnunquam ut in soluta Oratione, they have a double I, such as

units.la: Auch bisweilen, als in denen ungebundenen Reden, haben sie ein doppelt I. als vdy, fenty, ich hab gehört, ich hab empfunden, hab vermerckt. At dico, ich sage, das hat im prat.perf. diffi, ich hab gesagt, vnd offero, hat offerfi, ich hab erbotten, vengo, hat venni, & vennero, ich bin, sie seyn kommen.
units.tr: Sometimes too, as in prose, they have a double I, such as vdy and fenty: I have heard, I have perceived, have noticed. At dico, I say: its preterite is diffi, I have said; and offero has offerfi, I have offered; vengo has venni and vennero: I am, they are come.

units.la: DE PARTICVLIS, QVÆ VERBIS AFFIGI SOLENT.
units.tr: On the particles which are usually attached to verbs.

units.la: Von denen Stückvvörtlein, so man andern Wörtern anhengt.
units.tr: On the little particles which one appends to other words.

units.la: Hæ quidem sunt, mi, ci, si, ci, ne, vi, quæ quanta cum Elegantia verbis adhæreant, ac cuiusmodi sit earum significatio, ex ijs, quæ de eade earum vsu, dicentur liquida apparebit. Dise seynd, mi, ti, si, ci, ne, vi, welche mit was für Zierd sie den verbis anhengen, vnd was jhre bedeutung sey, wird auß disem, so von derselben Nutz gesaget wird, Sonnenklar erhellen.
units.tr: These indeed are mi, ti, si, ci, ne, vi, and how much elegance they lend when attached to verbs, and what their meaning is, will become clear from what is said below about their use. These are mi, ti, si, ci, ne, vi. With what kind of ornament they are attached to the verbs, and what their meaning is, will become clear as day from what is said about their use.

units.la: DE VSV HARVM PARTICVLARVM.
units.tr: ON THE USE OF THESE PARTICLES.

units.la: Von dem Gebrauch difer Stückwörtlein.
units.tr: On the use of these little particles.

units.la: PRimum solent praeponi ac postponi verbis, ut, Erstlich werden sie den verbis vor vnd nach gesetzt, als mi ama, amami, ti ama, amati, si ama, amasi, ci ama, amaci, ne ama, amane, vi ama, amaui.
units.tr: First they are usually placed before and after verbs, as First they are set before and after the verbs, as mi ama, amami, ti ama, amati, si ama, amasi, ci ama, amaci, ne ama, amane, vi ama, amaui.

units.la: Verum id judicio fieri debet, cum non semper, neque vbique deceat. Aber dises muß mit Verstand geschehen, weil es nicht allezeit, vnd überall wol stehet oder geziemet.
units.tr: But this must be done with judgment, since it is not always or everywhere fitting. But this must be done with discretion, because it is not always or everywhere becoming or proper.

units.la: Nam affectata erit minus haec Oratio. Dann dise Rede scheinet weniger Ehrfichtig, wann ich sag; che ti disse colui, quam che disseti colui, als, was hat er dir gesagt, quid ille tibi dixit.
units.tr: For this way of speaking will be less elegant: For this manner of speech seems less dignified when I say che ti disse colui, as quid ille tibi dixit. "What did he say to you?"

units.la: Item minus affectate dixerimus. Item, weniger übel gedencklich sagen wir also, se tu mi
units.tr: We would say this less awkwardly: Less awkwardly we say it thus: se tu mi

units.la: ami, non ti nuocerá, Als wann wir sagen, sé ami- mi, non nuocerátti, si me amas, haud tibi nocebit, so du mich liebeft, wird dir es nit schaden.
units.tr: As when we say, "if you love me, it will not harm you," so you love me, it will not hurt you.

units.la: Sed huiusmodi Iudicium traditis præceptis vix ac ne vix, quidem doceri potest.
units.tr: But such judgment can hardly, if at all, be taught by fixed rules.

units.la: Aber ein dergleichen Vrtheil oder Verstånd- nuß, kan durch gegebene Lehrgebott, kům- merlich gelehrt werden.
units.tr: But such judgment and understanding can hardly be taught by given rules.

units.la: Quandoquidem ex frequenti Auctorum Lectio- ne & Consuetudine Linguæ debeat comparari.
units.tr: Since it must be acquired from frequent reading of authors and from the everyday use of the language.

units.la: Alldieweil solches durch stettige lesung der gelehrten Bücher, vnd täglicher übung der Sprach, muß erlanget werden.
units.tr: Since this must be acquired by constant reading of learned books and daily practice of the language.

units.la: Et proinde scendum, has particulas, quoties verbum sequuntur, pendere ab ipsius verbi accentu, ac si una esset dictio.
units.tr: And therefore it must be known that these particles, whenever they follow a verb, depend on the stress of that verb, as if they were one word.

units.la: Ferner ist zuwissen, daß dise Stückwörtlein, so offt sie auff ein verbum folgen, an deß verbi seinem accent hange, als wäre es ein Wort, als, Amami, er liebet mich, amati, er liebet dich, amaßi, man liebet, man lieb, amaci, er liebet vns, amane, er liebet doch, er liebt je, amaui, er liebt euch, er lieb euch.
units.tr: Further, it must be known that these little particles, whenever they follow a verb, depend on the accent of the verb, as if it were one word: Amami, he loves me; amati, he loves you; amasi, one loves, one loves; amaci, he loves us; amane, he does love, he surely loves; amaui, he loves you (plural).

units.la: Duplicantur insuper Consonantes M. quando postponuntur verbis habentibus accentum in po- strema, ut,
units.tr: Moreover, the consonant M is doubled when it is placed after verbs having the stress on the last syllable, as

units.la: Die Consonantes M. werden auch gedoppelt, wann sie denen verbis nachgesetzt werden, so den Accent in der letzten Sylben haben, als, Ammm.
units.tr: The consonant M is also doubled when placed after the verbs that have the accent on the last syllable, as Ammm.

units.la: Amòmmi, ammòtti, amòffi, amòcci, ammòne, am-mònui, er hat mich geliebt, er hat dich geliebt, man hat geliebt, hat vns geliebt, er hat je geliebt, er hat euch geliebt, so alle auß dem praeterito amò (amauit) herkommen. Deßgleichen auß dem futuro, amerà, amabit, er wird lieben, seynd diese nachfolgenden.
units.tr: Amòmmi, ammòtti, amòffi, amòcci, ammòne, ammònui: he has loved me, he has loved you, one has loved, he has loved us, he has surely loved, he has loved you (plural), all of which come from the preterite amò (amauit). Likewise from the future, amerà (amabit, he will love), the following are formed.

units.la: Amerämmi, er wird mich lieben, amerätti, er wird dich lieben, ameràffi, man wird lieben, oder er wird sich lieben, ameràcci, er wird vns lieben, ameránne, er wird ja lieben, wird wol lieben, & amerául, wird euch lieben.
units.tr: Amerämmi, he will love me; amerätti, he will love you; ameràffi, one will love, or he will love himself; ameràcci, he will love us; ameránne, he will certainly love, will surely love; and amerául, will love you (plural).

units.la: Præterea MI, TI, SI, semper retinent literam I, cum adhærent verbo.
units.tr: Moreover, MI, TI, SI always retain the letter I when they are attached to a verb.

units.la: Ferner so behalten MI, TI, vnd SI, allezeit den Buchstaben I, wan sie dem verbo anhangen.
units.tr: Further, MI, TI and SI always retain the letter I when they are attached to the verb.

units.la: Nulla alia interpofita voce. Vnd kein ander Wort darzwischen gesetzt ist. Quod ex jam ad-ductis exemplis liquet. Welches auß jetzt eingeführten Exempeln klärlich erscheinet.
units.tr: When no other word is inserted between them. And no other word is placed between them. This is clear from the examples already given. Which is plain from the examples already brought forward.

units.la: Quod si aliqua alia vox intercesserit, mutant I, in E, cuius rei exemplum erit.
units.tr: But if some other word comes between, they change I into E, of which the following will be an example.

units.la: Wann aber ein anders Wort darzwischen kömbt, so verwandelen sie jhr I, in ein E. als dessen ein Exempel seyn wird.
units.tr: But if another word comes between, they change their I into an E, of which the following will be an example.

units.la: Me non batte sti tu, Me quidem tu haud verbe-rasti. Du hast mich zwar nit geschlagen.
units.tr: Me non batte sti tu, Me quidem tu haud verberasti. You have indeed not struck me.

units.la: Quanquam id accidere videtur, quoque ex comparatione personarum, Wiewol difes gleichsamb herkomen seyn scheinet, auß vergleichung der Personen, unde dicimus, Dahero sagen wir.
units.tr: Although this seems to arise also from the comparison of persons, Although this seems to arise from the comparison of persons, whence we say, hence we say:

units.la: Tu conosci me & Lui, Tu me & illum nosti, Du kennest mich vnd jhn.
units.tr: Tu conosci me & Lui, Tu me & illum nosti, You know me and him.

units.la: Item, Tu vedi me, & io veggo te, Tu vides me, & ego video te. Du sihest mich, vnd ich sihe dich.
units.tr: Likewise, Tu vedi me, & io veggo te, Tu vides me, & ego video te. You see me, and I see you.

units.la: Tu feristi me, e quella non tocasti, me quidem percussisti, illum vero haud tetigisti. Mich hast du wol geschlagen, aber jhn nicht angerührt.
units.tr: You have indeed struck me, but you have not touched him.

units.la: Eodem pariter modo se habent,ha particula, quando eas sequitur, Verbum infinitivi modi. Eben also verhalten sich die Stuckwörtlein, wenn auff sie folget ein Verbum, so infinitivi modi ist.
units.tr: In exactly the same way these particles behave when a verb of the infinitive mood follows them. In exactly the same way the little particles behave when a verb follows them that is in the infinitive mood.

units.la: Dicamus enim, Denn wir sagen.
units.tr: For we say, For we say:

units.la: Ragionasi me habere presomoglie, Die Leuthe geben vor, ich habe ein Weib genommen.
units.tr: Ragionasi me habere presomoglie, People pretend that I have taken a wife.

units.la: Dicitant, me duxisse Vxorem.
units.tr: Dicitant, me duxisse Vxorem.

units.la: Item Corre fama, me esser inamorato, Es gehet die sag, ich hab mich verliebt.
units.tr: Likewise, Corre fama, me esser inamorato, It is rumoured that I have fallen in love.

units.la: Rumor est, me amare.
units.tr: Rumor est, me amare.

units.la: Verum ha tamen Orationis ita rectius efferentur. Aber difes Sprüche werden vil bösser also außgeredt. Ragionāsi che io ho preso moglie, & corre fama, che io sono inamarato.
units.tr: But these sayings are rendered much better thus. But these expressions are much better rendered thus: Ragionāsi che io ho preso moglie, & corre fama, che io sono inamarato.

units.la: Postremo mutant I, in E, quando eas præcedit Aduerbium come, hoc modo.
units.tr: Lastly, they change I into E when the adverb come precedes them, in this way.

units.la: Endtlichen verwechseln sie jhre I, in ein E, wenn vor jhnen ein Adverbium hergehet, als auff dise weise.
units.tr: Lastly, they change their I into an E when an adverb precedes them, in this manner.

units.la: Io non sono àuaro come tè,
units.tr: Io non sono àuaro come tè,

units.la: Ich bin nicht geitzig, wie du.
units.tr: I am not stingy, like you.

units.la: Non sum auarus, vt tu.
units.tr: Non sum auarus, vt tu.

units.la: Item tu non sei liberale, come me.
units.tr: Likewise, tu non sei liberale, come me.

units.la: Du bist nicht freygebig, wie ich.
units.tr: You are not generous, like me.

units.la: Non es liberalis, vt ego.
units.tr: Non es liberalis, vt ego.

units.la: Quantum vero spectat ad earum significationem, was aber jhre bedeutung anbetrifft, ex typis non subiiciendis perspicue ostendetur, wird auß denen bald nachfolgenden Figuren klärlich zuersehen seyn.
units.tr: As for their meaning, it will be clearly shown from the figures that follow shortly, As for their meaning, it will be made plain from the figures that follow.

units.la: Vna cum vsu earundem, vt ex eo per sequendo non recedamus. Vnd zugleich der gebrauch derselbigen, damit wir von demselben nicht abweichen mögen.
units.tr: Together with their use, so that we may not depart from it by following it. Together with their use, so that we may not stray from it.

units.la: MI,
units.tr: MI,

units.la: (Me,) mi batte, vel battemi, er hat mich geschlagen, verberauit me, (mihi,) mi diede, & diedem, er hat mir geben (dedit mihi,)
units.tr: (Me,) mi batte, or battemi, he has struck me, he struck me, (to me,) mi diede, and diedem, he has given to me (he gave me,)

units.la: TI.
units.tr: TI.

units.la: (Te,) ti batte, & battetti, er hât dich gefchlâ-gen, (verberauit te,) (tibi.) ti diede & ti detti, er hat dir gegeben, (dedit tibi.)
units.tr: (You,) ti batte, & battetti, he has struck you, (he has beaten you,) (to you.) ti diede & ti detti, he has given you, (he has given to you.)

units.la: SI.
units.tr: SI.

units.la: (Se,) fi vccife & vccifefi, er hât fich getödt, (se interemit,) (sibi.) fi diede & diedefi la morte, er hat jhm felbst den Todt gegeben, (sibi mortem consciuit.)
units.tr: (Himself,) he killed himself and killed himself, he has done himself to death, (he slew himself,) (to himself.) he gave and gave himself death, he has given himself death, (he brought death upon himself.)

units.la: CI.
units.tr: CI.

units.la: (Nos,) ci percosse, & percosseci, er hât vns ge-schlagen, (nos percussit,) (nobis,) ci diede, & diedeci, er hat vns gegeben, (dedit nobis.)
units.tr: Us, ci percosse, & percosseci, he has struck us, (he struck us,) (to us,) ci diede, & diedeci, he has given us, (he gave us.)

units.la: (Illic & Illuc) ci fu, fucci, dort, dorten ist er gewefen, (illic fuit,) Item ci ando, andocci, er ist dort hin gangen, (iuit illuc.)
units.tr: (There & Thither) ci fu, fucci, there, he has been there, (he was there,) Likewise ci ando, andocci, he has gone there, (he went there.)

units.la: Illud tamen hic animadvertendum est, ‹das parti-culas nonnunquam poni in Oratione ornatus gratia dumtaxat, vt: Iedoch ist difes hier zumerčken, daß gedachte Wörtlein, bißweilen in einer Rede nur zur Zier gebraucht werden, als,
units.tr: Illud tamen hic animadvertendum est, that these particles are sometimes used in speech merely for ornament, as: However, it should be noted here that these little words are sometimes used in a speech merely for decoration, as:

units.la: (Ac Boccatius ita est locutus,) vnd der Boccatius hat also geredt, Natural cosa e' di ciascunò che ci nasce, pro che nasce.
units.tr: (And Boccaccio has spoken thus,) and Boccaccio has spoken thus: Natural cosa e' di ciascunò che ci nasce, for che nasce.

units.la: Es ist einem jeglichen natürlich, daß er geboren wirdt.
units.tr: It is natural to everyone that he is born.

units.la: NE.
units.tr: NE.

units.la: (Nos) ne abbraccio, abbracciònne, er hat vns umbfangen, oder gehalset, oder vns gekūßt, (osculatus est nos) (nobis) ne diede, diedene, er hat vns geben, (dedit nobis.)
units.tr: (Us) ne abbraccio, abbracciònne, he has embraced us, or hugged us, or kissed us, (he kissed us) (to us) ne diede, diedene, he has given us, (he gave us.)

units.la: VI.
units.tr: VI.

units.la: (Vos) vi percoffe, perroffeni, er hat euch geschlagen, (vos percussit,) (vobis) vi diede, diedeni, er hat euch gegeben, (dedit vobis.)
units.tr: (You) vi percoffe, perroffeni, he has struck you, (he has struck you,) (to you) vi diede, diedeni, he has given you, (he has given you.)

units.la: (Illic vel Illuc,) vi fu, funi, er ist dort gewesen, (illic fuit.) Item vi ando, andouui, er ist dort hin gängen, (init illuc.)
units.tr: (Illic or Illuc) vi fu, funi, he has been there, (he was there). Item vi ando, andouui, he has gone there, (he went there).

units.la: Porrò hæ particulæ invicem connectuntur, & ita non raro Orationem ingrediuntur haud mediocri cum Elegantia.
units.tr: These particles are further joined to one another, and so they often enter a sentence with no little elegance.

units.la: Ferner dise Wörtlein, auff eine andere arth gesetzt, vnd zieren sie der gestalt, eine angehende Red zum öfftern.
units.tr: Furthermore, these little words, when placed in another way, thus often adorn the opening of a speech.

units.la: Quod quomodo fiat, ex typis infra positis facilime intelligetur, welches, wie es geschehen kan, man auß den nachfolgenden leichtlichen zuersehen hat.
units.tr: How this is done can be understood most easily from the examples set out below, as one may see from the following.

units.la: MI, TI.
units.tr: MI, TI.

units.la: (Me tibi) lo miti raccomando, & raccommandomiti
units.tr: (Me tibi) lo miti raccomando, & raccommandomiti

units.la: Ich befehl mich dir, (me tibi commendo) (mihi te) tu mi ti raccomandasti.
units.tr: I commend myself to you (me tibi commendo) (mihi te) you commended me to yourself.

units.la: (Mihi te commendasti,) du hast mich dir befohlen.
units.tr: (Mihi te commendasti,) you have commended me to yourself.

units.la: MI, SI,
units.tr: MI, SI,

units.la: (Me sibi) Egli mi si elesse, elessemissi, per grandiss. amico. Er hat mich jhm zum sonderbaren Freunde außerkoren, (Is me sibi amicum summum elegit.)
units.tr: (Me sibi) He chose himself for me, chose himself for me, as a most distinguished friend. He has chosen me for his special friend (He chose me as his greatest friend.)

units.la: (Mihi se.) Egli mi si raccomando, & raccomandomisi, Er hat sich mir anbefohlen, Is mihi se commendauit.
units.tr: (Mihi se.) He commended himself to me, and commended himself to me, He has commended himself to me (He commended himself to me.)

units.la: MI, CI,
units.tr: MI, CI,

units.la: (Me illic.) mi ci fermai, fermaimici due giorni, Daselbst bin ich zwene Tage geblieben, (biduum illic mansi.)
units.tr: (Me illic.) I stayed there, I stayed there two days; (Daselbst bin ich zwene Tage geblieben) (I stayed there for two days.)

units.la: Item also, Mi ci fe andare, er schaffte mir dorthin zugehen, (curauit ut illuc irem.)
units.tr: Likewise, "He had me taken there": he saw to it that I went there. (He arranged for me to go there.)

units.la: (Mihi illic.) Mi ci diede, diedemici moglie, er hat mir alldorten ein Weib gegeben, (Illic mihi Vxorem dedit.)
units.tr: (Mihi illic.) "He gave me a wife there": he gave me a wife there. (There he gave me a wife.)

units.la: MI, VI,
units.tr: MI, VI,

units.la: (Me vobis.) Io mi vi raccomando, raccomandomi domini, Ich befelch mich euch, (me vobis commendo.)
units.tr: (Me vobis.) Io mi vi raccomando, raccomandomi domini, I commend myself to you, (I commend myself to you.)

units.la: (Mihi vos,) voi mi vi raccomandaste, vel raccomandastemini, jhr habet mich euch anbefohlen, (mihi vos commendastis.)
units.tr: (Mihi vos,) voi mi vi raccomandaste, vel raccomandastemini, you have commended me to you, (you have commended yourselves to me.)

units.la: Illic, vel illuc: mi vi vesti, & vestimmi, er hat mich dasselbst gekleidt, (illic me vestiuit,) (mihi illic,) miui meno, & menomiui, (me illuc duxit,) er hat mich dorthin geführt.
units.tr: Illic, vel illuc: mi vi vesti, & vestimmi, he has clothed me there, (he clothed me there,) (there, to me,) miui meno, & menomiui, (he led me thither,) he has led me thither.

units.la: Idem, miui compro, o compromoui vngi ardino, er hat mir dasselbst einen Garten gekaufft. (hortum mihi illic emit.)
units.tr: Idem, miui compro, o compromoui vngi ardino, he has bought me a garden there. (he bought a garden for me there.)

units.la: TI, CI,
units.tr: TI, CI,

units.la: (Te nobis,) Dio ti, ci, diede ouer diedetici per padre, Gott hat dich vns zum Vatter gegeben. (Deus te nobis patrem dedit.) (Te nos) Dio tici diede ouero diedeciti per Compagni. (Deus tibi nos socios dedit.) Gott hat vns dir zu Gesellen geben. (Te illic, vel illuc,) Io ti ci viddi, viditici, Ich hab dich dort gesehen. (ego te illic vidi.) Io ti ci menai, menattici, ich hab dich dort hinge führt, (ego te illuc duxi,)
units.tr: (You to us,) God has given you to us, or given you to us, as father, God has given you to us as father. (God has given you to us as father.) (You to us,) God has given you, or given us to you, as companions, God has given us to you as companions. (God has given us to you as companions.) (You there, or thither,) I have seen you there, or seen you there, I saw you there. (I saw you there.) I have led you there, or led you thither, I led you there (I led you thither).

units.la: (Tibi illic, vel illuc,) Iddio ti ci diede moglie, ouer dietetici moglie. Gott hat dir dort eine Fraw gegeben. (Deus tibi illic vxorem dedit.)
units.tr: (To you there, or thither,) God has given you a wife there, or given you a wife there, God has given you a wife there. (God has given you a wife there.)

units.la: TI, SI,
units.tr: TI, SI,

units.la: (Te sibi,) Dio ti si elefe, & elesseti per figliuolo. Gott hat dich jhm zu einem Sohne erwöhlet. (Deus te sibi filium elegit.)
units.tr: (You to himself,) God has chosen you for himself, and chosen you as a son. God has chosen you as a son for himself. (God chose you for himself as a son.)

units.la: (Tibi se,!) Egli ti si raccomanda, o raccomandatisi. Er befilcht sich der, (Is tibi se commendat.)
units.tr: (To you himself,!) He commends himself to you, or commends himself. He commends himself to her. (He commends himself to you.)

units.la: CI, SI,
units.tr: CI, SI,

units.la: (Se nobis,) Eglici se offerse, offerseecisi. Er hat sich gegen vns erbotten. Er hat sich erbotten, (Se nobis obtulit.)
units.tr: (Se nobis,) Egli ci se offerse, offerseci si. He offered himself to us. He has offered himself. (He offered himself to us.)

units.la: (Nos sibi,) ci si prese per compagni, oner cosi. Ei prosecisi per compagni. Hat vns sich zu Gefellen genommen. (Nos sibi socios adhibuit.)
units.tr: (Us to himself,) he took us as companions, or so; he took himself as companions. He took us to himself as companions. (He took us to himself as companions.)

units.la: (Se illic, illuc,) ci si vccise, oner vccisecisi, vel ei ci succise. Et hat sich daselbsten vmbbracht, (se illic interemit.)
units.tr: (Se illic, illuc,) ci si vccise, oner vccisecisi, vel ei ci succise. And he killed himself there. (He killed himself there.)

units.la: Idem ci si lasciò condurre oner lasciocisi condurre. Er hat sich lassen dorthin führen. (permisit se illuc duci.)
units.tr: The same: he let himself be led there, or he let himself be led. He let himself be led there. (He allowed himself to be led there.)

units.la: Sibi illc, sich alldorten, &c. ci si diede la morte, oner diedesici la morte. Er hat jhm dorten den Todt angethan. (sibi illi mortem intulit.)
units.tr: Sibi illc, to himself there, etc. ci si diede la morte, oner diedesici la morte. He inflicted death upon himself there. (He inflicted death on himself there.)

units.la: VI, SI,
units.tr: VI, SI,

units.la: Se vobis, er sich euch, Ei visi raccomanda, o Ei raccomandanisi. Er befilcht sich euch. (se vobis commendat.)
units.tr: Himself to you, he commends himself to you, or, he commends himself. He commends himself to you. (He commends himself to you.)

units.la: Sibi vos. Dio vi si elesse per figlinoli, elesseniss per figlinoli. Gott hat euch jhme zu Söhnen auserwöhlet. (Deus sibi vos elegit filios.)
units.tr: To himself you. God chose you for himself as sons, chose you as sons. God has chosen you for himself as sons. (God chose you for himself as sons.)

units.la: Vi, ist auch illic, wie Ci, dorten, daselbsten. Ei vi fi vccife. Er hat sich dort vmbbracht.
units.tr: Vi, is also there, as Ci, there, thither. Ei vi fi vccife. He has killed himself there.

units.la: Idem Ei lafciouifi condurre. Er hat sich lassen dorthin führen, (se illuc ducere permisit.)
units.tr: The same: he let himself be led there. He has let himself be led there. (He let himself be led there.)

units.la: Illic sibi, er sich dorten. Vifi compro vna vigna, euer comprouifi vna vigna. Dorten oder daselbsten hat er jhm einen Weinberg kaufft, (sibi illic Vineam emit.)
units.tr: There, for himself, he there. You bought a vineyard, you bought a vineyard. There, or in that place, he bought a vineyard for himself. (He bought a vineyard for himself there.)

units.la: VI, CI,
units.tr: VI, CI,

units.la: (Vos nobis,) jhr, (euch, vns,) vel nos vobis, vns, euch, &c.
units.tr: (Vos nobis,) you, to you, us, to us, or we, to you, etc.

units.la: Dio vi ci diede, oder diedeuici per compagni. Gott hat euch vns zu Gesellen gegeben, vnd vns euch, (Deus vos nobis, vel nos, (vobis socios dedit.)
units.tr: "Dio vi ci diede," or "diedeuici per compagni": God has given you to us as companions, and us to you. (God gave you to us as companions, or us to you.)

units.la: Vos illic, jhr oder euch alldorten. Vici batterono, oder, Effi batteronmici. Sie haben euch dorten geschlagen, (vos illic verberarunt.)
units.tr: Vos illic: you there. "Vici batterono," or "Effi batteronmici": they have beaten you there.

units.la: (Vos illuc,) euch selbsten hin, vi ci menarono, sie haben euch selbsten hingeführt, (vos illuc duxerunt.)
units.tr: (Vos illuc,) you thither: "vi ci menarono," they have led you thither themselves.

units.la: (Vobis illic,) euch dort, vi ci comprasse vna Casa, (domum vobis illic emistis,) jhr habt euch dort ein Hauß gekaufft.
units.tr: (Vobis illic,) to you there: "vi ci comprasse una casa," you have bought yourselves a house there.

units.la: Quando autem ha particula conjungüntur, cumparticula ne, amittunt I, & recipiunt E, hoc modo.
units.tr: When these particles are joined with the particle "ne," they lose the I and take an E, in this way.

units.la: Wann aber dife Wörtlein, zu dem Wört- lein Ne gesetzt werden, so verliehren sie jhr I. vnd nemmen ein E, daruor án, nachfolgender gestalt.
units.tr: When these little words are placed before the word "Ne," they lose their I and take an E in front, in the following form.

units.la: Me ne, te ne, se ne, cene, ve ne, vel sequente tamen vocali, jedoch daß ein Vocal nachfolget, mit einem Apostropho, oder hinwegwerffungs Zeichen, als men', ten', sen', cen', ven', quan- quam sequente Confonanto possunt vsurpari, aut in- tegra, aut truncata, sed abfq; Apostropho.
units.tr: Me ne, te ne, se ne, ce ne, ve ne, when a vowel follows, with an apostrophe or elision mark, as men', ten', sen', cen', ven'. Before a consonant they may be used either whole or truncated, but without the apostrophe.

units.la: Wiewol sie, wann ein Confonant nachge- het, eintweder gantz, oder aber gestimmelt, doch ohne den Apostrophum können gebraucht werden.
units.tr: Although, when a consonant follows, they may be used either in full or in shortened form, they may still be used without the apostrophe.

units.la: Significationem vero & vsum earum, vt hacte- nus fecimus, typis adscriptis ostendemus. Ihre be- deutung aber, vnd wie man sie gebrauchen soll, wollen wir vnserm gebrauch nach, mit einer Tabel erklären.
units.tr: We will explain their meaning and their use, as we have done hitherto, by a table set out in print, in our usual manner.

units.la: ME, NE,
units.tr: ME, NE,

units.la: (Mihi de illo, illa, illis,) me ne parlasti, parla- stimene da lui, du hast mir von jhme gesagt, oder du hast mit mir von jhm geredt, (mihi de illo es locutus.)
units.tr: (Mihi de illo, illa, illis,) me ne parlasti, parlastimene da lui, you have spoken to me about him, or you have talked with me about him, (you have spoken to me about him.)

units.la: (Me hinc, illinc, istinc,) me ne scacciò, ouer, scacciòmene. Er hat mich von hinnen außgetrie- ben, (me hinc, vel illinc expulit.)
units.tr: (Me hinc, illinc, istinc,) me ne scacciò, ouer, scacciòmene. He has driven me out from here, (he has driven me out from here or from there.)

units.la: (Ege
units.tr: (He

units.la: (Ego hinc,&c.) me nevò, ouer vommene. Ich gehe hinweg, ich geh von hinnen weg. (Ego hinc discedo.)
units.tr: (Ego hinc, etc.) me nevò, ouer vommene. I am going away, I go away from here. (I am going away from here.)

units.la: (Tibi de illo,) Iote ne parlai da lui, ouero parlai tene. Ich hab mit dir geredt, von dem oder jenem Red gehalten. (Tibi de illo sum locutus.)
units.tr: (Tibi de illo,) Iote ne parlai da lui, ouero parlai tene. I have spoken with you, held talk about this man or that one. (I have spoken with you about him.)

units.la: (Te hinc, te illinc,) dich von dar hero, Te ne scacciò, scacciottene, er hat dich von hier außgetriben, (te hinc expulit.)
units.tr: (Te hinc, te illinc,) you from here, from there, Te ne scacciò, scacciottene, he has driven you out from here, (he has driven you out from here.)

units.la: (Tu hinc, illinc,) Du von hier, &c. Tu te ne partisti, ouero, tu partisti tene. Du bist von hinnen weg gezogen. (Tu hinc discedisti.)
units.tr: (Tu hinc, illinc,) You from here, etc. Tu te ne partisti, ouero, tu partisti tene. You have gone away from here. (You have departed from here.)

units.la: SE, NE,
units.tr: SE, NE,

units.la: (Sibi de illo, illa, &c.) sich von demselben, oder derselben.
units.tr: (Sibi de illo, illa, etc.) himself or herself, about that man or that woman.

units.la: Sene promise, promisi sene gran cose. Er versprach jhme sehr grosse ding von denselben, (sibi de illo, illa magna promisit.)
units.tr: Sene promise, promisi sene gran cose. He promised him very great things about them. (He promised himself great things about that man or woman.)

units.la: Ei se ne parti, partissene, er ist von hinnen weggezogen, (ipse hinc discessit.)
units.tr: Ei se ne parti, partissene, he has gone away from here (he himself has departed from here).

units.la: VE, NE,
units.tr: VE, NE,

units.la: (Vobis de illo,) Euch von demselben. Eive parlo, o parlouuene, er hat mit euch von deme, oder dem geredt, (de illo, illa locutus est vobis.)
units.tr: (Vobis de illo,) to you about him. Eive parlo, o parlouuene, he has spoken with you about this man or that one. (He has spoken to you about him, or about her.)

units.la: Vos hinc, illinc, jhr von hier dorthin, Voi ve ne andaste, ouero andasteuene. Ihr seyt von hier oder dort hingezogen.(vos hinc,illinc discessistis.) O
units.tr: Vos hinc, illinc, you from here to there, Voi ve ne andaste, ouero andasteuene. You have gone away from here or from there. (You have gone away from here or from there.)

units.la: CE, NE,
units.tr: CE, NE,

units.la: (Nobis de illo, &c.) Vns von demselben. Et ce neparlo, & parlocene. Er hat mit vns, von dem, oder der geredt, (Is de illo, illa nobis locutus est.)
units.tr: (Nobis de illo, &c.) Of the same to us. Et ce neparlo, & parlocene. He has spoken with us, about him or about her. (He spoke with us about that man, or that woman.)

units.la: (Nos hinc, illinc, iftinc,) noi cene partimino, & partimmocene. Wir haben vns von hier weg begeben, (nos hinc discedimus.)
units.tr: (Nos hinc, illinc, istinc,) noi cene partimmo, & partimmocene. We have gone away from here. (Nos hinc discedimus.)

units.la: Conjunguntur deinceps hae particulae cum articulis, vt qui mox infra ponuntur, typi declarant.
units.tr: These particles are then joined with the articles, as the examples set out immediately below make clear.

units.la: Nachmals werden auch dife Wörtlein, zu den Articuln gesetzt, wie die typi, so nächst unden gesetzt werden, klärlich aufzweisen.
units.tr: Afterwards these little words are also set with the articles, as the examples placed next below will clearly show.

units.la: Ex quibus item significatio earum, & vsus perspicue cognosci poterit.
units.tr: From these the meaning of them, and their use, can also be clearly known.

units.la: Auß welchen beydes jhre bedeutung, vnd dann jhr gebrauch leucht: vnd deutlich kan gelernet vnd erkandt werden.
units.tr: From which both their meaning and their use shine forth, and can be learned and understood clearly.

units.la: GLI, MI, vel ME, GLI,
units.tr: GLI, MI, or ME, GLI,

units.la: (Mihi illos,) Gli mi, vel megli raccomando, & raccomandoglimi vel raccomandandomegli, dieselben mir anbefohlen, (mihi illos commendaui.)
units.tr: (To me them,) Gli mi, or megli raccomando, and raccomandoglimi or raccomandandomegli, the same ones commended to me, (I have commended them to me.)

units.la: (Me illi,) Gli mi vel megli raccomando, & raccomandatiglimi, item raccomandatomegli. Ich hab sie mir anbefohlen, oder mir dieselben befohlen, (me illi commendaui.)
units.tr: (To me them,) Gli mi or megli raccomando, & raccomandatiglimi, likewise raccomandatomegli. I have commended them to myself, or I have commended them to myself, (me illi commendaui.)

units.la: GLI, TI, vel SE GLI,
units.tr: GLI, TI, or SE GLI,

units.la: (Tibi illos,) Gli ti vel tegli raccomandai, & raccomandaiglisi, oner raccomandaitegli. Ich hab sie dir anbefohlen, (tibi illos commendaui.)
units.tr: (To you them,) I recommended them to you, or I recommended them to him for you, and I recommended them to him, or I recommended them to you. I have commended them to you (I have commended them to you.)

units.la: (Te illi,) Tegli raccomandasti, & raccomandastigliti. Du hast sie dir befohlen seyn lassen, (te illi commendasti.)
units.tr: (To him them,) You recommended them to him for yourself, and you recommended them to him for yourself. You have had them commended to yourself (you have commended them to him.)

units.la: GLI SI, vel SE GLI,
units.tr: GLI SI, or SE GLI,

units.la: (Sibi illos,) Sie jhme, Gli si fece amici, oner segli fece amici, & gli si fe amici, idem fecesegli amici. Er hat sie jhme zu Freunden gemacht, (illos sibi amicos reddidit.)
units.tr: (Sibi illos,) Sie jhme, He made himself friends with them, or he made them friends to himself, and he made them friends, the same as he made them friends to him. He has made them his friends (illos sibi amicos reddidit.)

units.la: (Se illi, idem,) Gli si raccomando, & raccomandoglisi, idem raccomandossegli. Er hat sie jhme befohlen, (se illi commendauit.)
units.tr: (Se illi, idem,) He recommended himself to him, and recommended to him, the same as he commended to him. He has commended them to him (se illi commendauit.)

units.la: GLI VI, vel VE GLI,
units.tr: GLI VI, or VE GLI,

units.la: (Vobis illos,) diefelben euch, Gli vi raccomandai, ò vegli raccomandai, ò raccomandaiuegli, Ich hab sie euch anbefohlen, ich hab sie euch belobt, (illos vobis commendaui.)
units.tr: (Vobis illos,) those same to you, Gli vi raccomandai, ò vegli raccomandai, ò raccomandaiuegli, I have commended them to you, I have praised them to you, (I have commended them to you.)

units.la: (Illos illic.) sie diefelbige dafelbften oder dorten, Gli vi vidi, oner vegli viddi, & viddiglini. Ich hab sie dorten, oder dafelbst gesehen, (illos illic vidi.)
units.tr: (Illos illic.) those same there, Gli vi vidi, oner vegli viddi, & viddiglini. I have seen them there, or at that place, (I have seen them there.)

units.la: Item Gli vi condusfi, ouer vegli condussi, idem, condussivegli, (illos illuc duxi, ) ich hab sie dort hin geführt.
units.tr: Likewise: Gli vi condusfi, or vegli condussi, the same: condussivegli, (I led them thither,) I have led them there.

units.la: (Et illic) vnd dafelbsten, Gli vidiedi il vivere, ò vegli diedi il vivere, & diedi vegli il viuer, Dafelbst gab ich jhme Nahrung, ich hab jhme dort die Nahrung geben, (ei illic victum dedi.)
units.tr: (Et illic) and there, Gli vidiedi il vivere, ò vegli diedi il vivere, & diedi vegli il viuer, There I gave him food; I have given him food there, (I gave him food there.)

units.la: GLI CI, vel CE GLI.
units.tr: GLI CI, or CE GLI.

units.la: (Nobis illos.) Vns diesselbigen, Gli ci raccomandasti, ouer cegli raccomandasti, & raccomandasti glici, idem raccomandaste cegli, Du hast sie vns anberümbt, hast sie vns anbefohlen, (illos nobis commendasti.)
units.tr: (Nobis illos.) those same to us, Gli ci raccomandasti, ouer cegli raccomandasti, & raccomandasti glici, idem raccomandaste cegli, You have commended them to us, you have recommended them to us, (you commended them to us.)

units.la: Nos illi, wir diefelben, Gli ci raccomandammo, ò cegli raccomandammo, & raccomandammo cegli, Wir haben sie vns anbefohlen, haben sie vns anbefohlen seyn lassen, (nos illi commendavimus.)
units.tr: Nos illi, we to him those same, Gli ci raccomandammo, ò cegli raccomandammo, & raccomandammo cegli, We have commended them to us; we have had them commended to us, (we commended them to him.)

units.la: Illic, illuc, dort, dafelbsten, Glici vidi, ouer cegli viddi, viddiglici, vnd viddicegli, ich hab sie dort gesehen, (illic eos vidi.) Idem cegli condusse, & condussegliei, idem condussecegli, er hat diefelbigen dorthin geführt, (illic eos duxit.)
units.tr: Illic, illuc, there, thither, Glici vidi, ouer cegli viddi, viddiglici, and viddicegli, I have seen them there, (I have seen them there.) Idem cegli condusse, & condussegliei, idem condussecegli, he has led those same thither, (he led them there.)

units.la: LO, MI.
units.tr: LO, MI.

units.la: LO MI, vel ME LO,
units.tr: LO MI, or ME LO,

units.la: (Illud mihi,) mir dis, oder daß. Eilo mi raccomando, o Egli me lo raccomando, & raccomandollomi, Idem raccomandommelo, (illum, illud, mihi commendaut.) Er hat mir dassellb, oder das oder dis anbefohlen.
units.tr: (Illud mihi,) that to me, or this. Eilo mi raccomando, o Egli me lo raccomando, & raccomandollomi, idem raccomandommelo, (illum, illud, mihi commendauit.) He has commended that one, or that, to me. (He commended him, it, to me.)

units.la: LO TI, vel TE LO,
units.tr: LO TI, or TE LO,

units.la: LO, Si, vel VE, LO.
units.tr: LO, Si, or VE, LO.

units.la: (Illum sibi,) denselben sich, Lo si elesse per compagno, o si lo elesse per Comp. & elessolosi per Compagno, er hat jhm denselben zum Gesellen erkorn, oder zum Gesellen erwöhlt, (illum sibi socium elegit.)
units.tr: (Illum sibi,) that one to himself. Lo si elesse per compagno, o si lo elesse per Comp. & elessolosi per Compagno, he has chosen that one for himself as a companion, or chose him as his companion, (he chose him for himself as companion.)

units.la: LO VI, vel VE LO.
units.tr: LO VI, or VE LO.

units.la: (Illum vobis) denselbigen, euch, Lo vi raccomandai, o velo raccomandai, & raccomandaiuelo, (illum vobis commendaui,) hab euch denselben belobt, versprochen, angerühmt, und anbefohlen.
units.tr: (Illum vobis) that one to you. Lo vi raccomandai, o velo raccomandai, & raccomandaiuelo, (illum vobis commendaui,) I have commended that one to you; I have praised, promised, extolled and commended him to you.

units.la: (Illum illic,) denselben dort, Lo vi viddi, velo viddi, & vidiloui, ich hab denselben dort gesehen, (illum illic vidi.) Lo vi menai, & velo menai, menailoui, Ich hab denselben daselbst hingeführt, ( illum illuc duxi. )
units.tr: (Him there,) him there: Lo vi viddi, velo viddi, and vidiloui: I have seen him there (I saw him there). Lo vi menai, and velo menai, menailoui: I have led him thither there (I led him thither).

units.la: LO CI, vel CE LO.
units.tr: LO CI, or CE LO.

units.la: ( Illum nobis ) denselben vns, Lo ci raccomando, over, Celo raccomando, idem raccomandolloci, & raccomandoccello, Er hat vns denselben gerühmbt, vnd befohlen, ( illum nobis commendavit. ) Idem io celo menai, & io menailoci, & menaicelo, hab denselben selbst hingeführt, ( illum illuc duxi. )
units.tr: (Him to us) that is, I recommend him to you, or, I recommend him to you; the same: I recommend him to us, and I recommend him to us, and I recommend him to them. He has praised him to us and charged us with him (he commended him to us). The same: I myself led him to them, and I led him to us, and I led him to them. I myself led him there (I led him there).

units.la: LO NE, vel NE LO.
units.tr: LO NE, or NE LO.

units.la: ( Illum nobis ) denselben vns, Lo ne tolse, vel ne lo tolse, & tolsenole, vel tolsenelo, er hat jhn oder denselbigen vns hinweg genommen, ( illum nobis abstulit. )
units.tr: (that one to us) that one to us, Lo ne tolse, vel ne lo tolse, & tolsenole, vel tolsenelo, he has taken him or that one away from us; (he has taken him away from us.)

units.la: Illum hinc, denselben hier, Lo ne meno vel nelo meno, menollene, & menonnelo, er hat jhn hinweg geführt, er hat jhn davon geführt, ( illum hinc abduxit. )
units.tr: Illum hinc, that one from here, Lo ne meno vel nelo meno, menollene, & menonnelo, he has led him away, he has led him off; (he has led him away from here.)

units.la: LA MI, vel ME LA.
units.tr: LA MI, or ME LA.

units.la: ( Illam mihi ) Dieselbige mir, Me la raccomandasti, o La mi raccomandasti, & raccomandastime la, du hast sie mir anbefohlen, ( illam mihi commendasti. )
units.tr: (That one to me) That same one to me, Me la raccomandasti, o La mi raccomandasti, & raccomandastime la, you have commended her to me, (you commended her to me.)

units.la: LA TI, vel TE LA.
units.tr: LA TI, or TE LA.

units.la: (Illam tibi) Diefelbe dir, La ti raccomanda, te la raccomanda, raccomandailati, & raccomandaitela, ich hab sie dir belobt, (illam tibi commendaui.)
units.tr: (The same to you) The same to you, La ti raccomanda, te la raccomanda, raccomandailati, & raccomandaitela, I have praised her to you (I have recommended her to you).

units.la: LA SI, vel SE LA.
units.tr: LA SI, vel SE LA.

units.la: (Illam sibi) Dieselbe jhme, Et se la prese per moglie, & la si prese per moglie, presela si, vel presela per moglie, er hat sie jhm zum Weib genommen, oder nam sie zum Weibe, (illam sibi vxorem duxit.)
units.tr: (Illam sibi) That same woman for himself: "And he took her as his wife," "and so he took her as his wife," "he took her so," or "he took her as a wife"; he has taken her to wife, or took her as his wife, (illam sibi uxorem duxit.)

units.la: LA CI, vel CE LA.
units.tr: LA CI, or CE LA.

units.la: (Illam nobis) dieselbe vns, La ci raccomando, ce la raccomando, & raccomandollaci, vel raccomandocella, er hat sie vns angerühmbt, (illam nobis commendauit.)
units.tr: (her to us) that same one to us, La ci raccomando, ce la raccomando, & raccomandollaci, vel raccomandocella, he has commended her to us. (he has commended her to us.)

units.la: (Illam illic) diefelb dorten, La ci vidi, ce la viddi, viddilaci, vidicela, ich hab sie dort gesehen, (illam illic vidi.)
units.tr: (her there) that one there, La ci vidi, ce la viddi, viddilaci, vidicela, I have seen her there. (I have seen her there.)

units.la: Ich hab sie dafelbst hingeführt, (illam illuc duxi.)
units.tr: I have led her there (I led her thither).

units.la: LA VI, vel VE LA,
units.tr: LA VI, or VE LA,

units.la: Idem la vi viddi, ve la vidi, vidi la vi, & vidi-vela, (illam illic vidi,) ich hab fie dort gesehen.
units.tr: Idem la vi viddi, ve la vidi, vidi la vi, & vidi-vela, (I have seen her there,) I have seen her there.

units.la: Idem vela menai, & la vi menai, menailaui, & menaivela, ich hab fie dorthin geführt. (Illam illuc duxi.)
units.tr: The same: vela menai, and la vi menai, menailaui, and menaivela, I have led her there. (I have led her thither.)

units.la: NE LA, vel LA NE,
units.tr: NE LA, or LA NE,

units.la: (Illam nobis,) diefelbige vns, Nela raccommando, o, la ne raccommando, & raccomandollane, idem raccomandomela. Er hat fie vns befohlen. (illam nobis commend.)
units.tr: (Her to us,) that same one to us, Nela raccommando, or, la ne raccommando, and raccomandollane, the same: raccomandomela. He has commended her to us. (He has commended her to us.)

units.la: Idem la ne meno, o, ve la meno, & menollane, vel menonnela. Er hat fie hier weg geführt. (illam hinc abduxit.)
units.tr: Idem la ne meno, o, ve la meno, & menollane, vel menonnela. He has led her away from here. (he has led her away from here.)

units.la: LE MI, vel ME LE,
units.tr: LE MI, or ME LE,

units.la: (Illas mihi,) diefelben mir. Lui me le raccomando, Egli le mi raccomando, & raccomandollemi, idem raccomandomele. Er hat mir diefelben (Frawen) anbefohlen, (illas mihi commendauit.)
units.tr: (those to me) those (women) to me. Lui me le raccomando, Egli le mi raccomando, & raccomandollemi, idem raccomandomele. He has commended those (women) to me. (he has commended those women to me.)

units.la: LE TI, vel TE LE.
units.tr: LE TI, or TE LE.

units.la: Illas tibi, dieselben dir, Egli te le raccomando, vel Le ti raccomando, & raccomandolleti, idem raccomandottele, er hat dieselben (Weiber) dir befohlen, (illas tibi commendauit.)
units.tr: Illas tibi, those (the same ones) to you, Egli te le raccomando, vel Le ti raccomando, and raccomandolleti, idem raccomandottele, he has commended those (women) to you (he has commended them to you.)

units.la: LE SI, vel SE Le.
units.tr: LE SI, or SE LE.

units.la: Illas sibi, dieselben jhme, Le si prese per Compagne, Se le prese per Compagne, Prefelesi, & prese-lese per Compagne, Er hat sie jhme zu Gesel-linen genommen, (illas sibi Socias asciuit.)
units.tr: Those to himself, those (women) to him, Le si prese per Compagne, Se le prese per Compagne, Prefelesi, and prese-lese per Compagne, he has taken them to himself as companions, (he took those women to himself as companions.)

units.la: LE NE, vel NE LE.
units.tr: LE NE, or NE LE.

units.la: Illas nobis, dieselben vns, Ne le raccomando, & raccomandolene, vel raccomandonele, er hat sie vns anbefohlen. (illas nobis comm.)
units.tr: Illas nobis, "the same to us": Ne le raccomando, and raccomandolene, or raccomandonele, "he has commended them to us." (commended them to us)

units.la: Illas hinc, Le ne meno, & ne le meno, & menolle-ne, menonnele, hat sie hier weg geführt, (illas hinc abdux.)
units.tr: Illas hinc, Le ne meno, and ne le meno, and menolle-ne, menonnele, "has led them away from here." (led them away from here)

units.la: LE CI, vel LE CE.
units.tr: LE CI, vel LE CE.

units.la: (Illas nobis) Le ci raccomando, cele raccoman-do, & raccomandolleci, & raccomandatoccelle, (illas nob. comm.) hat sie vns befohlen.
units.tr: (them to us) Le ci raccomando, cele raccomando, & raccomandolleci, & raccomandatoccelle, (them to us, commended): he has commended them to us.

units.la: (Illas illic.) Le ci vidi, & cele vidi, viddicele, hab sie dort gesehen, (illas illic vidi.)
units.tr: (them there) Le ci vidi, & cele vidi, viddicele: I have seen them there, (them there, seen).

units.la: LE VI, vel VE LE.
units.tr: LE VI, or VE LE.

units.la: Illas vobis, diefelben euch, Le vi raccomando, ve le raccomando, & raccomandolleui, vel ratomandouele, (illas vobis commend.) er hat sie euch anbefohlen.
units.tr: Illas vobis, the same to you; Le vi raccomando, ve le raccomando, and raccomandolleui, or ratomandouele, (commended them to you): he has commended them to you.

units.la: Idem Le vi vidi, & vele vidi, vidileui, vidiuele, (illas illic vidi,) hab sie dorten gesehen, Idem le vi menai, ve le menai, (illas illuc duxi,) menaileui, & menaiuele, hab sie dort weg geführt.
units.tr: Idem Le vi vidi, and vele vidi, vidileui, vidiuele, (those there I saw,) I saw them there. Idem le vi menai, ve le menai, (those thither I led,) menaileui, and menaiuele, I led them away there.

units.la: Atque hactenus de huiusmodi particulis, in quarum tamen tractatione si paulo fuimus prolixiores, quam par esse cupiam videri potest.
units.tr: And so far concerning particles of this kind; yet if in treating of them I have been somewhat more lengthy than is fitting, it may perhaps appear so.

units.la: Biß hieher von dergleichen Wörtlein, vnd ob wir gleich in derselben abhandlung möchten angesehen werden, als hätten wir vns länger aufgehalten, als billch einen bedüncken thäte.
units.tr: So much for such little words. And even if in this discussion we may seem to have dwelt longer than some would think proper.

units.la: Sciant Italicæ Linguæ studiosi, earum exactam cognitionem maioris esse momenti, quam primo aspectu quis unquam putasset.
units.tr: Let those who study the Italian language know that an exact knowledge of these matters is of greater importance than anyone would have supposed at first sight.

units.la: So sollen doch die, der Welschen Sprach be- hiffene wiffen, daß derselben genaue Erkåndt- nuß mehr hinder sich haben, denn als einer im ersten Anblick hätte vermeinen mögen.
units.tr: Let those who apply themselves to the Italian language know that an exact knowledge of these matters is of more consequence than one might have thought at first glance.

units.la: Id quod vos ipsos non dubito esse judicaturos, ubi huius Linguae vim & ingenium vel mediocriter cog- noveretis.
units.tr: I do not doubt that you yourselves will judge this to be so, once you have come to know moderately well the force and character of this language.

units.la: Welches jhr auch ewrem guten Verstand nach werdet erkennen, wie ich meine, wenn jhr nur die Krafft vnd Arth difer Sprach, etlicher maßen werdet ergriffen haben.
units.tr: As you will also recognise with your good understanding, I believe, if you have only grasped the power and nature of this language to some degree.

units.la: DE VERBIS IMPERSONALIBVS.
units.tr: DE VERBIS IMPERSONALIBUS.

units.la: Von den vnpöhrsöhnlichen Wörtern.
units.tr: Of impersonal verbs.

units.la: EA instar Latinorum verborum impersonalium numeris & personis deficiunt.
units.tr: They lack number and person, like the Latin impersonal verbs.

units.la: Dife haben keine numeros vnd Personen, gleich wie die Lateinische impersonalia haben.
units.tr: These have no numbers and persons, just as the Latin impersonalia do.

units.la: Præter numerum singul. & personam tertiam, außerhalb deß singularis numeri, vnd der dritten Person.
units.tr: Apart from the singular number and the third person.

units.la: Atque etiam eis nunquam datur casus nominandi, vnd wird auch jhnen niemahln der Nominativus, oder Nenn casus, zugegeben.
units.tr: And they are never given the nominative case.

units.la: Qui verbis personalibus omnibus, aut tacitè aut exprese semper præponitur.
units.tr: It is always placed before all personal verbs, either tacitly or expressly.

units.la: Welcher doch denen verbis personalibus alle zeit, entweder heimlich oder außtrucklich vor gesetzt wirdt.
units.tr: Which, however, always stands before the personal verbs, either tacitly or expressly.

units.la: Ex iis autem quaedam per se ita dicuntur, & sunt actiua significationis, vt. Deren werden etliche für sich selbsten also genennet, vnd seynd generis actiui, als.
units.tr: Some of these are said thus by themselves, and are of the active sense, as some of them are used by themselves in this way and are of the active kind, such as:

units.la: Pluit, pluue, es regnet, Tonat, tonat, es donnert, Fulgurat, fulgerat, es blitzet, Lampeggia, coruscat, es wetterleuchtet, item Verna, es ist Winter, (est hyems.)
units.tr: Pluit, pluue, it rains; Tonat, tonat, it thunders; Fulgurat, fulgerat, it lightens; Lampeggia, coruscat, it flashes like lightning; likewise Verna, it is winter (est hyems).

units.la: Quanquam apud Poetas nonnunquam vsurpan tur, perinde & si personalia essent, Nominatiuo scilicet adjuncto.
units.tr: Although poets sometimes use them as if they were personal verbs, namely with a nominative added.

units.la: Wiewol sie bey den Poeten, bißweilen anders nicht gebraucht werden, denn als wären sie verba personalia, da sie nemblich einen Nominativum vor sich haben.
units.tr: Although among the poets they are sometimes used as though they were personal verbs, that is, with a nominative placed before them.

units.la: Quaedam vero ex aliis verbis deriuantur, ac passiua sunt significationis, habentia particulam SI, praepositam, vel postpositam, vt.
units.tr: Some, however, are derived from other verbs and are of the passive sense, having the particle SI placed before or after them, as

units.la: Etliche aber werden auß andern verbis hergeleytet, vnd seynd generis passiui, welches Flickwörtlein für sich haben, oder auch nach sich, als.
units.tr: Others, however, are derived from other verbs and are of the passive kind; they have the little word SI before them or after them, as:

units.la: Si amat, amatur, (amatur,) si legge, legitur, (legitur,) si corre, correfi, (curritur,) si stat, statur, (statur,) si vä, vätur, (ituur,) & huiusmodi non pauca.
units.tr: If one loves, it is loved (amatur); if one reads (si legge), it is read (legitur); if one runs (si corre), it is run (correfi, curritur); if one stands (si stat), it is stood (statur); if one goes (si vä), it is gone (vätur, ituur); and many others of this kind.

units.la: Man
units.tr: One

units.la: DE PARTICIPIIS.
units.tr: CONCERNING PARTICIPLES.

units.la: Von den Mittelvwörtern.
units.tr: On the Participles.

units.la: HAbet quidem Sermo Italicus, quasdam voces, quae participys latinis videntur esse similes. Die Welsche Sprach hat zwar etliche Wörter, die den Lateinischen participijs scheinen gleich seyn, als amante, legente, tenente, vbidiente. Item amato, letto, tenuto, vbidito, liebend, lesend, haltend, gehorchend, item geliebt, gelesen, gehalte, gehorsamet, vnd endlich, Renerendo, tremendo, offerunado, orrendo, & huiusmodi alia quaedam, vnd endtlich, ehrwürdig, zitternd, anmerckend, greulich, vnd andere difer arth mehr.
units.tr: The Italian language does have some words that seem to be like the Latin participles, such as amante, legente, tenente, ubidiente; also amato, letto, tenuto, ubidito; in German liebend, lesend, haltend, gehorchend; also geliebt, gelesen, gehalten, gehorsamet; and finally reverendo, tremendo, onorando, orrendo, and others of this kind; and finally ehrwürdig, zitternd, anmerckend, greulich, and others of this sort.

units.la: Sed vix crediderim jure possi dici participia, Aber ich glaube schwärlich, daß man sie mit recht könne participia nennen.
units.tr: But I hardly think they can rightly be called participles.

units.la: Quando quidem cum verbis nihil habeant commune, Dieweil sie mit den verbis nichts gemein haben, (eorum scilicet, quae latina participia a verbis mutuantur) nemblich in denen Stucken, welche die Lateinische participia von denen verbis entlehnen, ac vt plane nomina vsurpari solent, vnd werden gentzlich wie nomina gebraucht.
units.tr: For they have nothing in common with verbs (that is, in those respects in which the Latin participles take their character from verbs), and they are commonly used quite as nouns, and are treated entirely as nouns.

units.la: P
units.tr: P

units.la: Omnino enim Lingua Italica abhorret ab iftius modi dicendi forma.
units.tr: For the Italian language altogether shrinks from this kind of expression.

units.la: Dann die Italiänisch Sprach scheuet sich für dergleichen art zureden, als nemblich. Io amo l'amante de la virtu, pro io amo colui, che ama la virtu, ich lieb den, der die Tungendt liebt.
units.tr: For Italian shrinks from such a way of speaking, as for example: Io amo l'amante de la virtu, pro io amo colui, che ama la virtu, I love the one who loves virtue.

units.la: Neque vero dicimus, gleichfalls sagen wir nit, Io ho promesso vn dono a LegenteCicerone,pro,io ho promesso a colui che LeggeCicerone. Ich versprechè dem, der den Ciceronem lifet, &c.
units.tr: Nor do we say, Io ho promesso vn dono a LegenteCicerone, for io ho promesso a colui che LeggeCicerone: I have promised a gift to the one who reads Cicero.

units.la: Atqui haud me latet, nonnunquam a Boccaeio huiusmodi participia vsurpari, sed per raro fieri.
units.tr: Yet I am not unaware that such participles are sometimes used by Boccaccio, but this happens rarely.

units.la: Iedoch ist mir nicht vnwissend, daß dergleichen participia ven dem Boccatio gebraucht werden, welches doch selten geschicht.
units.tr: Nevertheless, I am not unaware that such participles are sometimes used by Boccaccio, though this happens rarely.

units.la: Neminem ambigere puto, qui illius scripta aliquando legerit, dauon meiner meinung nach, niemand zweifeln würde, welcher seine Schriften, einmal wird gelesen haben.
units.tr: I think no one doubts who has ever read his writings, so in my opinion no one would doubt it who has once read his works.

units.la: Quocirca, cum dicimus, derowegen wann wir sagen. Io fui, vel sono, vel saro dolente, item il giorno sequente, item la vegnente vel venente notte, hoc est fui, sum, & ero dolens, postridie, & futura nox, das ist, ich bin gewesen, ich bin, oder ich werde betrübet seyn, deßgleichen der folgende Tag, die zukünfftige Nacht.
units.tr: Wherefore, when we say, therefore, when we say Io fui, or sono, or saro dolente; likewise il giorno sequente; likewise la vegnente or venente notte, that is, fui, sum, and ero dolens, postridie, and futura nox: that is, I have been, I am, or I shall be grieved; likewise the following day, the coming night.

units.la: Nemo non videt, hac omnia nomina esse potius quam participia.
units.tr: Everyone sees that all these are nouns rather than participles.

units.la: Sihet jederman, daß solches vilmehr nomina, als participia seyn.
units.tr: Everyone sees that these are rather nouns than participles.

units.la: Neque juxta eadem formas, ex omnibus aliis Italicis idem posse trahi. Vnd könne man solcher gestalt, nicht von allen Italiänischen verbis ziehen, atque de verbis Latinis haud fieri nequit, wie solches bey den Lateinischen gar leichtlich geschehen kan.
units.tr: Nor can the same form be drawn from all other Italian verbs in this way, and from Latin verbs it can certainly be done, as is quite easily managed in Latin.

units.la: De est proinde omnino sermoni Italico participium in Rus. Hat demnach die Italiänische Sprach gar kein participium in Rus.
units.tr: Italian therefore has altogether no participle in -rus. So the Italian language has no participle in -rus at all.

units.la: Haud enim dicimus, pro amaturus, amature, lecturus, lecturo, & huiusmodi. Wir sagen nicht für amaturus, amaturo, einer der da lieben wird, sondern also sagen wir.
units.tr: We do not say amaturus, amature, lecturus, lecturo, and the like, for amaturus, amaturo, meaning one who is going to love. We say it this way instead.

units.la: Donendo io, donendo colui, donendo noi, voi, coloro amare vel habendo ad amare, vel effendo per amare, &c. hoc est, cum sim, sis, sit amaturus, simus, sitis, sint amaturi. Nach dem ich werd lieben, er wird lieben, sie werden lieben, &c.
units.tr: Having to love I, having to love he, having to love we, you, they, to love, either having to love or being for loving, etc. That is, when I am, you are, he is about to love; when we are, you are, they are about to love. After I shall love, he will love, they will love, etc.

units.la: Quod tamen Gerundium est, apud Italos, expe-nimus etiam lecturus, hoc modo. Welches doch ein Gerundium bey den Italiänern ist, wir pflegen auch das lecturus also zuerklären, und umbzureden.
units.tr: This, however, is a gerund among the Italians; we also express lecturus in this way, and rephrase it.

units.la: Io, il quale leggerò.
units.tr: Io, il quale leggerò.

units.la: Tu il quale leggerai.
units.tr: Tu il quale leggerai.

units.la: Colui quale leggerà.
units.tr: Colui quale leggerà.

units.la: Item lecturi, also im plurali numero.
units.tr: Likewise lecturi, thus in the plural number.

units.la: Noi i quali leggeremo.Voi i quali leggerete.Coloro i quali leggeranno.
units.tr: Noi i quali leggeremo. Voi i quali leggerete. Coloro i quali leggeranno. We who shall read. You who shall read. They who shall read.

units.la: Welcher ich, du, er, lesen werd oder wirst, wir, ihr, sie lesen werden, und werdet, &c.
units.tr: I who shall or will read; you who will read; he who will read; we who shall read; you who will read; they who will read; etc.

units.la: Postremo, eorum declinatio nihil differt a nominum declinatione. Endtlich ist ihre declination nichts von der Nominum declinatione vnderschiden.
units.tr: Finally, their declension differs in nothing from the declension of nouns.

units.la: Habet enim amante, quae est vox singularis numeri, ac utriusque generis, in plur. num.
units.tr: For amante, which is a word of the singular number and of both genders, has in the plural

units.la: Dann amante, welches Wort singul. num. vnd beyderley Geschlechts ist, hat im plur. amanti, amato, amati, amante, onorando, onorandi, &c. der liebend, die liebenden, der geehrt, die geehrten.
units.tr: For amante, which is a word of the singular number and of both genders, has in the plural amanti, amato, amati, amante, onorando, onorandi, &c.: the loving one, the loving ones; the honoured one, the honoured ones.

units.la: Ex iis quae de his supra, cum de verborum aggregamus declinatione, tradidimus. Aus disen, was wir oben von der Conjugation deren verborum gehandelt haben. Facile perspici potest, quae sint Gerundia, apud Italos, quisque sit eorum usus. Kan man leichtlich sehen, welches die Gerundia bey den Welschen, und was derselbigen gebrauch sey: Dicimus, sagen wir, legendo diuento dotto, (legendo fio doctus) durch lesen wird ich gelehrt.
units.tr: From what we set down above, when we treated the conjugation of verbs, it can easily be seen which are gerunds among the Italians, and what their use is. We say, we say legendo diuento dotto, (legendo fio doctus): by reading I become learned.

units.la: En Gerundium praesenti temporis, siehe daß ist ein Gerundium, praesenti temporis.
units.tr: Behold a gerund of the present tense.

units.la: Item habendo letto, ho imparato, (cum legerem) (didici) eupraterii, dieweil ich gelesen hab, hab ich gelernt, das ist ein Gerundium præteriti temporis.
units.tr: Likewise habendo letto, ho imparato (cum legerem, didici), perfect, since I have read, I have learned: that is a gerund of the past tense.

units.la: Denique dounenda leggere. Hauenda a leggere, essendo per leggere, apro il libro, (cum sim lectu-rus, librum aperio.)
units.tr: Denique dounenda leggere. Hauenda a leggere, essendo per leggere, apro il libro (cum sim lecturus, librum aperio): finally, to be read; having to read; being about to read, I open the book (when I am about to read, I open the book).

units.la: Letstlich, wann ich lesen will, als ich soll lesen, weil ich hab zulesen, nach dem ich zulesen da bin, so thu ich das Buch auff, ich mach das Buch auff, &c.
units.tr: Finally: when I wish to read, as I ought to read, since I have to read, since I am about to read, I open the book, I open the book, etc.

units.la: Iam breuitatis causa reijcęo exempla ex verbo passiuo, ietzt will ich verschweigen vmb kürtze willen, die passiua exempla. Cum haud necesse est videatur postea plura tradere, qua fusius supra sunt tradita. Weil nicht nothwendig scheinet, hernach vil darvon zureden, welches oben schon nach genug ist abgehandelt worden.
units.tr: Now, for the sake of brevity, I omit the examples from the passive verb, as I will now leave out the passive examples for the sake of brevity. Since it does not seem necessary to hand down much more about them later, which has already been treated at sufficient length above.

units.la: Illud admonebo, hoc plus habere Linguam nostram, quam latinam. Dises will ich erinnern, vnsere Sprach hab dises mehr, dann die Lateinische, quod hæc in Gerundijs non agnoscit tempora, illa maxime.
units.tr: I will point this out: our language has this further feature beyond Latin, I wish to point this out: our language has this more than Latin, that this language does not recognise tenses in gerunds, whereas that one does so most of all.

units.la: Demum obseruandum quoque est, daß dise in Gerundijs keine Zeit erkennet, jene aber am allermeisten.
units.tr: Finally this too is to be observed, that this language recognises no tense in gerunds, but that one does so most of all.

units.la: Letstlich ist dises auch zubeobachten. Futuri temporis Gerundia Italica explicari per participia latina eiusdem temporis. Daß die Welschen Gerundia futuri temporis, werden erklåret, durch die Latheinischen participia, eben dises temporis
units.tr: Finally, this too is to be noted: Italian gerunds of the future tense are explained by Latin participles of the same tense. That the Italian gerunds of the future tense are explained by the Latin participles of this same tense.

units.la: tam actiua, quam passiua significationes, sowol im Actiuo als im Passiuo, &c.
units.tr: both active and passive meanings, as well in the active as in the passive, etc.

units.tr: Per Dio, by God, (Hercle,) multis aliis modis, jurant Itali. The Italians swear in many other ways, namely, as alla fe, alla fede, per l'anima mia: by my faith, by my soul.
