units.la: Oltre, vber, (vltra) oltre il mare, vber Meer, (vltra Mare,) oltre a cio, oltre cio, & oltre di cio, vber dis, vber das, (prater hoc,) oltre il Principe, aufser den Fürsten, (prater principem,) dietro, nach, (post,) dietro il monte, nach dem Berge, (post montem,) dietro a lui, nach welchem, (post quem.) Accanto, allato, dabey, (prope,) vt accanto & allato, allato alla Città, bey der Statt, prope Ciuitatem.
units.tr: Oltre, beyond, oltre il mare, beyond the sea, oltre a cio, oltre cio, and oltre di cio, besides this, oltre il Principe, besides the prince, dietro, after, dietro il monte, behind the mountain, dietro a lui, after him, Accanto, beside, near, by, vt accanto & allato, allato alla Città, beside the city.

units.la: Appresso, bey, als appresso di me, bey mir, (apud me.) Item appresso significat post, vt appresso di te, vel appresso a te, (post te,) nach dir, Appetto, vergleichung, nach vergleichung, (comparatione) als Appetto a lui, nach dessen vergleichung, (eius comparatione,) di rimpetto, gegen vber, (ex oppofito,) vt di rimpetto al monte, (ex oppofito montis) dem Berge gegen vber.
units.tr: Appresso, with, near, as appresso di me, with me, Item appresso significat post, likewise appresso means after, vt appresso di te, vel appresso a te, after you, Appetto, in comparison, as Appetto a lui, in comparison with him, di rimpetto, opposite, vt di rimpetto al monte, opposite the mountain.

units.la: Infino, infin. (vsq.) bis, als infin' al Cielo, bis an Himmel, infino al Cielo, vsq. ad Cœl. Di nascosto, heimlich, clam, in geheim, idem, als ingeheim dem Vatter, (clam patrem) Auanti, dinanzi, inanzi, vor, zuvor, (coram,) vt dinanzi al Giudice, vor dem Richter, (coram judice.) Intor-
units.tr: Infino, infin., as far as, until, as infin' al Cielo, as far as heaven, infino al Cielo, up to heaven. Di nascosto, secretly, clam, in secret, likewise, as ingeheim dem Vatter, secretly from the father. Auanti, dinanzi, inanzi, before, in the presence of, vt dinanzi al Giudice, before the judge.

units.la: Intorno, vmb, vmbher,( circa )vt, intorno a cui, vmb welchen, vmb dene, ( circa quem, )fuori, drauffen, fuori della Citta, drauffen vor der Statt, ( extra Civitatem, ) item dentro della Citta, in der Statt, innerhalb der Statt, ( intra Civitatem, ) Su, auff, oben, ( supra ) vt, in su del colle, auff dem kügel, ( supra Collem. )
units.tr: Intorno, around, about, as intorno a cui, around whom, fuori, outside, fuori della Citta, outside the city, likewise dentro della Citta, inside the city, within the city. Su, up, above, as in su del colle, up on the hill.

units.la: Giu, drunden, vnden, darunden, giu del monte, drunden, oder vnden am Berge, ,jub montem.
units.tr: Giu, down, below, beneath, as giu del monte, down or below the mountain.

units.la: Di la, aufferhalb, jenseits, ( extra ) vt, di la del Castello, aufferhalb deß Schlosses, ( extra Castrum, ) Di qua, jenseits, diesseits, als, di qua di Castello, jenerseits, diesseits deß Schlosses, ( citra Castrum )
units.tr: Di la, beyond, on the far side, as di la del Castello, beyond the castle. Di qua, on this side, as di qua di Castello, on this side of the castle.

units.la: Da, von, ( a ) ex de, di, de, in, mutatur in nel, vt nel Cielo, in Himmel, ( in coelo, ) & nella terra, in der Erden, in der Erd, oder auff Erden, ( in terra. )
units.tr: Da, from, of, ex, de, di, de, in, is changed to nel, as nel Cielo, in heaven, and nella terra, on earth.

units.la: Sed quando alterutro modo loqui debeamus, wie man aber auff dife oder jene weise reden soll.
units.tr: But when we ought to speak in either way, how one should speak in this or that manner.

units.la: Vsu & Consuetudo Linguae ac frequens scriptorum Italicorum Latio probe docebit.
units.tr: Usage and the custom of the language, and the frequent writings of the Italian authors, will teach this well.

units.la: Das wird der gebrauch vnd gewonheit der Sprache, wie auch die stettige lesung, der Welschen Scribenten, am beften lehren.
units.tr: The practice and custom of the language, as well as the constant reading of Italian writers, will teach this best.

units.la: Sunt tandem quaedam praepositiones, quae non, nisi in Compositione verborum vsurpantur, vt,
units.tr: Finally, there are certain prepositions which are used only in the composition of verbs, as:

units.la: Es seynd etliche praepositiones, die man nur gebraucht, wann man die verba will zusammen fetzen, als, di, in diffido, ich mißtrawe, dis, in disgiongo, ich sónder von einander, (separo,) item ra, in raccoglio, ich leg zusammen, (colligo) Ri, in ripiglio, ich fasse wider, (iterum capio.) Effe, in effalto, ich erheb, Inter in interrompo, ich breche darzwischen. Tra, in trametto, ich leg darzwischen, (interpono.) Tras, in trasporto, ich trag über, (transfero.)
units.tr: There are some prepositions which are used only when one wishes to compound verbs, as: di, in diffido, I distrust; dis, in disgiongo, I separate or part from one another; likewise ra, in raccoglio, I gather together; ri, in ripiglio, I take up again; effe, in effalto, I raise up; inter, in interrompo, I break in between; tra, in trametto, I put between; tras, in trasporto, I carry across.

units.la: Fra, in fraflagio, (verbum ridiculum,) auß welchem ebenfals das lächerliche Adverbium fraflagliatamente herkömmet, quasi distincte, fast mit vnderschid, als tu parli fraflagliatamente, du redest, &c.
units.tr: Fra, in fraflagio (a ridiculous word), from which the comic adverb fraflagliatamente also comes, roughly, with distinction, nearly with a difference, as tu parli fraflagliatamente, you speak, etc.

units.la: DE ADVERBIIS LOCALIBVS.
units.tr: DE ADVERBIIS LOCALIBVS.

units.la: Von Zuvvörtern, die den Orth bedeuten.
units.tr: Of Adverbs of Place.

units.la: Qui, qua, ci, hie, hieher, allhier. (hic, huc.) Quinci, di qui, von hinnen, (hinc.)
units.tr: Qui, qua, ci, here, hither, hereabouts. (hic, huc.) Quinci, di qui, from here, hence. (hinc.)

units.la: Costi & costa, dort, alldorten, (istic.) Costa, & incosta, dorthin, (istuc.) Costinci, von dorther, (istinc.)
units.tr: Costi & costa, there, over there, (istic.) Costa, & incosta, thither, (istuc.) Costinci, from there, (istinc.)

units.la: Lui, quini, la, vi, dafelbst, dafelbst hin (illic illuc.) Indi, quindi, di là, di colà, von dannenhero, von dort her, (illinc.)
units.tr: Lui, quini, la, vi, there, thither (illic, illuc.) Indi, quindi, di là, di colà, from thence, from yonder (illinc.)

units.la: Di qua, hier durch, hier seits, hierzu, vnd hieher werts, (hac.)
units.tr: Di qua, through here, on this side, hither, and hitherward (hac.)

units.la: Di costo, dorten durch, dorten hindurch (istac.) di la, dort wertz. Idem, di cola, indi & quindi, (illac.) Altronde, anders woher. (alunde.) ad altro luogo, anders wohin, & clio, ) Doue, wo, (vbi, ) in alcun luogo, anders wo, (alibi.)
units.tr: From this side, over there through, over there past (istac.); from there, over there, that way (illac.). Likewise: from there, thence, and hence (illac.); from elsewhere, from another quarter (alunde.); to another place, elsewhither, and so on; where (vbi); in some place, somewhere else (alibi.)

units.la: Ounque, Dounque, & oueche, allenthalben, sey wo es wolle. (vbicunque.)
units.tr: Ounque, Dounque, & oueche, everywhere, wherever it may be (ubicunque).

units.la: Dentro, & entro, drinnen, (intus.)
units.tr: Dentro, & entro, within, inside (intus).

units.la: Fuori, & di fuori, drauffen, darauffen, (foris.)
units.tr: Fuori, & di fuori, outside, without (foris).

units.la: Vnde, donde, von wannen, (vnde.)
units.tr: Vnde, donde, whence (unde).

units.la: Indi, von dort hero, von dannen hero, (inde.)
units.tr: Indi, from thence, from there (inde).

units.la: Di altronde, anders woher, (alunde.)
units.tr: Di altronde, from elsewhere (alunde).

units.la: Iui, quiui, la cola, dafelbst, (ibi.)
units.tr: Iui, quiui, la cola, there (ibi).

units.la: Altronde, anderwerts, (alibi, )
units.tr: Altronde, elsewhere (alibi).

units.la: Da qualunque luogo, ley woher es wolle, (vndecunque.)
units.tr: Da qualunque luogo, from whatever place, whencesoever (undecunque).

units.la: Donde ti piace, woheres dir beliebet, (unde libet) per alcun luogo, via, o parte, durch einigerley orts vnd wegs. (aliqua.)
units.tr: Donde ti piace, whence you please (unde libet); per alcun luogo, via, o parte, by some place, way or part, by some route or direction (aliqua).

units.la: In alcun luogo, irgends wo, (vsquam.) a neffun luogo, nirgendswo, (nusquam.)
units.tr: In some place, somewhere (vsquam.); in no place, nowhere (nusquam.)

units.la: Infino qua, oner a questo tempo, a questo luogo, bis hieher, (hucusque.) Verso qua, verso questo luogo, hieher werts. (horsum.)
units.tr: Up to here, up to this time, up to this place, hitherto (hucusque.); toward here, toward this place, hither (horsum.)

units.la: Altroue, verso altro luogo, anderwers, anders wohin zu, (aliorsum.)
units.tr: Altroue, verso altro luogo, elsewhither, thither to another place (aliorsum).

units.la: Indietro, inuerso dietro, rückwerts, oder zurück-seits, (retrorsum.)
units.tr: Backward, toward the back, backwards, or back (retrorsum.)

units.la: Verso man finistra, gegen der lincken Hand zu, (finistrorsum.) Dæparte, da banda, (seorsum,) neben sich, beyseits. Insu, verso insu, hinauffwarts, nauffwerts, auffwerts, (furfum.) In giu, o inuerso, in giu, hinunderwarts, abwarts, (deorsum.)
units.tr: Verso man finistra, toward the left hand (finistrorsum). Dæparte, da banda (seorsum), aside, apart. Insu, verso insu, upward, aloft (furfum). In giu, o inuerso, in giu, downward, down (deorsum).

units.la: De Conjunctione. Zusammenfügung der Red vnd Wörter.
units.tr: De Conjunctione. Von Zusammenfügung der Red vnd Wörter. Of Conjunction: the joining together of speech and words.

units.la: ET, sequente vocali E, sequente Consonanti haec propria conjunguntur.
units.tr: ET, before a vowel E, before a consonant, these proper forms are joined.

units.la: Et sagt man, wann ein E. folget, sonst werden die nachfolgende eigentlich mit denen mitlautenden Buchstaben gefüget.
units.tr: One says "Et" when a vowel (E) follows; otherwise the following words are properly joined with the consonants.

units.la: Quædam continuant sensum ut, Etlich führen den Verstand weiters, als, in modo che, in guisa che, di maniera che, perfisfatta maniera che, si fattamente che: So gar, so gar daß, also daß, dero gestalt daß, &c. deromassen daß, (adeò quod, ita ut,)
units.tr: Some words continue the sense, such as: in modo che, in guisa che, di maniera che, per fatta maniera che, si fattamente che; so that, in such a way that; so much that, so that, in such manner that, thus that, so that (adeò quod, ita ut.)

units.la: Lionde, dahero, (vnde.) Perche, warumb, (quare,) Poiche, nach dem, demnach, (postquam.)
units.tr: Lionde, therefore (unde). Perche, why (quare). Poiche, after that, accordingly (postquam).

units.la: Quædam distinguunt, ut, ò, onero. Etliche vn-derscheiden, oder sondern ab, ò, onero, oder, (aut,) (seu,) entweder, oder, vel disjunguntqui-dem sententiam, sed conjungunt verba, die sondern zwar den Verstand von einander, aber die Wör-ter hengen sie an,
units.tr: Some distinguish: ò, onero, or (aut, seu), either... or (vel). These indeed separate the sense, but join the words to one another.

units.la: Die dem vorigen zuwider seynd, seynd dise.
units.tr: Those contrary to the preceding are these.

units.la: Nondimeno, Tuttania, Tuttanolta, benche, comeche, anchorche, quantunque, auengache (nihilominus,) nichts desto weniger, idem obwol, wiewol, ob gleich, wenn gleich, ob schon, wiewol daß, wan gleich daß, &c. idem ob zwar.
units.tr: Nondimeno, Tuttania, Tuttanolta, benche, comeche, anchorche, quantunque, auengache (nihilominus,) nevertheless, idem although, even though, even if, even when, although that, even if that, etc. idem although indeed.

units.la: Sed benche datur, in indicatiuo, catera autem subjunctiuo. Benche wird mit dem Indicatiuo construiert, die übrigen aber mit dem Coniunctiuo.
units.tr: Sed benche datur, in indicatiuo, catera autem subjunctiuo. Benche is construed with the indicative, the others however with the subjunctive.

units.la: Quadam detrahunt, vt, etliche mindern etwas, als, almeno, auffs wenigst, (saltem,) purche, nur daß, allein daß, (modo,) purche non vegga, (modo ne videam,) nur daß er nit sehe.
units.tr: Some words lessen the sense, such as some lessen something, such as almeno, at least, (saltem,) purche, provided that, only that, (modo,) purche non vegga, (modo ne videam,) provided that he does not see.

units.la: Tanto, so weit, so vil, (tantum,) solo, allein, (solum.)
units.tr: Tanto, so far, so much, (so much,) solo, alone, (only.)

units.la: Quadam reddunt causam, vt, etliche zeigen eine Vrsach an, als, Percioche, darumb daß, (enim.) Accioche, auff daß, (ne, vt ne) concio-fia cosa che, idem. Quadam concludunt, vt; Etliche schliessen, als, Adunque, derhalben, (ergo.) Percio, deßwegen, derowegen, (propterea.)
units.tr: Quadam reddunt causam, vt, Some give a reason, as: Percioche, because (enim.) Accioche, so that (ne, vt ne) concio-fia cosa che, idem. Quadam concludunt, vt; Some conclude, as: Adunque, therefore (ergo.) Percio, for that reason, wherefore (propterea.)

units.la: Quadam vsurpantur ornatus gratia, vt, Etliche werden zur zierd gebraucht, als ora, pure, ben &c.
units.tr: Some are used merely for ornament, such as some are used for ornament, such as ora, pure, ben etc.

units.la: De Interjectione.
units.tr: De Interjectione. Of Interjection.

units.la: Gaudentis, oh, ridentis, ah, ha, Admirantis, o, vh, vh, Dolentis, a hi, ah, o hi me, Desiderantis, deh,
units.tr: Of one rejoicing: oh. Of one laughing: ah, ha. Of one admiring: o, vh, vh. Of one grieving: a hi, ah, o hi me. Of one desiring: deh.

units.la: Terrentis, haca, haco, oh oh, Dio; Frewdenstimm, ho ho, Lachensstimm, ha ha ha, Wundernsstimm, ey, ai ey, Item der sich kümmert, ach, ach, Der da wünschet, hey, ey daß, Der abschröckt, hü frißjhn.
units.tr: Of one terrified: haca, haco, oh oh, Dio. A voice of joy: ho ho. A voice of laughter: ha ha ha. A voice of wonder: ey, ai ey. Likewise of one who is anxious: ach, ach. Of one who wishes: hey, would that. Of one who deters: hü, shoo him off.

units.la: Allhier folgen Appendicis loco, etliche Declinationes verborum, Welche in diser Grammatica, hievornen nit zufinden.
units.tr: Allhier folgen Appendicis loco, etliche Declinationes verborum, Welche in diser Grammatica, hievornen nit zufinden. Here follow, by way of appendix, some declensions of verbs which cannot be found earlier in this grammar.

units.la: Als erstlich.
units.tr: As first.

units.la: DECLINATIO VERBI ACTIVI, QVARTÆ CONJUGATIONIS.
units.tr: DECLINATION OF THE ACTIVE VERB, FOURTH CONJUGATION.

units.la: Dico, dire, sagen.
units.tr: I say, to say, to tell.

units.la: Temp. præs.
units.tr: Present tense.

units.la: Io dico, tu dici, colui dice, ich sag, du sagst, er sagt.
units.tr: I say, you say, he says; I say, you say, he says.

units.la: Noi dicemo, voi dicete, wir sagen, jhr saget. Coloro dicono, sie sagen.
units.tr: We say, you say, we say, you say. They say, they say.

units.la: Præteritum imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past tense.

units.la: Io dicena, tu diceui, colui dicena, ich sagte, du sagtest, er sagte.
units.tr: I was saying, you were saying, he was saying, I said, you said, he said.

units.la: Noi dicenamo, voi diceuate, wir sagten, oder sageten, jhr sagtet oder sagetet. Coloro dicenano, sie sagten oder sageten.
units.tr: Noi dicenamo, voi diceuate, we said, or sayed; you (plural) said, or sayed. Coloro dicenano, they said, or sayed.

units.la: Præs.
units.tr: Present.

units.la: Præt. Perfect. duplicatum.
units.tr: Preterite Perfect, doubled.

units.la: Io diffi & ho detto, ich hab gesagt.Tu dicesti, & hai detto, du hast gesagt.Colui disse, & ha detto, er hat gesagt. (fagt.Noi dicemmo, & habbiam detto, wir haben ge-Voi diceste, & havete detto, ihr habt gesagt.Coloro differo, & hanno detto, sie haben gesagt.
units.tr: I said and have said, I have said. You said and have said, you have said. He said and has said, he has said. We said and have said, we have said. You said and have said, you have said. They said and have said, they have said.

units.la: Plusq. perfectum.
units.tr: Pluperfect.

units.la: Io haueua, tu haueui, colui haueua. Noi haue-uamo, voi hauevate, coloro haueuano, detto.Ich, du, er hatte, hatteft gesagt. Wir, ihr, sie hatten, hattet gesagt.
units.tr: I had, you had, he had said. We had, you had, they had said. I, you, he had, hadst said. We, you, they had, had said.

units.la: Futurum.
units.tr: Future.

units.la: Io dirò, tu dirai, colui dira. Ich werd, du wirst, er wird sagen.Noi diremo, voi direte. Wird werden, ihr werdet sagen.Coloro diranno, sie werden sagen.
units.tr: Io dirò, tu dirai, colui dirà. I shall say, you will say, he will say. Noi diremo, voi direte. We shall say, you will say. Coloro diranno, they will say.

units.la: Imperativi Temp. præs.
units.tr: Imperative, present tense.

units.la: Dica tu, dica egli, diciamo noi, sag du, sag er, sagen wir.Dite voi, dicano coloro, saget ihr, sagen sie.
units.tr: Say you, let him say, let us say: say you, say he, say we. Say you, let them say: say you, say they.

units.la: Futur. temp.
units.tr: Future tense.

units.la: Dirai tu, dirà colui, diremo noi, du solt sagen, er solt sagen, wir sollen sagen.Direte voi, diranno coloro, ihr soltet, sie solen sagen.
units.tr: Dirai tu, dirà colui, diremo noi, you shall say, he shall say, we shall say. Direte voi, diranno coloro, you shall say, they shall say.

units.la: Opta-
units.tr: Optative.

units.la: O Dio voglia, che io dica. O wolte Gott, daß ich fag. Che tu dica, egli dicha, daß du sagst, daß er sag. Che noi diciamo, voi diciate, daß wir sagen, daß jhr saget, che coloro dicano, daß sie sagen.
units.tr: O God grant that I may say. Oh, would God that I said. That you may say, that he may say: that you say, that he say. That we may say, that you may say, that they may say: that we say, that you say, that they say.

units.la: Praeterit. perfect.
units.tr: Preterite perfect.

units.la: Iddio voglia, che io diceßi. Wolt Gott daß ich solt sagen.
units.tr: Iddio voglia, che io diceßi. Would to God that I should say.

units.la: Tu diceßi, egli diceße, du solte st sagen, er solt sagen.
units.tr: If you should say, if he should say: you should say, he should say.

units.la: Noi diceßimo, wir solten, Voi diceste, jhr soltet, Coloro diceßero, sie solten, sagen.
units.tr: Noi diceßimo, we should say; Voi diceste, you should say; Coloro diceßero, they should say.

units.la: Aliter, oder also.
units.tr: Aliter, or otherwise.

units.la: O che io direi, daß ich sagte. che tu direßi, daß du sagtest. Ch' egli direbbe, daß er sagte. Noi diremmo, wir sagten. che voi direste, daß jhr sagtet. Coloro direbbono, sie sagten.
units.tr: O che io direi, that I would say. Che tu direßi, that you would say. Ch' egli direbbe, that he would say. Noi diremmo, we would say. Che voi direste, that you would say. Coloro direbbono, they would say.

units.la: Praeterit. Perfect. Subjunct. 2.
units.tr: Preterite perfect subjunctive, second form.

units.la: Iddio voglia, che io habbia, tu habbia, egli habbia detto. Wolt Gott daß ich, du, er hab, habst gesagt.
units.tr: God grant that I may have, that you may have, that he may have said. Would God that I, you, he have, hast said.

units.la: Noi habbiamo, } detto.Voi habbiate, }Coloro habbiano, }Wir haben, } gesagt.Ihr habet, }Sie haben, }
units.tr: We have, you have, they have said: we have, you have, they have said.

units.la: Præterit. Plusquamperfect.
units.tr: Preterite pluperfect.

units.la: Dio voglia,Che io haueßi, } detto.Tu haueßi, }Chi egli haueße, }Ich solt haben, } gesagt.Du solst haben, }Er solt haben, }
units.tr: Dio voglia, che io haueßi, tu haueßi, chi egli haueße, detto. Would to God that I should have said, you should have said, he should have said.

units.la: Noi haueßimo, } detto.Voi haueste, }Coloro haueßero, }Wir, jhr, sie, solten, soltet, soltet haben gesagt.
units.tr: Noi haueßimo, Voi haueste, Coloro haueßero, detto. We, you, they should have said.

units.la: Idem aliter.
units.tr: Idem aliter. The same otherwise.

units.la: O cb' io hauerei, haueria, tu hauerefti, colui hauerebbe, & haueria, detto.
units.tr: Oh, that I would have, you would have, he would have, and would have said.

units.la: Daß ich, du, er, hätte, hättest gesagt.
units.tr: That I would have said, you would have said, he would have said.

units.la: Noi haueremmo, } detto.Che voi hauereste, }Coloro hauerebbono, & haueriano, }
units.tr: We would have, that you would have, they would have, and would have said.

units.la: Daß wir, jhr, sie, solten haben, soltet haben, gesagt.
units.tr: That we, you, they should have said.

units.la: Futurum subjunctiui.
units.tr: Future subjunctive.

units.la: Quando io hauerò,Tu hauerai,Egli hauerà,Noi haueremo,Voi havereтe,Coloro haueranno, detto. Wenn ich, du, er, wir, jhr, sie, werd, wirst, wird, werden, werdet haben gesagt.
units.tr: When I shall have, you shall have, he shall have, we shall have, you shall have, they shall have said: when I, you, he, we, you, they shall have said.

units.la: Infinitiui Temp. praes.
units.tr: Infinitive, present tense.

units.la: Dire, Sagen.Hauere detto, gesagt haben.Futur. Douere dire, sagen sollen.Hauere a dire, zusagen haben.Essere per dire, zusagen seyn.
units.tr: Dire, to say. Hauere detto, to have said. Futur. Douere dire, to be going to say, to be to say. Hauere a dire, to have to say. Essere per dire, to be about to say.

units.la: Participium, dicente, dicenti, sagend, die sagenden.Detto, detti, der gesagte, die gesagten.Detta, dette, gen. mul.
units.tr: Participium: dicente, dicenti, saying, those saying. Detto, detti, the said, the said (plural). Detta, dette, the said (feminine).

units.la: Gerundij.
units.tr: Gerunds.

units.la: Dicendo, sagend, sagende.Hauendo detto, io, tu, egli, noi, voi, coloro, weil ich, du, er gesagt, nachdem wir, jhr, sie gesagt haben, &c.
units.tr: Dicendo, saying. Hauendo detto, io, tu, egli, noi, voi, coloro, because I, you, he have said; after we, you, they have said, etc.

units.la: Douendo dire, nachdem ich oder er sagen soll, &c.
units.tr: Douendo dire, after I or he should say, etc.

units.la: Hauendo a dire, io, noi, &c. nachdem ich oder wir zusagen haben.
units.tr: Hauendo a dire, io, noi, &c. after I or we have to say.

units.la: DECLINATIO VERBI PARLO, PARLARE, reden.
units.tr: DECLINATION OF THE VERB PARLO, PARLARE, to speak (reden).

units.la: Ex prima Conjugatione, als,
units.tr: From the first conjugation, as follows:

units.la: Indicat. mod. temp. praes.
units.tr: Indicative mood, present tense

units.la: Io parlo, ich red, rede, (loquor.) Tu parli, du redest, (loqueris.) Colui parla, er redet, (loquitur.) Noi parliamo, wir reden, (loquimur.) Voi parlate, jhr redet, (loquimini.) Coloro parlano, sie reden, (loquuntur.)
units.tr: Io parlo, I speak (I speak.). Tu parli, you speak (you speak.). Colui parla, he speaks (he speaks.). Noi parliamo, we speak (we speak.). Voi parlate, you speak (you speak.). Coloro parlano, they speak (they speak.).

units.la: Praeteritum imperfect.
units.tr: Imperfect past tense

units.la: Io parlaua, ich redte, (loquebar.) Tu parlaui, du redteft, (loquebaris.) Colui parlaua, er redte, (loquebatur.) Noi parlauamo, wir redten, (loquebamur.) Voi parlauate, jhr redtet, oder redetet, (loquebamini.) Coloro parlauano, sie redeten, (loquebantur.)
units.tr: Io parlaua, I was speaking. Tu parlaui, you were speaking. Colui parlaua, he was speaking. Noi parlauamo, we were speaking. Voi parlauate, you were speaking. Coloro parlauano, they were speaking. ## Perfect past

units.la: Praeteritum perfect.

Io parlai, & ho parlato, ich hab geredt, (locutus sum.) Tu parlasti, tu hai parlato, du haft geredt, (locutus es.) Colui parlo, & ha parlato, er hat geredt, (locutus est.) Noi parlammo, & habbiamo parlato, wir haben geredt, (locuti sumus.)
units.tr: Io parlai, & ho parlato, I have spoken. Tu parlasti, tu hai parlato, you have spoken. Colui parlo, & ha parlato, he has spoken. Noi parlammo, & habbiamo parlato, we have spoken, (we have spoken.)

units.la: Voi parlaste, & hauete parlato, jhr habet geredt, (locuti estis.)
units.tr: Voi parlaste, & hauete parlato, you have spoken, (you have spoken.)

units.la: Coloro parlarono, & hanno parlato, sie haben geredt, (locuti sunt.)
units.tr: Coloro parlarono, & hanno parlato, they have spoken, (they have spoken.) ## Pluperfect

units.la: Plusquam perfectum.

Io haueua, Tu haueui, Colui haueua, parlato. Locutus eram. Locutus eras. Locutus erat. Ich, du, er, hatte, hatteft geredt. Noi haueuamo, Voi haueuate, Coloro haueuano, parlato. Locuti eramus, eratis, erant.
units.tr: I had, you had, he had, spoken. I had spoken. You had spoken. He had spoken. I, you, he, had, hadst spoken (German). We had, you had, they had, spoken. We had spoken, you had spoken, they had spoken.

units.la: Wir, jhr, sie, hatten, hattet geredt.
units.tr: We, you, they had spoken. ## Future

units.la: Futurum.
Io parlarò, (loquar.) Tu parlarai, (loqueris.) Colui parlara, (loquetur.) Noi parlaremo, (loquemur.) Voi parlarete, (loquemini.) Coloro parlaranno, (loquentur.)
units.tr: Io parlarò, I shall speak. Tu parlarai, you shall speak. Colui parlara, he shall speak. Noi parlaremo, we shall speak. Voi parlarete, you shall speak. Coloro parlaranno, they shall speak.

units.la: Ich, du, er, wir, jhr, sie, werd, wirst, wird, werden, werdet, werden reden.
units.tr: I, you, he, we, you, they will speak. ## Imperative, present tense

units.la: Imperativo temp. praes.
Parla tu, parla colui, rede du, rede er, (loquere.)
units.tr: Parla tu, parla colui, speak you, let him speak.

units.la: Idem. Parlate voi, redet jhr, (loquimini.) Parlano coloro, reden sie, (loquuntur.)
units.tr: Idem. Parlate voi, speak you. Parlano coloro, let them speak. ## Future imperative

units.la: Futurum Imperat.
Parlai tu, du solt reden, (loquitor.) Parlarà colui, er soll reden, (loquitor.) Parlarete voi, jhr sollt reden, (loquiminor.) Parlaranno coloro, sie sollen reden, (loquuntor.)
units.tr: Parlai tu, you shall speak. Parlarà colui, he shall speak. Parlarete voi, you shall speak. Parlaranno coloro, they shall speak. ## Subjunctive or conjunctive mood, present tense

units.la: Subjunctiui vel conjunct.mod.temp.praes.
Che io parli, tu parli, egli parla, daß ich redte, solt reden, daß du, er solt reden, ouer che io parlassi, tu parlassi, &c. (Ego loquar, tu loquaris, ille loquatur.)
units.tr: Che io parli, tu parli, egli parla, that I speak, that you speak, that he speak; or che io parlassi, tu parlassi, &c. (that I might speak, that you might speak, and so on).

units.la: Che noi parlassimo, voi parlaste, coloro parlassero, daß wir redten, solten reden, jhr redetet, soltet reden, sie solten reden, redeten. (Loquamur, loquamini, & loquantur.)
units.tr: Che noi parlassimo, voi parlaste, coloro parlassero, that we speak, that you speak, that they speak. ## Imperfect, past tense

units.la: Imperfect. temp. prat.
O che ioparlarei, daß ich redete. Vtinam ego loquerer.
units.tr: O che io parlarei, O that I might speak.

units.la: Che tu parlaresti, daß du redtest. Ch' egli parlarebbe, daß er redte. (Tu loquereris, ille loqueretur.)
units.tr: Che tu parlaresti, that you might speak. Ch' egli parlarebbe, that he might speak.

units.la: Noi parlaremmo, wir redten, (nos loqueremur.) Voi parlaresse, jhr redetet, (vos loqueremini.)
units.tr: Noi parlaremmo, we might speak. Voi parlaresse, you might speak.

units.la: Che coloro parlarebbono, & parlariano, daß sie redeten, (illi loquerentur.)
units.tr: Che coloro parlarebbono, & parlariano, that they might speak. ## Perfect past

units.la: Præteritum perfectum.

Dio volesse, che io, che tu, ch'egli habbia parlato, Cum ego Daß ich hab, ] Locutus sim. daß du hast, } geredt. locutus sis. daß er hat, ] locutus sit. Che noi habbiamo, ] Locuti simus. Che voi habbiate, } parlato. locuti sitis. Coloro habbiano, ] locuti sint.
units.tr: Dio volesse, che io, che tu, ch'egli habbia parlato, God grant that I, that you, that he may have spoken: that I have spoken, that you have spoken, that he has spoken. Che noi habbiamo, that we have spoken; Che voi habbiate, that you have spoken; Coloro habbiano parlato, that they have spoken.

units.la: Daß wir haben, jhr habet, daß sie haben geredt.
units.tr: That we have, you have, they have spoken. ## Pluperfect past

units.la: Præterit. plusq. perfect.
O che io, che tu, che egli, hauesse, & hauesse parlato,
units.tr: O che io, che tu, che egli, hauesse, & hauesse parlato, O that I, that you, that he, had, and had spoken,

units.la: Daß ich hätt, oder solt haben geredt, (ego locutus essem.)
units.tr: That I had (or should have) spoken.

units.la: Du solt haben geredt, (locutus esses.)
units.tr: You should have spoken.

units.la: Er solt haben geredt, (locutus esset.)
units.tr: He should have spoken.

units.la: Noi habbiamo, voi habbiate, coloro habbiano parlato.
units.tr: Noi habbiamo, voi habbiate, coloro habbiano parlato. We have spoken, you have spoken, they have spoken.

units.la: Wir hätten, jhr hättet, sie hätten geredt.
units.tr: That we would have, you would have, they would have spoken.

units.la: Locuti essemus, essetis, essent.
units.tr: That we had spoken, you had spoken, they had spoken. ## Future

units.la: Futurum.

Io haverò, Tu haverai, Colui haverà, Noi haveremo, Voi haverete, Coloro haveranno, parlato. Cum ego locutus ero, locutus eris, locutus erit, locuti erimus, locuti eritis, locuti erint. Wenn ich werd, wenn du wirst, wenn er wirdt, } haben Wenn wir werden, } geredt. Ihr werdet, Sie werden,
units.tr: Io haverò, Tu haverai, Colui haverà, Noi haveremo, Voi haverete, Coloro haveranno, parlato. When I shall have spoken, when you will have spoken, when he will have spoken, when we shall have spoken, when you will have spoken, when they will have spoken. (Wenn ich werd, wenn du wirst, wenn er wirdt, } haben / Wenn wir werden, } geredt. Ihr werdet, Sie werden,: if I shall, if you shall, if he shall, [have] spoken; if we shall, you shall, they shall [have] spoken.)

units.tr: Infinitive mood, present and imperfect.

units.tr: To have spoken, to have spoken (to have spoken). To be to speak, to be supposed to speak. To have to speak, to have to exhort, to be going to speak (to be going to speak).

units.la: Essendo per parlare, weil zureden ist.
units.tr: Essendo per parlare, since there is speaking to be done.

units.la: Perdere, Verliehren.
units.tr: Perdere, to lose.

units.la: Indicativ. Temp. præsens.
units.tr: Indicative. Present tense.

units.la: Io perdo, tu perdi, colui perde, Ich verliere, du verlierst, er verleürt, Noi perdemo, wir verlieren.Voi perdete, jhr verlieret.Coloro perdono, sie verlieren.
units.tr: Io perdo, tu perdi, colui perde, I lose, you lose, he loses, Noi perdemo, we lose. Voi perdete, you lose. Coloro perdono, they lose.

units.la: Praeterit. Imperfect.
units.tr: Past, imperfect.

units.la: Io perdena, ich verlohr, verluhr.Tu perdeui, du verluhrst.Colui perdena, er verlohr, verluhr.Noi perdenamo, wir verluhren.Voi perdenate, jhr verluhret.Coloro perdeuano, sie verluhren.
units.tr: Io perdena, I lost. Tu perdeui, you lost. Colui perdena, he lost. Noi perdenamo, we lost. Voi perdenate, you lost. Coloro perdeuano, they lost.

units.la: Praeterit perfect. duplicatum.
units.tr: Past perfect, doubled form.

units.la: Io perdei & pe[?] etti, ho perduto, ich hab verloren.Tu perdesti & hai perduto, & perso, du hast verloren.Colui perdette, & ha perduto, er hat verlohren.Noi perdemmo, & habbiamo perduto, wir haben verlohren.Voi perdeste, & hauete perduto, jhr habt verloren.Coloro perdettero & hanno perduto, sie haben verlorn.
units.tr: Io perdei & perdetti, ho perduto, I lost; I have lost. Tu perdesti & hai perduto, & perso, you lost; you have lost. Colui perdette, & ha perduto, he lost; he has lost. Noi perdemmo, & habbiamo perduto, we lost; we have lost. Voi perdeste, & hauete perduto, you (plural) lost; you have lost. Coloro perdettero & hanno perduto, they lost; they have lost.

units.tr: Pluperfect.

units.tr: Io perdero, I shall lose, tu perderai, you will lose, colui perderà, he will lose, Noi perderemo, we shall lose, Voi perderete, you will lose, Coloro perderanno, they will lose.

units.la: Imperatiui modi. tempus præs.

units.la: Perdano coloro, verlieren sie,
units.tr: Perdano coloro, let them lose.

units.la: Perderemo noi, wir sollen verlieren.

units.la: Perderete voi, jhr solt verlieren.

units.la: Perderanno coloro, sie sollen verlieren.

units.la: Dio voglia che io perda, tu perda, colui perda, Noi perdiamo, voi perdiate, coloro perdano. Wolte Gott daß ich verlier, du verlierst, er verlierte. Wir verlieren, jhr verlieret, daß sie verlieren.
units.tr: Dio voglia che io perda, tu perda, colui perda, Noi perdiamo, voi perdiate, coloro perdano. Would God that I might lose, that you might lose, that he might lose, that we might lose, that you might lose, that they might lose.
